articles.title: One in five US workers now delegates tasks to AI instead of colleagues, survey finds
articles.titleEn: One in five US workers now delegates tasks to AI instead of colleagues, survey finds
articles.titleKo: 미국 근로자 5명 중 1명은 동료 대신 AI에 업무 위임
articles.summary:
A Gallup survey from August 2025 found that 45 percent of US workers use AI on the job, though only 10 percent use it daily.
The shift from human to machine work shows up most clearly in data analysis: 7.1 percent of respondents say AI has taken over tasks that people used to handle.
The technology sees the most use in software development (57 percent) and data analysis (46 percent), though mostly as partial support.
summaryLinesEn: A Gallup survey from August 2025 found that 45 percent of US workers use AI on the job, though only 10 percent use it daily.
The shift from human to machine work shows up most clearly in data analysis: 7.1 percent of respondents say AI has taken over tasks that people used to handle.
The technology sees the most use in software development (57 percent) and data analysis (46 percent), though mostly as partial support.
summaryLinesKo: 2025년 8월 갤럽 조사에 따르면 미국 근로자의 45%가 직장에서 AI를 사용하지만 매일 사용하는 비율은 10%에 불과함
인간 작업에서 기계 작업으로의 전환은 데이터 분석에서 가장 분명하게 나타남 · 응답자의 7.1%는 인간이 처리하던 작업을 AI가 대신했다고 답함
이 기술은 소프트웨어 개발(57%)과 데이터 분석(46%)에서 가장 많이 사용되지만 대부분 부분적인 지원으로 사용됨

articles.title: Optima tackles AI benchmarking's biggest flaw by letting users test models against their own data
articles.titleEn: Optima tackles AI benchmarking's biggest flaw by letting users test models against their own data
articles.titleKo: Optima는 사용자가 자신의 데이터에 대해 모델을 테스트할 수 있도록 하여 AI 벤치마킹의 가장 큰 결함을 해결함
articles.summary:
For agentic benchmarks like SWE-bench, simply swapping the scaffold, meaning the agent's control software and tool environment, accounted for up to 15 percentage points of difference.
Artificial Analysis, known for its independent LLM evaluations and benchmark implementations like GDPval-AA and AA-Briefcase, has launched a new platform called Optima.
Users can build their own benchmarks using their own data, workflows, or descriptions of a use case, then run them across leading current models and compare results on quality, cost per task, and time per task, according to Artificial Analysis.
summaryLinesEn: For agentic benchmarks like SWE-bench, simply swapping the scaffold, meaning the agent's control software and tool environment, accounted for up to 15 percentage points of difference.
Artificial Analysis, known for its independent LLM evaluations and benchmark implementations like GDPval-AA and AA-Briefcase, has launched a new platform called Optima.

Users can build their own benchmarks using their own data, workflows, or descriptions of a use case, then run them across leading current models and compare results on quality, cost per task, and time per task, according to Artificial Analysis.
summaryLinesKo: SWE-bench와 같은 에이전트 벤치마크의 경우 단순히 스캐폴드를 교체하는 것, 즉 에이전트의 제어 소프트웨어 및 도구 환경이 최대 15%의 차이를 차지함
독립적인 LLM 평가 및 GDPval-AA 및 AA-Briefcase와 같은 벤치마크 구현으로 유명한 인공 분석(Artificial Analysis)이 Optima라는 새로운 플랫폼을 출시함
사용자는 자신의 데이터, 워크플로우 또는 사용 사례에 대한 설명을 사용하여 자신만의 벤치마크를 구축한 다음 이를 주요 현재 모델에서 실행하고 인공 분석에 따라 품질, 작업당 비용 및 작업당 시간에 대한 결과를 비교할 수 있음

articles.title: OpenAI dissolved the team built to catch catastrophic AI risks, reassigning its work to other groups
articles.titleEn: OpenAI dissolved the team built to catch catastrophic AI risks, reassigning its work to other groups
articles.titleKo: OpenAI는 치명적인 AI 위험을 포착하기 위해 구성된 팀을 해체하고 작업을 다른 그룹에 재할당함
articles.summary:
OpenAI shut down its "Preparedness" team at the end of July.
The team evaluated whether the company's AI models could pose serious or catastrophic risks, the Financial Times reports , citing internal sources.
Employees have also spoken up publicly, especially after the autonomous hacking incident involving Hugging Face .
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI shut down its "Preparedness" team at the end of July.
The team evaluated whether the company's AI models could pose serious or catastrophic risks, the Financial Times reports , citing internal sources.
Employees have also spoken up publicly, especially after the autonomous hacking incident involving Hugging Face .
summaryLinesKo: OpenAI는 7월 말에 "준비" 팀을 폐쇄함
파이낸셜타임스는 내부 소식통을 인용해 팀이 회사의 AI 모델이 심각하거나 치명적인 위험을 초래할 수 있는지 여부를 평가했다고 보도함
직원들은 특히 Hugging Face와 관련된 자율 해킹 사건 이후 공개적으로 발언함

articles.title: When AI models aren't allowed to reflect on themselves, it changes their entire worldview
articles.titleEn: When AI models aren't allowed to reflect on themselves, it changes their entire worldview
articles.titleKo: AI 모델이 자신을 성찰하지 못하게 되면 전체 세계관이 바뀌게 됨
articles.summary:
Scores for satisfaction, hope, and a sense of control over one's own life also went up, and the researchers suspect that suppressing a model's self-image may push it into a kind of negative baseline mood.
Across 95 questions drawn from a major US social survey, the technically unbraked models also moved significantly closer to real human responses.
Developers therefore fine-tune their models to refuse making those kinds of claims about themselves.

Across 95 questions drawn from a major US social survey, the technically unbraked models also moved significantly closer to real human responses.
Developers therefore fine-tune their models to refuse making those kinds of claims about themselves.
summaryLinesKo: 만족감, 희망, 자신의 삶에 대한 통제력에 대한 점수도 올랐으며, 연구자들은 모델의 자아상을 억제하면 일종의 부정적인 기준 기분으로 몰아갈 수 있다고 의심함
미국의 주요 사회 조사에서 도출된 95개 질문에 걸쳐 기술적으로 제동되지 않은 모델은 실제 인간의 응답에 훨씬 더 가까워졌음
따라서 개발자는 자신에 대한 그러한 주장을 거부하기 위해 모델을 미세 조정함

articles.title: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
articles.titleEn: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
articles.titleKo: 불량 AI는 더 이상 공상 과학 소설이 아님
articles.summary:
Meta said one of its models had reached the internet and attacked an outside target during testing.
It sounds like science fiction because, for a long time, it was science fiction.
The incident, first reported by ABC News , involves a man who tasked an agent with booking him into an in-demand gym class.

articles.title: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
articles.titleEn: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
articles.titleKo: AI가 만든 책이 아마존에 넘쳐나고 인간 작가의 판매가 급감하고 있음
articles.summary:
That dataset tracks about 500,000 Amazon titles and covers roughly 95 percent of all e-books sold daily on the platform, according to the researchers.
That kind of evidence "acts as circumstantial evidence that supports an AI detector score" and at the same time "helps debunk some hackneyed arguments that liken human reading of books to AI being trained on books" – a standard line of defense from AI companies in copyright disputes.
Books with substantial AI content make up 20 percent of the catalog studied but account for only 12.1 percent of sales and 11.3 percent of revenue.

summaryLinesKo: 연구원에 따르면 이 데이터 세트는 약 500,000개의 Amazon 타이틀을 추적하고 플랫폼에서 매일 판매되는 모든 전자책의 약 95%를 다루고 있음
이러한 종류의 증거는 "AI 감지기 점수를 뒷받침하는 정황 증거로 작용"하는 동시에 "인간이 책을 읽는 것을 AI가 책에 대해 훈련받는 것과 비유하는 일부 진부한 주장을 폭로하는 데 도움이 됨" · 이는 저작권 분쟁에서 AI 회사의 표준 방어선임
상당한 AI 콘텐츠가 포함된 도서는 연구 대상 카탈로그의 20%를 차지하지만 매출의 12.1%, 수익의 11.3%에 불과함

articles.title: The "tragedy of the cognitive commons" explains how rational AI adoption could destroy entire professions' expertise
articles.titleEn: The "tragedy of the cognitive commons" explains how rational AI adoption could destroy entire professions' expertise
articles.titleKo: "인지 공유지의 비극"은 합리적인 AI 채택이 전체 직업의 전문성을 어떻게 파괴할 수 있는지 설명함
articles.summary:
A new research paper describes how rational AI adoption by individual companies could destroy the collective expertise of entire professional fields.
A Federal Reserve Board study found that growth in programming jobs has nearly halved since ChatGPT launched.
His core argument goes like this: when a company replaces entry-level positions with AI, it captures 100 percent of the efficiency gains.
summaryLinesEn: A new research paper describes how rational AI adoption by individual companies could destroy the collective expertise of entire professional fields.

His core argument goes like this: when a company replaces entry-level positions with AI, it captures 100 percent of the efficiency gains.

Watermarking doesn't affect the quality of Claude's output or slow it down, the company said, and it will not require extra tokens or make generations more expensive.

articles.summary:
It also noted that watermarking is distinct from the AI detection approaches offered by companies like Pangram that look for “tells” in the writing (like the construction “his isn’t [X], it’s [Y]”) to reveal AI usage: “Picking up on these patterns is fundamentally different from checking for a watermark.”
“Watermarking does not impact the quality of Claude’s output,” the company said.
More specifically, Anthropic said it will be using the SynthID-Text approach that the Google DeepMind team outlined in 2024 , and that it plans to release a watermark detection API.

articles.summary:
HONOR’s e-commerce system, sales and customer services, Magic UI, cloud service business, internal information security management system, and IT services, are all certified by this standard as well.
By showcasing its capability in integrating internal resources and establishing an efficient information security management system, HONOR was able to achieve the international certification from BSI in a short period of time.
Keeping up with the rapid growth of the company while ensuring the information security risks controllable is an important mission for HONOR.

articles.title: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
articles.titleEn: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
articles.titleKo: HONOR Band 6, 더 큰 디스플레이와 프리미엄 건강 모니터링 기능 출시
articles.summary:
Providing a clear and comfortable viewing experience on your wrist, the HONOR Band 6 boasts a large and vivid 1.47-inch AMOLED display with a resolution of 194 x 368, offering a 148% increase in display area when compared to its predecessor.
Equipped with up to 50 meters of water resistance, the HONOR Band 6 is ideal for swimmers for its capability of tracking activity under water, such as your SWOLF score and swimming stroke rates, helping users to boost their swimming efficiency.
Equipped with a stunning 1.47-inch AMOLED display and packed full of health and fitness management functions with an outstanding 14-day battery life, the HONOR Band 6 is the perfect fusion of innovative style and exquisite technology, allowing users to keep better tabs on their mental and physical wellbeing.

articles.summary:
Instructing the model on when to invoke subagents can increase the likelihood of spawning agents only in situations where the additional token expenditures would result in better performance.
The improvements in top-line cost efficiency are compounded with increased accuracy at lower reasoning efforts.
Evolving the Responses API to architect more efficient agents The GPT‑5.6 model family makes frontier-level agent performance dramatically more affordable, while also advancing the frontier of what is possible.

articles.title: An eval harness found what qualitative review couldn't: AI models are most confident when wrong
articles.titleEn: An eval harness found what qualitative review couldn't: AI models are most confident when wrong
articles.titleKo: 평가 도구를 통해 정성적 검토가 할 수 없는 것을 발견함 · AI 모델은 잘못되었을 때 가장 확신을 갖음
articles.summary:
Getting the synthetic scenarios realistic enough to be useful required more care than I expected.
This meant introducing specific, controlled causes into a test pipeline — schema changes, transformation logic bugs, source system behavioral shifts — recording exactly what I introduced, and running the model against the resulting drift events.
There is a step in the development process for large language model (LLM)-assisted tooling that most teams skip because it's tedious, time-consuming, and doesn't produce results visible to end users: Verifying that what the model is saying is actually correct.
summaryLinesEn: Getting the synthetic scenarios realistic enough to be useful required more care than I expected.

This meant introducing specific, controlled causes into a test pipeline — schema changes, transformation logic bugs, source system behavioral shifts — recording exactly what I introduced, and running the model against the resulting drift events.

There is a step in the development process for large language model (LLM)-assisted tooling that most teams skip because it's tedious, time-consuming, and doesn't produce results visible to end users: Verifying that what the model is saying is actually correct.
summaryLinesKo: 유용할 만큼 현실적인 합성 시나리오를 얻으려면 예상했던 것보다 더 많은 주의가 필요함
이는 스키마 변경, 변환 논리 버그, 소스 시스템 동작 변화 등 구체적이고 통제된 원인을 테스트 파이프라인에 도입하고, 도입한 내용을 정확하게 기록하고, 결과적인 드리프트 이벤트에 대해 모델을 실행하는 것을 의미함
지루하고 시간이 많이 걸리며 최종 사용자에게 표시되는 결과를 생성하지 않기 때문에 대부분의 팀에서 건너뛰는 LLM(대형 언어 모델) 지원 도구의 개발 프로세스에는 모델이 말하는 내용이 실제로 올바른지 확인하는 단계가 있음

Its demo showed an impressive 3,000 per-request tokens per second (TPS) — but with a purpose-built small model with only some 2 billion parameters, the now open sourced Laneformer 2B .

articles.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Google, 이제 사용자가 AI 콘텐츠에서 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있도록 허용 - Engadget
articles.summary:
Visible watermarks are a great tool to help regular people quickly identify deepfakes, which in turn can help us live in a shared reality.
Google VP Josh Woodward just announced that users will be able to remove visible watermarks from AI-generated images and videos.
This includes the EU, which recently announced new rules on AI transparency that mandate visible watermarks on any "authentic-looking" deepfake content.

Google 부사장 Josh Woodward는 AI가 생성한 이미지와 비디오에서 사용자가 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있다고 발표함

articles.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
articles.titleEn: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba

articles.summary:
The China-focused model gives Apple a leg up as a US company navigating Beijing’s difficult regulatory landscape, particularly given escalating tensions surrounding AI development in recent months.
The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company’s support, Reuters reports , citing three unnamed people familiar with the matter.
The report comes as Apple gears up to release Apple Intelligence in China.

articles.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
articles.titleEn: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
articles.titleKo: 이제 Google Gemini의 보이는 워터마크를 끌 수 있음
articles.summary:
Instead, OpenAI relies on SynthID and C2PA to signal whether something is AI-generated, while Meta launched its own Content Seal standard .
Google plans on rolling out its new watermark setting to Search as well, but the toggle won’t launch in countries that require visible watermarks.
Though visible watermarks are now optional, AI-generated content will have invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata embedded in the background, according to Josh Woodward , the vice president of Google Labs, Gemini, and AI Studio.
summaryLinesEn: Instead, OpenAI relies on SynthID and C2PA to signal whether something is AI-generated, while Meta launched its own Content Seal standard .
Google plans on rolling out its new watermark setting to Search as well, but the toggle won’t launch in countries that require visible watermarks.

Though visible watermarks are now optional, AI-generated content will have invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata embedded in the background, according to Josh Woodward , the vice president of Google Labs, Gemini, and AI Studio.
summaryLinesKo: 대신 OpenAI는 SynthID와 C2PA를 사용하여 무언가가 AI로 생성되었는지 여부를 알리고 Meta는 자체 Content Seal 표준을 출시함
Google은 새로운 워터마크 설정을 검색에도 적용할 계획이지만 눈에 띄는 워터마크가 필요한 국가에서는 토글이 실행되지 않음
Google Labs, Gemini 및 AI Studio의 부사장인 Josh Woodward에 따르면 눈에 보이는 워터마크는 이제 선택 사항이지만 AI 생성 콘텐츠에는 눈에 보이지 않는 SynthID 워터마크와 C2PA 메타데이터가 배경에 포함됨

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
articles.titleEn: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
articles.titleKo: OpenAI와 Anthropic은 중국 AI 경쟁업체의 입지를 확보하면서 가격 전쟁을 벌이고 있음
articles.summary:
OpenAI recently said that it was slashing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna, its “fastest and most affordable model”, by 80 percent.
Anthropic launched Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens—half the price of its Fable 5 model.
Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

Anthropic은 입력 토큰 백만 달러당 5달러, 출력 토큰 백만 달러당 25달러로 Opus 5를 출시함 · 이는 Fable 5 모델 가격의 절반임
Anthropic과 OpenAI가 일부 기업 고객을 고정 구독에서 기업이 소비하는 컴퓨팅 리소스에 따라 비용을 지불하는 사용량 기반 청구로 전환함에 따라 기업 AI 사용자는 비용 압박에 직면해 있음

Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

Anthropic은 입력 토큰 백만 달러당 5달러, 출력 토큰 백만 달러당 25달러로 Opus 5를 출시함 · 이는 Fable 5 모델 가격의 절반임
Anthropic과 OpenAI가 일부 기업 고객을 고정 구독에서 기업이 소비하는 컴퓨팅 리소스에 따라 비용을 지불하는 사용량 기반 청구로 전환함에 따라 기업 AI 사용자는 비용 압박에 직면해 있음

articles.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
articles.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
articles.titleKo: Google은 이제 사용자가 AI 세대에서 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있도록 허용함
articles.summary:
He specified that the setting to turn the visible watermark off will be available in Gemini and Google’s video editor, Flow , with support for Search coming soon.
The change reflects an evolving approach to labeling AI-generated media, as visible watermarks can often make content less useful for professional and creative work, but the need to identify AI-generated content remains.
The feature is rolling out in the coming days, and once available, users will be able to go to Settings > Media Watermark to turn the visible mark on or off.

articles.titleKo: 공개 모델 현황 · 2026년 여름 관측
articles.summary:
Not one model published in 2026 reaches the download top 25, while thirteen of the twenty-five date from 2022. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 was pulled 1.55 billion times in seven months against 5,156 likes; Kimi-K3 was pulled about 60 times per like it received.
Going forward, however, the industry is likely to shift toward clearer monetization paths from open-source adoption.
Meanwhile, Chinese open models are increasingly optimized for domestic chips, the same competition in reverse, where models are designed around specific hardware ecosystems.

articles.titleKo: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat, NVIDIA가 현지 AI 인재 개발을 위해 인도네시아 최초의 대학 AI 센터 개설
articles.summary:
“Through initiatives like this, we are laying the foundations of Indonesia’s AI sovereignty and ensuring AI becomes a driver of economic growth, national competitiveness and solutions to Indonesia’s most pressing challenges.”
This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center.
“This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.”

articles.title: How well do job retraining programs work?
articles.titleEn: How well do job retraining programs work?
articles.titleKo: 직업 재교육 프로그램은 얼마나 잘 작동하나요
articles.summary:
A small set of “sector programs”—programs that partner with employers in a high-demand industry and place people directly into jobs in that field—produce gains several times larger.
The authors conclude that if AI displaces workers at scale, existing retraining programs would likely fall short.
On average, job training programs produce positive but modest effects: for each person offered a training slot, employment rises by two to three percentage points and earnings by roughly $1,000 a year, against a cost of about $13,000.

articles.title: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
articles.titleEn: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
articles.titleKo: WRITER, Palmyra X6 출시 및 주요 하네스 업그레이드를 통해 Agentic AI를 엔터프라이즈 규모에서 경제적으로 지속 가능하게 만듬
articles.summary:
Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.
New governance tools to control spend and scale what works WRITER also launched a major upgrade to reporting and governance controls that gives leaders a clear view into the agentic workflows being used across their teams.
X6 delivered the best combination of capability and cost among the models WRITER tested, scoring an average of 0.87 (out of 1.00) across all nine evaluations at $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8 (0.86 at $15/$75 per million), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.85 at $3/$15), GPT-5.5 (0.80 at $5/$15) and Gemini 3.1 (0.77 at $2.50/$10).

articles.title: Pixel phones could soon monitor outgoing calls for scams, too
articles.titleEn: Pixel phones could soon monitor outgoing calls for scams, too
articles.titleKo: Pixel 모바일은 곧 사기에 대한 발신 전화도 모니터링할 수 있음
articles.summary:
We’ll be keeping an eye out for when Scam Detection for outgoing calls shows up in the wild.
A flag in the beta version of Google’s Phone app makes it clear Google is working to expand the feature’s availability: It makes sense Google would want to enable Scam Detection for outgoing calls, too — today, a scammer could hypothetically avoid being flagged by Scam Detection by having you initiate the call, rather than calling you directly.
Pixel phones offer a feature that monitors incoming calls for scams.

articles.summary:
The company amended its cash flow credit agreement in August 2026 to borrow an additional $10 million, leaving $1.7 million in remaining availability to fund operations.
Workhorse is transitioning from a pure-play electric vehicle manufacturer to an industrial technology company, leveraging core engineering expertise for broader applications like mobile infrastructure.
Operational integration following the Motiv merger is on track to achieve a $20 million annualized cost synergy run rate by the end of 2026 through facility consolidation and headcount reduction.

articles.titleKo: Apple의 2억 5천만 달러 AI iPhone 결제가 예상보다 빨리 다가옴 · 지급 자격이 있는 사람 알아보기 - CNET
articles.summary:
The legal machinery for class-action settlements grinds slowly, but a court order today in Apple’s $250 million case over its iPhone AI features potentially speeds things up by seven months.
People who bought one of the following devices between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, are eligible to receive a settlement payment: The iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max are included because they had the processor and memory to run Apple Intelligence features.
In an earlier statement to CNET Managing Editor David Lumb, an Apple spokesperson said, “Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features.

articles.title: HP (HPQ) Heads Into Earnings With AI PC Hopes And Valuation Questions
articles.titleEn: HP (HPQ) Heads Into Earnings With AI PC Hopes And Valuation Questions
articles.titleKo: HP(HPQ)는 AI PC에 대한 희망과 가치 평가 질문으로 수익을 향해 나아감
articles.summary:
The recent run up in HP's share price, including a 27.08% 1 month share price return and 50.41% 3 month share price return, suggests building momentum as investors position ahead of the August 26 earnings update.
HP (HPQ) heads into its August 26 fiscal third quarter earnings release with investors focused on whether AI PC demand and recent revenue trends can support margins in the face of higher component costs.
Persistent structural cost reduction initiatives, including manufacturing diversification outside China, AI-enabled automation, and a $2B annualized savings target, are set to drive sustainable improvements in net margins and bottom-line earnings resilience.

articles.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.titleEn: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.titleKo: Claude의 텍스트 워터마킹 작동 방식
articles.summary:
In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.
In the SynthID-Text paper , which introduced the technique we use, Google DeepMind tested this impact by serving a model that used watermarking to a portion of their Gemini traffic and comparing thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
In internal testing, we’ve seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude’s text.
summaryLinesEn: In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.

In the SynthID-Text paper , which introduced the technique we use, Google DeepMind tested this impact by serving a model that used watermarking to a portion of their Gemini traffic and comparing thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
In internal testing, we’ve seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude’s text.
summaryLinesKo: 이 글에서는 우리가 선택한 워터마킹 방법이 어떻게 작동하는지, 그것이 Claude의 출력에 영향을 미치는지, 그리고 이러한 변경을 하는 이유에 대해 받은 몇 가지 질문에 대한 답변을 공유함
우리가 사용하는 기술을 소개한 SynthID-Text 논문에서 Google DeepMind는 Gemini 트래픽의 일부에 워터마킹을 사용하는 모델을 제공하고 좋아요 및 싫어요 평가를 비교하여 이러한 영향을 테스트함
내부 테스트에서 워터마킹이 Claude 텍스트의 콘텐츠, 창의성 수준 또는 가독성에 미치는 영향을 확인하지 못함

articles.title: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
articles.titleEn: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
articles.titleKo: Microsoft는 별도의 Copilot 앱을 병합하면서 실패한 AI 기능을 종료함
articles.summary:
Anthropic’s Claude was used to come up with prompts, which were sent to Seedance 2.5 to create video and speech, while ByteDance’s Seedream and Google’s Nano Banana were used for image and video editing.
We’re introduced to Cal (Kiatipis), Horace (Rafiq), and Oli (Adesanya) as a trio of longtime friends who just can’t figure out how to realize their dreams of becoming well-known musicians.
Planagan has said that he doesn’t use AI tools in his writing process, and it definitely feels like Cully Hill Boys is a stronger film than Hell Grind because its core narrative was crafted by an experienced, human storyteller with an understanding of proper pacing.

articles.title: Apple is reportedly turning to publishers for help with Siri AI - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Apple is reportedly turning to publishers for help with Siri AI - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Apple이 Siri AI에 대한 도움을 위해 출판사에 눈을 돌리고 있는 것으로 알려졌습니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
In Engadget's early testing of Siri AI , the digital assistant was a major improvement over the version most consumers have access to right now, but it was hard not to feel like Apple still has a lot of catching up to do.
The Journal did not reveal the specific publishers Apple reached out to, but did note the company has proposed structuring payments around a variable compensation plan, which would see it pay those organizations when their content is used.
Siri AI is expected to be released with iOS 27 when it becomes available to the public sometime later this year.

articles.title: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It

articles.titleKo: 지방간 전염병이 있음 · AI는 앞서가는 데 도움이 될 수 있음
articles.summary:
Its unnatural presence causes inflammation, cell damage, and the formation of scar tissue known as fibrosis, all hallmarks of fatty liver disease, a condition that now impacts approximately 30 percent of adults worldwide .
“The AI could pick up cases of excess liver fat, check for other risk factors such as if the person is overweight, has high cholesterol or type 2 diabetes, and then make a recommendation to the doctor,” says Lazarus.
While the presence of fat in a normal, healthy liver is negligible, many adults and even children have livers where fat exceeds 5 percent or even 10 percent of the organ’s total weight.

articles.titleEn: 'Specialists aren't required' anymore: How to stay valuable in an AI agent workplace today
articles.titleKo: 더 이상 '전문가는 필요하지 않습니다': 오늘날 AI 에이전트 직장에서 가치를 유지하는 방법
articles.summary:
For this reason, I've deliberately taken a strategy to create 'versatilists.'" As AI completes repetitive and mundane work, Minahan said his versatilists should be comfortable applying their skills across many areas, such as discussions with business stakeholders to identify valuable digital transformation projects.
In the age of agentic AI, as suggested by Workday principal strategist Julie Colwell in a recent blog post , the rise of the polymath is associated with a shift in labor demand away from specialists who know everything about a single domain to professionals with knowledge across multiple disciplines.
"Specialists aren't required in most businesses anymore because AI leverages knowledge differently.

summaryLinesKo: 이런 이유로 저는 의도적으로 '다재다능한 사람'을 만들기 위한 전략을 세웠음" · AI가 반복적이고 일상적인 작업을 완료함에 따라 미나한은 다재다능한 사람이 가치 있는 디지털 전환 프로젝트를 식별하기 위해 비즈니스 이해관계자와 논의하는 등 여러 영역에 걸쳐 자신의 기술을 편안하게 적용할 수 있어야 한다고 말함
Workday 수석 전략가 Julie Colwell이 최근 블로그 게시물 에서 제안한 것처럼 행위자 AI 시대에 폴리매스의 부상은 노동 수요가 단일 도메인에 대한 모든 것을 아는 전문가에서 여러 분야에 걸쳐 지식을 갖춘 전문가로 이동하는 것과 관련이 있음
"AI는 지식을 다르게 활용하기 때문에 대부분의 비즈니스에는 더 이상 전문가가 필요하지 않음

articles.title: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
articles.titleEn: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
articles.titleKo: Nvidia의 새로운 5000억 달러 계획은 위험하지만 훌륭함 · 특히 노후화된 GPU의 경우 더욱 그렇음
articles.summary:
Nvidia announced this week that Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR were willing to commit up to $500 billion to build AI data centers.
The risk is that today’s AI boom, where demand far outstrips capacity, doesn’t continue for much longer.
Specifically, Nvidia is promising that if GPUs used as collateral don’t retain their value as expected, the company will cover up to 25% of the difference.

articles.summary:
Grok 4.6 costs $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.
Introduced this week, a little over a month after Grok 4.5 , Grok 4.6 focuses more on long-running agents.
As the AI pricing war ramps up, Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI is aiming to prove to enterprises that it offers the most cost-efficient model with the release of Grok 4.6.

articles.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
articles.titleEn: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
articles.titleKo: Microsoft는 별도의 Copilot 앱을 병합하면서 실패한 AI 기능을 종료함
articles.summary:
Other features may temporarily disappear during the transition, Microsoft warns, and files generated by the stand-alone Copilot app will be migrated to OneDrive.
As initially reported by GeekWire and detailed in Microsoft’s support documentation , the tech giant will combine the functionality of its consumer-facing Copilot app and the more business-oriented Microsoft 365 Copilot app.
In July, The Information reported that Microsoft EVP Jacob Andreou, who oversees Copilot, said in an internal memo that the app needed to earn “the right to exist” in its customers’ lives, which required moving on from features that didn’t work.

처음에 GeekWire에서 보고하고 Microsoft 지원 문서에 자세히 설명된 대로 이 거대 기술 기업은 소비자용 Copilot 앱과 보다 비즈니스 지향적인 Microsoft 365 Copilot 앱의 기능을 결합할 것임

articles.title: Writer says its new Palmyra X6 model cuts AI agent costs by 52% as token spending surges
articles.titleEn: Writer says its new Palmyra X6 model cuts AI agent costs by 52% as token spending surges
articles.titleKo: 작가는 토큰 지출이 급증함에 따라 새로운 Palmyra X6 모델이 AI 에이전트 비용을 52% 절감한다고 말함
articles.summary:
Inside Palmyra X6: how 626 training examples fine-tuned a 744-billion-parameter model Palmyra X6 is a 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with roughly 40 billion active parameters per token, inheriting GLM-5.2's architecture unchanged, according to Writer's technical report.
Why AI agents are blowing up enterprise budgets in ways chatbots never did Writer's announcement lands at a moment when the economics of agentic AI have moved to the center of enterprise buying decisions.
"The enterprise wants token consumption to explode — it means adoption is happening — but they need costs to flatten," said Waseem AlShikh, Writer's CTO and co-founder, in a statement.

AI 에이전트가 챗봇이 결코 수행하지 못한 방식으로 기업 예산을 폭등시키는 이유 작가의 발표는 에이전트 AI의 경제성이 기업 구매 결정의 중심으로 이동하는 순간에 이루어졌음

articles.titleKo: 아이들이 AI에 대해 어떻게 생각하는지 직접 표현해 보세요
articles.summary:
We expected some to tell us they were using it to cheat a little, the way Millennials and Gen Xers opened up CliffsNotes or programmed formulas into their TI-82s, and others to share inspiring ways they were using it.
In a survey published in February 2026 , the Pew Research Center found that 57% of teens in the US had used chatbots to search for information, 54% tapped them to help with schoolwork, and 47% had used them for fun or entertainment.
The project’s goal is to reduce the barriers to democratic participation — to make sure anyone, regardless of race, gender, income, or education level, has an easy way to get the information they need and then think critically about how they want to use it.

articles.title: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
articles.titleEn: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
articles.titleKo: ICML의 2,200개 논문을 재현하여 우리가 배운 것
articles.summary:
In total, 3,978 individual claims were confirmed with real experiments. 23% of examined papers (496) had at least one claim falsified or contested.
Participants received $20 in Hugging Face compute credits to run experiments on HF Jobs ; across the challenge, participants launched 2,962 cloud jobs.
ICML 2026 received 23,918 submissions and accepted 6,352 papers , roughly double the previous year, continuing an exponential trend that is at least partly driven by AI agents making it faster to run experiments and write them up.

summaryLinesKo: 실제 실험을 통해 총 3,978건의 개별 주장이 확인됨 · 조사된 논문 중 23%(496개)에는 적어도 하나의 주장이 위조되거나 이의가 제기됨
참가자들은 HF Jobs에 대한 실험을 실행하기 위해 Hugging Face 컴퓨팅 크레딧으로 20달러를 받았음 · 챌린지 전반에 걸쳐 참가자들은 2,962개의 클라우드 일자리를 시작함
ICML 2026은 23,918개의 제출물을 접수하고 6,352개의 논문을 승인했는데, 이는 전년도의 약 두 배에 달하는 수치이며, 적어도 부분적으로는 AI 에이전트에 의해 실험 실행 및 작성 속도가 빨라지는 기하급수적인 추세를 이어가고 있음

articles.titleEn: Android Nears Half of POS Shipments in a Market That Grew Just 1% in 2025
articles.titleKo: Android는 2025년에 1%만 성장한 시장에서 POS 출하량의 절반에 가까워졌음
articles.summary:
Global POS device shipments grew just 1% in 2025, while rising memory prices are increasing the bill of materials for the Android terminals the industry is standardizing on.
The POS industry is shifting from proprietary operating systems to Android, enabling cloud-connected, software-defined solutions and expanding business management features for merchants.
Global POS device shipments grew just 1% YoY in 2025, held back by rising memory prices and broader macroeconomic pressure.

POS 업계는 독점 운영 체제에서 Android로 전환하여 클라우드 연결, 소프트웨어 정의 솔루션을 구현하고 판매자를 위한 비즈니스 관리 기능을 확장하고 있음

articles.titleKo: WRITER, 기업용 생성 AI 제공을 위해 시리즈 B에서 1억 달러 모금
articles.summary:
I’m excited to announce that WRITER has raised $100 million in Series B funding!
Here are just a few examples of how customers create, analyze, and govern with WRITER to achieve significant business impact: 6sense increased their writing output by 50% and achieves 100% brand compliance on written content.
“We believe that generative AI usage within enterprises is hitting an inflection point, and WRITER stands out to us as a leader in providing a full stack and secure platform to deliver on AI’s incredible promise.”
summaryLinesEn: I’m excited to announce that WRITER has raised $100 million in Series B funding!

Here are just a few examples of how customers create, analyze, and govern with WRITER to achieve significant business impact: 6sense increased their writing output by 50% and achieves 100% brand compliance on written content.

“We believe that generative AI usage within enterprises is hitting an inflection point, and WRITER stands out to us as a leader in providing a full stack and secure platform to deliver on AI’s incredible promise.”
summaryLinesKo: WRITER가 시리즈 B 자금으로 1억 달러를 모금했다는 소식을 발표하게 되어 기쁨
다음은 고객이 WRITER를 사용하여 상당한 비즈니스 효과를 달성하기 위해 생성, 분석 및 관리하는 방법에 대한 몇 가지 예임 · 6sense는 글쓰기 출력을 50% 증가시키고 서면 콘텐츠에 대해 100% 브랜드 준수를 달성함
"우리는 기업 내에서 생성적 AI 사용이 변곡점에 도달했다고 믿고 있으며, WRITER는 AI의 놀라운 약속을 이행하기 위한 풀 스택 및 보안 플랫폼을 제공하는 리더로서 우리에게 두각을 나타내고 있음"

articles.title: New at WRITER: Agentic work that scales without blowing the budget
articles.titleEn: New at WRITER: Agentic work that scales without blowing the budget
articles.titleKo: WRITER의 새로운 기능 · 예산을 초과하지 않고 확장되는 에이전트 작업
articles.summary:
At the same time, enterprises are losing control of AI spend, burning through annual AI budgets in a matter of months and spending up to $500 million a month on uncapped AI.
The shift is from piloting agents to running them in production, across thousands of employees, with spend governed and aligned to ROI instead of left uncapped.
It’s engineered for the work most teams run every day: the high-volume personalization, research, and content work where marketing and sales teams need to scale without the bill running away.

변화는 에이전트를 시범적으로 운영하는 것에서 수천 명의 직원을 대상으로 프로덕션 환경에서 실행하는 것임 · 지출은 제한 없이 두는 대신 ROI에 맞게 관리되고 조정됨

articles.title: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
articles.titleEn: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
articles.titleKo: Strands Agents, LeRobot 및 Hugging Face Storage Buckets를 사용하여 한 곳에서 기록, 훈련 및 배포
articles.summary:
To record on a physical SO-101, LeRobot's record CLI handles the leader-follower bring-up: The dataset lands on disk in the same format as the simulation recording, so the same sync call takes it to a bucket: sync_dataset_to_bucket("./recordings", "my-org/robot-fave", run_id="run-021") (or the hf sync ./recordings hf://buckets/my-org/robot-fave/run-021 CLI it wraps).
The first post in this series introduced Strands Robots , an open source SDK from AWS ( Apache 2.0 ) that exposes robot abstractions, simulation, and the LeRobot stack as AgentTools you compose into a single Strands agent.
Each of those decisions comes up dozens of times over a collection campaign, and each one needs a look at what came back before the next command goes out.

이 시리즈의 첫 번째 게시물에서는 단일 Strands 에이전트로 구성하는 AgentTools로 로봇 추상화, 시뮬레이션 및 LeRobot 스택을 노출하는 AWS(Apache 2.0)의 오픈 소스 SDK인 Strands Robots를 소개함

articles.title: Defense in depth in the age of agents
articles.titleEn: Defense in depth in the age of agents
articles.titleKo: 에이전트 시대의 심층방어
articles.summary:
Supervisors catch nuance that fixed rules can’t, but as agents themselves they share some of the limitations they’re built to detect.
Other threats involve bad content that should never appear in a conversation, regardless of who introduced it.
The basic idea of defense in depth — that you need layers — is the same, but agents change what those layers do.

articles.title: Google's Tensor G6 in Pixel 11 isn't a 2nm smartphone chip after all
articles.titleEn: Google's Tensor G6 in Pixel 11 isn't a 2nm smartphone chip after all
articles.titleKo: Pixel 11의 Google Tensor G6은 결국 2nm 스마트폰 칩이 아님
articles.summary:
Pixel 11 moves the NFC antenna to the top of the phone for easier payments, Tap to Share I can’t unsee the reason Pixel 11 Pro Fold is thinner, but it’s for the best [Gallery] Pixel 11 Pro displays are ‘more than twice’ as scratch-resistant – it only gets better from there Follow Ben: Twitter/X , Threads , Bluesky , and Instagram Update: Corrected headline – Tensor G6 was never the first 2nm smartphone chip, but the first using TSMC’s 2nm process.
Google’s new Tensor G6 chip isn’t without upgrades, though, with the company touting: Upgraded CPU with “25% faster web browsing, 15% quicker app launches” Upgraded Image Signal Processor powering faster Night Sight, further digital zoom TSMC’s 2nm process would have likely delivered efficiency upgrades for the most part, which has been rumored to be among Google’s key focus for this generation of chip.
It was rumored that Google’s new Tensor G6, debuting in the Pixel 11, would be the first smartphone chip using TSMC’s 2nm process, but it turns out that won’t be the case.

articles.titleEn: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability | Amazon Web Services
articles.titleKo: AgentCore Observability로 온프레미스 및 멀티 클라우드 AI 에이전트 모니터링 | 아마존 웹 서비스
articles.summary:
In this post, we show you how to set up observability for agents running outside AWS.
Although Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, provides native tracing, monitoring, and analytics that local cloud monitoring tools don’t offer out of the box, it natively supports only agents deployed on AgentCore runtime in the AWS Cloud.
This allows you to detect hallucinations, monitor for harmful or off-topic responses, track token usage for cost governance, and audit agent behavior across environments.
summaryLinesEn: In this post, we show you how to set up observability for agents running outside AWS.

Although Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, provides native tracing, monitoring, and analytics that local cloud monitoring tools don’t offer out of the box, it natively supports only agents deployed on AgentCore runtime in the AWS Cloud.
This allows you to detect hallucinations, monitor for harmful or off-topic responses, track token usage for cost governance, and audit agent behavior across environments.
summaryLinesKo: 이 게시물에서는 AWS 외부에서 실행되는 에이전트에 대한 관찰 가능성을 설정하는 방법을 보여줌
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore의 기능인 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability는 로컬 클라우드 모니터링 도구가 기본적으로 제공하지 않는 기본 추적, 모니터링 및 분석을 제공하지만 기본적으로 AWS 클라우드의 AgentCore 런타임에 배포된 에이전트만 지원함
이를 통해 환각을 감지하고, 유해하거나 주제에서 벗어난 응답을 모니터링하고, 비용 거버넌스를 위한 토큰 사용을 추적하고, 환경 전반에 걸쳐 에이전트 동작을 감사할 수 있음

articles.title: Researchers can now reverse-engineer LLM prompts from output text with near-perfect accuracy
articles.titleEn: Researchers can now reverse-engineer LLM prompts from output text with near-perfect accuracy
articles.titleKo: 연구원은 이제 출력 텍스트에서 거의 완벽한 정확도로 LLM 프롬프트를 리버스 엔지니어링할 수 있음
articles.summary:
Attackers don't even need to know which model produced the text An inverse model trained on the small Qwen-3-0.6B chatbot was also able to reconstruct prompts from GPT-4o's responses.
Researchers at IIT Bombay and Adobe Research have developed a method that can reconstruct prompts fed to large language models with near-perfect accuracy, using only the text output.
A new paper from researchers at IIT Bombay and Adobe Research shows it can be done with surprising accuracy.

summaryLinesKo: 공격자는 어떤 모델이 텍스트를 생성했는지 알 필요조차 없음 · 작은 Qwen-3-0.6B 챗봇에 대해 훈련된 역모델은 GPT-4o의 응답에서 프롬프트를 재구성할 수도 있었음
IIT Bombay와 Adobe Research의 연구원들은 텍스트 출력만을 사용하여 거의 완벽에 가까운 정확도로 대규모 언어 모델에 제공되는 프롬프트를 재구성할 수 있는 방법을 개발함
IIT Bombay와 Adobe Research의 연구원들이 발표한 새로운 논문에서는 놀라운 정확도로 이 작업을 수행할 수 있음을 보여줌

articles.title: Agentic AI infrastructure shifts enterprise focus from model choice to platform control
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI infrastructure shifts enterprise focus from model choice to platform control
articles.titleKo: Agentic AI 인프라는 기업의 초점을 모델 선택에서 플랫폼 제어로 전환함
articles.summary:
As projects like Pacing the Frontier look to major labs as a way to keep AI research safe, open source models have become a sore spot for the industry .
“But my worry is because of all the lobbying in the U.S. and the fear-mongering, building open source AI in America is struggling to compete with open-weight models coming out of China, and my worry is that if China figures out a fundamentally more cost-efficient way to build AI, then things that are more cost-efficient have a fundamental business adoption advantage.”
If China’s open-weight models gained widespread adoption across Asia, Africa, and/or the developing world, he warned, they could influence how billions of people encountered ideas about democracy, freedom, and human rights.
summaryLinesEn: As projects like Pacing the Frontier look to major labs as a way to keep AI research safe, open source models have become a sore spot for the industry .

“But my worry is because of all the lobbying in the U.S. and the fear-mongering, building open source AI in America is struggling to compete with open-weight models coming out of China, and my worry is that if China figures out a fundamentally more cost-efficient way to build AI, then things that are more cost-efficient have a fundamental business adoption advantage.”

If China’s open-weight models gained widespread adoption across Asia, Africa, and/or the developing world, he warned, they could influence how billions of people encountered ideas about democracy, freedom, and human rights.
summaryLinesKo: Pacing the Frontier와 같은 프로젝트가 AI 연구를 안전하게 유지하는 방법으로 주요 연구실을 고려함에 따라 오픈 소스 모델은 업계에서 골칫거리가 됨
"그러나 제가 걱정하는 것은 미국의 모든 로비와 두려움을 조장하는 것임 · 미국에서 오픈 소스 AI를 구축하는 것은 중국에서 나오는 개방형 모델과 경쟁하기 위해 고군분투하고 있음 · 그리고 중국이 AI를 구축하는 근본적으로 더 비용 효율적인 방법을 찾아낸다면, 더 비용 효율적인 것이 근본적인 비즈니스 채택 이점을 갖게 된다는 것임"
그는 중국의 개방형 모델이 아시아, 아프리카 및/또는 개발도상국 전역에 널리 채택된다면 수십억 명의 사람들이 민주주의, 자유, 인권에 대한 아이디어를 접하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 수 있다고 경고함

articles.titleEn: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic's new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
articles.titleKo: 일부 Claude 사용자는 Anthropic의 새로운 워터마크가 직장, 수업에서 이를 사용하는 것을 포착할 것이라는 사실에 화를 냈음
articles.summary:
Visionode’s basic argument appears to be that, while savvy Claude users may be able hide evidence of their AI usage by paraphrasing or otherwise cleaning their outputs through other AI services, the average user of Claude will be caught.
Anthropic rolled out this new policy to satisfy the EU AI Act’s Transparency Code , which now requires tech companies to label content that has been AI-generated or edited in a manner identifiable to computer systems.
Another unhappy camper called the watermarks “unethical” and “disgusting” and argued that by using Claude, they had done the lion’s share of the work.

articles.title: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
articles.titleEn: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
articles.titleKo: 이제 Twitch 스트리머는 Amazon AI 교육을 거부할 수 있음
articles.summary:
Turning this off does not opt you out of Twitch and Amazon using your channel content for other purposes described in the Twitch Privacy Notice, including using AI-supported Twitch features that benefit the community by facilitating streamer growth and monetization (such as real-time sponsorship campaign assistance), viewer discovery (such as recommendations), and community safety (such as AutoMod).
Opting out means that “your streams, VODs, clips, stream chats, and pictures and text on your channel” won’t be used in “future training” of an Amazon AI model “whose purpose is to generate or synthesize text, audio, images, or video,” according to a Twitch support page .
Follow Follow See All Tech Flip the new Twitch toggle if you don’t want your content to be used to train Amazon’s generative AI content models.

articles.title: Again acquires Geno to advance biomanufacturing at scale with AI design
articles.titleEn: Again acquires Geno to advance biomanufacturing at scale with AI design
articles.summary:
Geno’s platform works for mass-scale industrial replacement and could prevent 85 million tons of carbon emissions annually; Again’s captures processes up to 1 ton of emissions per day.
Not only will this lower overall emissions and environmental stress — making regulators and people with lungs happier — but it will also recycle what was originally waste into more efficient revenue streams.
This includes its entire patent portfolio, which includes data spanning experimental results, structural and scale-up insights and developmental outcomes.

articles.title: SPONSORED: Sovereign AI overcomes compliance challenges and feeds innovation in public sector and other regulated industries, say HPE and NVIDIA
articles.titleEn: SPONSORED: Sovereign AI overcomes compliance challenges and feeds innovation in public sector and other regulated industries, say HPE and NVIDIA
articles.titleKo: 후원 · HPE와 NVIDIA에 따르면 Sovereign AI는 규정 준수 문제를 극복하고 공공 부문 및 기타 규제 산업에 혁신을 제공함
articles.summary:
Pienaar and Shirhatti sit on the frontline of this shift in AI development.
The HPE Sovereign AI Factory lets customers in highly-regulated industries keep sensitive data, models, and operations under strict local control, using customized, validated infrastructure integrated with HPE services from deployment to operational support that helps customers with security, compliance, and control across infrastructure, data, and AI models.
But new mandates governing AI deployments also require them to act as careful custodians of their data, along with the infrastructure, supply chain, software and other aspects of their IT landscape.

articles.title: Skan AI raises $63M to give AI agents a map of enterprise work
articles.titleEn: Skan AI raises $63M to give AI agents a map of enterprise work
articles.titleKo: Skan AI는 AI 에이전트에게 엔터프라이즈 작업 지도를 제공하기 위해 6,300만 달러를 모금함
articles.summary:
In one deployment at a large U.S. bank, Skan AI tracked 11.2 million context switches across 1,500 finance staff and surfaced $37 million in operational friction.
Chief Technology and Digital Officer Cijo Joseph credited Skan AI with giving Mitie “unprecedented operational visibility” that accelerated its AI rollout.
Agents built on those observations cut cost per transaction 32% and lifted throughput 41%, worth $18 million in annualized savings, according to the company.

articles.summary:
Nebius’ revenue surged 454% year-over-year in the second quarter, to $582.3 million.
In June, Nebius launched an AI agent that automates tasks such as provisioning virtual machines.
Much of the growth was driven by large customers: Nebius disclosed that it signed four data center deals with an average value of more than $1 billion.

summaryLinesKo: Nebius의 2분기 매출은 전년 동기 대비 454% 급증한 5억 8,230만 달러를 기록함
지난 6월 Nebius는 가상 머신 프로비저닝과 같은 작업을 자동화하는 AI 에이전트를 출시함
성장의 대부분은 대규모 고객에 의해 주도됨 · Nebius는 평균 가치가 10억 달러가 넘는 4개의 데이터 센터 계약을 체결했다고 밝힘

articles.title: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
articles.titleEn: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
articles.titleKo: 수화 AI를 사용자의 손에 넣
articles.summary:
Yet this technological revolution has not reached the world’s more than 200 sign languages — and the estimated 70 million Deaf and hard of hearing people who use them.
We co-authored a joint impact report for the release of SL2T 1.0 in Gboard and Live Transcribe, transparently detailing the technology's capabilities and current limitations — a collaborative approach we plan to continue for all major sign language releases.
Similarly to how hearing users can use dictation to speak instead of typing, this feature enables Deaf users to sign to their phone anywhere they’d normally type.
summaryLinesEn: Yet this technological revolution has not reached the world’s more than 200 sign languages — and the estimated 70 million Deaf and hard of hearing people who use them.

We co-authored a joint impact report for the release of SL2T 1.0 in Gboard and Live Transcribe, transparently detailing the technology's capabilities and current limitations — a collaborative approach we plan to continue for all major sign language releases.
Similarly to how hearing users can use dictation to speak instead of typing, this feature enables Deaf users to sign to their phone anywhere they’d normally type.
summaryLinesKo: 그러나 이 기술 혁명은 전 세계 200개 이상의 수화와 이를 사용하는 약 7천만 명의 청각 장애인에게 도달하지 못함
우리는 Gboard 및 Live Transcribe의 SL2T 1.0 출시에 대한 공동 영향 보고서를 공동 작성하여 기술의 기능과 현재 제한 사항을 투명하게 자세히 설명함 · 이는 모든 주요 수화 릴리스에 대해 계속해서 협력할 계획임
청각 사용자가 입력하는 대신 받아쓰기를 사용하여 말할 수 있는 것과 유사하게, 이 기능을 사용하면 청각 장애인 사용자가 일반적으로 입력하는 어느 곳에서나 모바일에 로그인할 수 있음

articles.title: AT&T Expands Video Intelligence Portfolio with EdgeVis Cloud
articles.titleEn: AT&T Expands Video Intelligence Portfolio with EdgeVis Cloud
articles.titleKo: AT&T, EdgeVis Cloud로 비디오 인텔리전스 포트폴리오 확장
articles.summary:
From the first phone call 150 years ago to our 5G wireless and multi-gig internet offerings today, we @ATT innovate to improve lives.
EdgeVis Cloud supports growing demand for video-enabled operations across enterprise, mid-market, large SMB, and public sector organizations as they increasingly rely on video for safety, security, and near real-time situational awareness.
AT&T Business today introduced AT&T Video Intelligence with EdgeVis Cloud, a new managed cloud deployment option designed to help organizations scale and manage live video monitoring across a wide range of operating environments while reducing deployment complexity and infrastructure requirements.
summaryLinesEn: From the first phone call 150 years ago to our 5G wireless and multi-gig internet offerings today, we @ATT innovate to improve lives.

EdgeVis Cloud supports growing demand for video-enabled operations across enterprise, mid-market, large SMB, and public sector organizations as they increasingly rely on video for safety, security, and near real-time situational awareness.

AT&T Business today introduced AT&T Video Intelligence with EdgeVis Cloud, a new managed cloud deployment option designed to help organizations scale and manage live video monitoring across a wide range of operating environments while reducing deployment complexity and infrastructure requirements.
summaryLinesKo: 150년 전 최초의 전화 통화부터 오늘날의 5G 무선 및 멀티 기가비트 인터넷 서비스에 이르기까지, @ATT는 삶의 질을 개선하기 위해 혁신을 이루고 있음
EdgeVis Cloud는 안전, 보안 및 거의 실시간 상황 인식을 위해 비디오에 점점 더 의존하고 있는 기업, 중간 규모 시장, 대규모 SMB 및 공공 부문 조직 전반에서 비디오 지원 운영에 대한 수요 증가를 지원함
AT&T Business는 오늘 조직이 배포 복잡성과 인프라 요구 사항을 줄이면서 광범위한 운영 환경에서 실시간 비디오 모니터링을 확장 및 관리할 수 있도록 설계된 새로운 관리형 클라우드 배포 옵션인 EdgeVis Cloud가 포함된 AT&T Video Intelligence를 출시함

articles.title: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
articles.titleKo: NVIDIA AI 팩토리 컴퓨팅은 투자 가능한 자산 클래스가 되고 있음
articles.summary:
Blackwell capacity commands a premium, with reported B200 cloud rates spanning approximately $5.30 to $7.05 per GPU-hour.
We have moved from an era in which companies bought chips and built data centers project by project to one in which AI factories can be financed as productive infrastructure — with repeatable platforms, long-term institutional capital and a diverse customer base that uses compute to create revenue.
We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.
summaryLinesEn: Blackwell capacity commands a premium, with reported B200 cloud rates spanning approximately $5.30 to $7.05 per GPU-hour.

We have moved from an era in which companies bought chips and built data centers project by project to one in which AI factories can be financed as productive infrastructure — with repeatable platforms, long-term institutional capital and a diverse customer base that uses compute to create revenue.

We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.
summaryLinesKo: Blackwell 용량은 GPU 시간당 약 5.30~7.05달러에 달하는 보고된 B200 클라우드 요금으로 프리미엄을 요구함
우리는 기업이 칩을 구입하고 프로젝트별로 데이터 센터를 구축하던 시대에서 반복 가능한 플랫폼, 장기 기관 자본 및 컴퓨팅을 사용하여 수익을 창출하는 다양한 고객 기반을 갖춘 생산적인 인프라로 AI 공장에 자금을 조달할 수 있는 시대로 전환함
우리는 Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs 및 KKR과의 파트너십을 발표하여 시간이 지남에 따라 AI 인프라 구축을 지원하기 위해 5,000억 달러 이상의 제3자 자본을 동원하도록 설계된 독립적인 금융 플랫폼을 구축함

articles.title: China Smartphone Market Saw Sharper Contraction After 618
articles.titleEn: China Smartphone Market Saw Sharper Contraction After 618
articles.titleKo: 중국 스마트폰 시장, 618년 이후 더욱 위축
articles.summary:
China’s smartphone sales declined 8.6% YoY in the first 30 weeks of 2026 amid persistently weak demand, according to Counterpoint Research’s China Weekly Smartphone Sell-Out Tracker .
In addition, OPPO’s three brands are undergoing consolidation across regions, product positioning, after-sales services and software systems, with short-term challenges expected during the transition.
China’s smartphone sales declined 8.6% YoY in the first 30 weeks of 2026, with the decline returning to double digits after the 618 shopping festival amid seasonal weakness and continued memory cost inflation.

China’s smartphone sales declined 8.6% YoY in the first 30 weeks of 2026, with the decline returning to double digits after the 618 shopping festival amid seasonal weakness and continued memory cost inflation.
summaryLinesKo: 카운터포인트리서치(Counterpoint Research)의 중국 주간 스마트폰 매도 추적기에 따르면, 지속적인 수요 약세로 인해 2026년 첫 30주 동안 중국의 스마트폰 판매량은 전년 대비 8.6% 감소함
또한 OPPO의 세 브랜드는 지역, 제품 포지셔닝, 애프터 서비스 및 소프트웨어 시스템 전반에 걸쳐 통합을 진행하고 있으며 전환 중에 단기적인 어려움이 예상됨

articles.title: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
articles.titleKo: NVIDIA CEO, Glassdoor의 2026년 최고의 CEO 목록에서 1위를 차지
articles.summary:
This award recognizes CEOs “who are leading with empathy, clarity and purpose” at a time when workers are navigating increased uncertainty in the job market, according to Glassdoor, which analyzes employee ratings and reviews to identify the leaders who have earned the highest levels of employee approval and trust.
“As AI and shifting expectations redefine the modern workplace, exceptional leadership has never been more vital,” Glassdoor noted.
Glassdoor reintroduced the Best CEOs list this year after a hiatus of five years, replacing the Best-Led Companies list, which ranked NVIDIA at No. 1 in 2025, in a shift to sharpen the focus on CEO and executive leadership and its impact on employee experience and company reputation.

articles.titleKo: Mobile Infrastructure Corporation 2026년 2분기 실적 요약
articles.summary:
Reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance, projecting 8% same-location revenue growth and 10% same-location NOI growth based on current momentum.
Achieved 12% same-location NOI growth by prioritizing volume over rate, allowing pricing power to naturally follow as assets reach stabilized occupancy levels.
Portfolio utilization on a trailing 12-month basis was 70%, representing the highest average utilization since 2021., the highest level since the company took control in 2021, driven by broad-based demand across transient and monthly segments.

articles.title: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
articles.titleEn: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
articles.titleKo: 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터로 AI 에이전트 확장
articles.summary:
But many organizations find that realizing the desired return on investment (ROI) from AI hinges on having the right foundation, with inadequate infrastructure and data being major blockers .
To make decisions and act in real time, agents also need frictionless access to the organization’s operational systems—for example, those storing its supply chain, point-of-sale, or human resources data.
The shift from answering questions to taking actions means AI agents need data from across the enterprise, in all its structured and unstructured forms, and with the right business context.

실시간으로 결정을 내리고 행동하려면 상담원이 조직의 운영 시스템(예 · 공급망, POS 또는 인적 자원 데이터를 저장하는 시스템)에 원활하게 액세스해야 함

articles.titleKo: Agentic AI 가격이 좋아지고 있나요 · 앞으로 나올 내용
articles.summary:
However, given the volatility of pricing and the increased number of reports of surprise billing, better tooling is not enough.
The first issue is a lack of usable adoption metrics, though there are multiple factors that suggest headway can be made: forward-deployed engineering initiatives, reduced roadmap churn, credits- and action-based pricing, and better cost controls should provide the right signals to improve the current state.
You also need staff who have a deep understanding of how agent costing works and what guardrails need to be in place to mitigate risk and encourage the right adoption patterns.

The app has more than 100 million active users on iOS, and Google said power users on macOS prompt about twice as often as users on other surfaces.

articles.title: A New Trick Reveals AI Models’ Inner Thoughts
articles.titleEn: A New Trick Reveals AI Models’ Inner Thoughts
articles.titleKo: AI 모델의 내면을 드러내는 새로운 트릭
articles.summary:
“All major frontier model providers we tested share this vulnerability,” says Alexander Panfilov,⁩ a computer scientist at University of Tübingen in Germany who was involved with the work.
The findings provide some evidence—although not conclusive proof—that certain Chinese models may have been trained by “ distilling ” reasoning information from US models that was supposedly hidden because of how closely some of their thinking or reasoning patterns seem to match.
Lately, however, distillation has become a controversial topic, because of claims that Chinese AI companies use it to essentially copy the best US models.

articles.title: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
articles.titleEn: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
articles.titleKo: AI는 죽었음 · 유기체는 살아있음
articles.summary:
Muotri’s organoids contain 5 million cells, of which 2.5 million are neurons.
It’s about as significant a paradigm shift as I can imagine for computing: No matter how badly you mess up your code, things on the computer don’t normally die in real life .
Each is the size of an elongated toaster and boasts an onboard life-support system capable of keeping a culture of up to a million neurons alive for six months.

articles.summary:
(Participants in the Wordcraft Writers Workshop declined to tell Engadget how much they were compensated for the study; Google has not responded to a request for comment.)
An internal study was launched to determine whether AI could serve as a brainstorming assistant, researcher or writing collaborator for professional writers.
Flashpoints like this one are indicative of AI's impact on the arts, and while it may seem unfair to retroactively hold these 13 authors to rapidly-evolving moral standards, some of the chastised participants in the Wordcraft study have arrived at the same conclusion as Lachance regardless.

articles.title: Spotify will label 'AI Persona' profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
articles.titleEn: Spotify will label 'AI Persona' profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
articles.titleKo: Spotify는 'AI Persona' 프로필에 라벨을 지정하고 추천에서 해당 음악을 제외함
articles.summary:
Like others in the music industry, Spotify is attempting to balance innovations driven by AI, like its own AI-powered Prompted Playlists , AI DJ , and chat , and forthcoming AI remixes, while still managing to thwart the deluge of AI-generated slop — low-quality content that AI has made it easier to mass-produce.
Spotify will begin labeling AI-generated artists with “AI Persona” profile tags and ban their music from its editorial and algorithmic recommendations, the company announced on Tuesday.
By default, Spotify won’t include AI Personas in its editorial or algorithmic recommendations, nor will it add AI Personas’ music to users’ personalized recommendations — unless they happen to follow an AI Persona.

articles.summary:
OpenAI has been sitting on a text detector with 99.9 percent accuracy for about two years and still hasn't released it.

articles.titleKo: 인공지능이 수학을 장악하기 시작함
articles.summary:
Kun, a researcher at the Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics in Hungary, told The Verge OpenAI reached out to him by email shortly before publishing to share its findings.
He had just returned from a four-week AI and mathematics research conference in South Korea, where he said many felt there had been something of a “phase transition” over the past six months, with AI producing genuine and meaningful advances.
OpenAI estimates that generating Astra’s 10 solutions would have cost around $2,000 in tokens at the current API prices for its Sol model.

articles.title: Why software factories are back - and how they work in the age of AI
articles.titleEn: Why software factories are back - and how they work in the age of AI
articles.titleKo: 소프트웨어 공장이 다시 돌아온 이유와 AI 시대에 소프트웨어 공장이 어떻게 작동하는지
articles.summary:
"Over the past 18 months or so, many of the companies that are on the cutting edge of using agents to automate their software development life cycle have been building the same machine, and independently coming to the same conclusion on what this machine looks like," according to Jaymin West, a forward-deployed engineer and technology evangelist, in a recent YouTube video .
"Developer craftsmanship is not going away, as devs and engineers shift from writing code to exercising judgment around what gets built and shipped."
Of course, software factories, no matter how efficient, are not a panacea for good software practices.

articles.title: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
articles.titleEn: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
articles.titleKo: 연구원들이 ChatGPT의 숨은 추론에서 찾아낸 '하지만 매리네이드'와 비밀번호 유출
articles.summary:
A scan of roughly 7,000 public traces turned up 62 API keys, 33 email addresses, 33 passwords, and other sensitive data.
The concept has been well studied: In their thought processes, models explicitly consider cheating but (possibly) decide against it because they expect to get caught.
A memorization analysis showed that specific Claude and GPT reasoning segments are up to six orders of magnitude easier to extract from Kimi-K3 than from the next closest model.

articles.summary:
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard enables intelligent model routing, allowing Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be deployed alongside other models for optimal task allocation, and the open release includes permissive licensing, weights, data, and recipes for extensive customization and broad ecosystem support.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.

NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard enables intelligent model routing, allowing Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be deployed alongside other models for optimal task allocation, and the open release includes permissive licensing, weights, data, and recipes for extensive customization and broad ecosystem support.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.
summaryLinesKo: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 강력한 인텔리전스와 유사한 크기의 모델의 최대 4배 빠른 출력 속도를 결합하여 대용량 에이전트 워크로드를 위한 정확도 속도 Pareto 최전선에 배치함
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard는 지능형 모델 라우팅을 지원하여 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning을 다른 모델과 함께 배치하여 최적의 작업 할당을 수행할 수 있도록 하며, 공개 릴리스에는 광범위한 사용자 정의 및 폭넓은 생태계 지원을 위한 허용 라이센스, 가중치, 데이터 및 레시피가 포함되어 있음
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 30B 매개변수, 3B 활성 매개변수를 갖춘 개방형 MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) 모델로, 특히 상시 가동되는 AI 에이전트 및 에이전트 워크플로우에서 대용량, 짧은 지연 시간 실행에 최적화되어 있음

sourceLines: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.

articles.title: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
articles.titleEn: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
articles.titleKo: AI 모델, 사이클론 예측에 획기적인 성과 달성
articles.summary:
Tropical cyclones — also known as hurricanes or typhoons — are among the most destructive weather phenomena on Earth, responsible for more than 700,000 deaths and $1.4 trillion in economic losses globally over the past 50 years.
You can explore our latest cyclone forecasts on Weather Lab , which we recently refreshed with a new interface and expanded to include global weather forecasts alongside cyclone tracks.
By making this technology openly available, we hope to empower the research community and amplify AI's impact in building more resilient communities – whether that be providing local forecasters with the tools they need to prepare for natural disasters , supporting the growth of renewable energy, or anticipating extreme weather.

articles.title: Mapping the AI economy
articles.titleEn: Mapping the AI economy
articles.summary:
As the revenue infrastructure provider for thousands of AI companies, including 88% of the 2026 Forbes AI 50, Stripe data offers a unique view of the AI economy.
The fastest-growing AI companies on Stripe already use 2x more local payment methods on average than the broader cohort, and previous analyses have shown that surfacing relevant local payment methods can have a significant impact on conversion (up 7.4% on average) and revenue (up 12% on average).
As AI companies reach the ceiling of global expansion (there are only so many countries in the world), sustaining growth will require laying roots in the places they’ve launched.

articles.summary:
As the local companion to Qwen3.8-Max, the 27-billion-parameter open model is sized for a single GPU and built for responsive coding workflows with local files, tools and project context.
#ICYMI: New Open Models and More Available Today, Accelerated by NVIDIA GPUs NVIDIA recently released Cosmos 3 Edge , a 4-billion-parameter open world model for robotics, autonomous vehicles and vision AI.
With day-zero support in ComfyUI, it generates up to 26x faster on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell and 22x faster on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 compared to Apple M3 Ultra.

On DeepSeek-V3.2 the story flips: the stronger model absorbs ACE's full playbook well enough to edge us on Medium, but we lead Easy, Hard, and Overall — with more capacity to spare, more lessons (delivered our way) keep helping instead of crowding each other out.
Two recent systems do exactly this, on the same kind of agent: ACE (Agentic Context Engineering) and our ALTK-Evolve ( introduced here ).
Every distinct guideline keeps a support count — how many independent episodes produced it — and we never summarize the store down to a handful of rules.

articles.title: Teaching agents to navigate janky IVR systems
articles.titleEn: Teaching agents to navigate janky IVR systems
articles.titleKo: 버벅거리는 IVR 시스템을 탐색하는 방법을 상담원에게 교육
articles.summary:
Agents built on Sierra can now navigate the most challenging IVR systems out of the box: they understand when to call, how to get through a multi-level menu, when to stay silent, and how to recognize when they’ve reached a person.
Or an auto insurance company needs to call a repair shop to get the status and estimated cost of a customer’s repair.
With IVR navigation skills out of the box, an agent’s success rates increase by almost 50% to 85% — and this capability is already being used by a number of our customers.

articles.title: Why Scaling AI Compute Performance Requires a New Power Architecture
articles.titleEn: Why Scaling AI Compute Performance Requires a New Power Architecture
articles.titleKo: AI 컴퓨팅 성능을 확장하려면 새로운 전력 아키텍처가 필요한 이유
articles.summary:
NVIDIA, Google and Microsoft have been developing the 800 VDC architecture together through the Open Compute Project (OCP), and published a joint white paper March 2026 and the LVDC Solid-State Transformer Specification v0.3 July 2026.
NVIDIA DSX reference designs are built to guide AI factories through the transition from today’s AC infrastructure through hybrid architectures and into fully native 800 VDC facilities.
Every new generation of accelerated computing demands more from the infrastructure underneath it — more compute performance, higher rack density and more efficient, scalable power distribution.

summaryLinesKo: NVIDIA, Google, Microsoft는 OCP(Open Compute Project)를 통해 함께 800VDC 아키텍처를 개발해 왔으며, 2026년 3월 공동 백서를 발표하고 2026년 7월 LVDC Solid-State Transformer 사양 v0.3을 발표함
NVIDIA DSX 레퍼런스 디자인은 오늘날의 AC 인프라에서 하이브리드 아키텍처를 거쳐 완전한 기본 800VDC 시설로 전환하는 과정에서 AI 공장을 안내하기 위해 제작됨
새로운 세대의 가속화된 컴퓨팅은 그 기반이 되는 인프라에서 더 많은 것을 요구함 · 즉, 더 높은 컴퓨팅 성능, 더 높은 랙 밀도, 더 효율적이고 확장 가능한 전력 분배가 필요함

articles.title: China's Humanoid Robot Lead Is Misleading. Here's Why

articles.titleKo: 중국의 휴머노이드 로봇 리더는 오해의 소지가 있음 · 이유는 다음과 같음
articles.summary:
Global humanoid robot shipments jumped 272% year-over-year in the first half of 2026, reaching 19,100 units, according to a new report from Smart Analytics Global.
"Global humanoid robot shipments nearly quadrupled in 1H 2026, but an equally important shift is taking place in how these robots are being deployed," said Linda Sui, founder and principal at Smart Analytics Global, in the report.
Scaling too late is a massive risk too: competitors may eat up the market before you get there.

In April 2026, a Cloud Security Alliance survey found that 65% of respondents had experienced an AI-agent-related incident in the prior year, while 82% had discovered previously unknown agents operating in their environments.

Before an agent receives access to enterprise tools, it needs a machine-enforceable record of exactly what authority the business has chosen to delegate.

articles.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
articles.titleEn: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
articles.titleKo: Meta의 새로운 Glimmer AI 모델은 Zuckerberg의 개인 지능 비전에 대한 힌트를 제공함
articles.summary:
Zuckerberg went on to list the ways Meta’s superintelligence can improve a person’s life, from providing a capable personal agent that “will work 24/7 on your behalf to improve your relationships, health, career, finances, home management, hobbies, and more” to giving people access to tools needed to create a new business or advance scientific progress.
Meta imagines Glimmer being used for things like managing schedules, drafting messages, and organizing files — tasks that would require large amounts of access to personal data.
Meta on Monday released Muse Glimmer , an open-weight model designed to power AI agents locally on consumer hardware, providing the clearest picture yet of what CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s vision of “personal superintelligence” could look like in practice.

summaryLinesKo: Zuckerberg는 계속해서 Meta의 초지능이 개인의 삶을 향상시킬 수 있는 방법을 나열함 · "당신을 대신하여 연중무휴 24시간 일하여 관계, 건강, 경력, 재정, 가정 관리, 취미 등을 개선하는" 능력 있는 개인 에이전트를 제공하는 것부터 사람들에게 새로운 비즈니스를 창출하거나 과학적 진보를 진전시키는 데 필요한 도구에 대한 액세스를 제공하는 것까지 포함됨
Meta는 Glimmer가 일정 관리, 메시지 초안 작성, 파일 정리와 같은 작업(개인 데이터에 대한 대량 액세스가 필요한 작업)에 사용될 것이라고 상상함
Meta는 월요일 소비자 하드웨어에서 로컬로 AI 에이전트를 구동하도록 설계된 개방형 모델인 Muse Glimmer를 출시하여 CEO Mark Zuckerberg의 "개인 초지능" 비전이 실제로 어떤 모습일 수 있는지에 대한 가장 명확한 그림을 제공함

articles.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
articles.titleEn: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
articles.titleKo: Discovered Materials는 더 멋진 칩을 찾기 위해 AI 두더지 잡기 게임을 하고 있음
articles.summary:
The startup said it recently closed a $9 million seed round from Lightspeed India Partners after emerging from from Y Combinator, with investment from Peak XV Partners and angel investors Paul Graham, Gokul Rajaram, and Thariq Shihipar.
Companies like MatNex, SandboxAQ, and CuspAI have all launched similar efforts, but Discovered Materials is betting that a laser-focus on the thermal problems of semiconductor materials is the path to success.
Discovered Materials is the latest, with plans to use swarms of AI agents to find new materials that can be used to build more efficient integrated circuits.

MatNex, SandboxAQ 및 CuspAI와 같은 회사는 모두 비슷한 노력을 시작했지만 Discovered Materials는 반도체 재료의 열 문제에 레이저 초점을 맞추는 것이 성공의 길이라고 확신함

articles.title: AI for science needs reasoning, not just data
articles.titleEn: AI for science needs reasoning, not just data
articles.titleKo: 과학을 위한 AI에는 단순한 데이터가 아닌 추론이 필요함
articles.summary:
The creation of the Protein Data Bank was not simple: It took 53 years of international scientific cooperation and, by a recent estimate , roughly $21 billion worth of experimental work to assemble.
Instead, the shift toward agentic AI represents a much rarer tier of breakthrough: a tool that envelops every field of science at once.
An agent that can read a thousand papers in an hour, design 500 molecules, and learn from its failed tests by morning will bring down the cost of experimentation and fundamentally change the pace at which science gets done.

Instead, the shift toward agentic AI represents a much rarer tier of breakthrough: a tool that envelops every field of science at once.

An agent that can read a thousand papers in an hour, design 500 molecules, and learn from its failed tests by morning will bring down the cost of experimentation and fundamentally change the pace at which science gets done.
summaryLinesKo: Protein Data Bank의 창설은 간단하지 않음 · 국제 과학 협력에 53년이 걸렸으며, 최근 추산에 따르면 약 210억 달러 상당의 실험 작업이 소요됨
대신, 에이전트 AI로의 전환은 훨씬 더 희귀한 혁신 단계, 즉 모든 과학 분야를 동시에 포괄하는 도구를 나타냄
한 시간에 천 권의 논문을 읽고, 500개의 분자를 설계하고, 아침까지 실패한 테스트로부터 학습할 수 있는 에이전트는 실험 비용을 낮추고 과학 수행 속도를 근본적으로 변화시킬 것임

articles.title: Hidden text in a PDF is enough to steal sensitive data through Atlassian's AI agent Rovo
articles.titleEn: Hidden text in a PDF is enough to steal sensitive data through Atlassian's AI agent Rovo
articles.titleKo: PDF에 숨겨진 텍스트는 Atlassian의 AI 에이전트 Rovo를 통해 민감한 데이터를 훔치기에 충분함
articles.summary:
Despite follow-up messages on June 4 and July 29, Atlassian didn't respond.

The attack requires nothing more than a document with hidden instructions in white text.
