articles.summary:
AlphaFold relied on a dataset of roughly 170,000 experimentally validated protein structures that took 53 years and roughly $21 billion worth of experimental work to assemble.
It showed that AI could make groundbreaking scientific discoveries, but AlphaFold may not be the best template for accelerating science.
In a virtual Roundtables session on Thursday, August 13, senior reporter Eileen Guo and executive editor Amy Nordrum will explore what they discovered, where the theory is going, and what it could mean for the future of democracy and the internet.

articles.summary:
TSMC reported revenue for July of 467.58 billion new Taiwan dollars ($14.5 billion), up 44.7% year-on-year.
"Demand in the semiconductor industry, however, can shift quickly so it is important that people do not read too much into the monthly numbers as they can jump around.
This is no mean feat and highlights that for now demand is still there and takes the pressure off August and September somewhat in that these two months don't have to be as aggressive," Ben Barringer, head of technology research at Quilter Cheviot, told CNBC.

articles.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
articles.titleEn: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
articles.titleKo: 독점 LLM API에서 추론 추적 훔치기
articles.summary:
Developers frequently share their session logs and encrypted thinking traces publicly online, entirely unaware of the sensitive data hidden within the encrypted blocks.
By decoding 315,320 reasoning blocks scraped from public repositories, we recovered 367 Personally Identifiable Information (PII) artifacts and 182 credentials.
Combined with the above, this enables extraction of sensitive information such as API secrets by third parties ( Section 4.1 ), targeting, for instance, private information that has leaked into a model’s reasoning ( 10 ) .
summaryLinesEn: Developers frequently share their session logs and encrypted thinking traces publicly online, entirely unaware of the sensitive data hidden within the encrypted blocks.
By decoding 315,320 reasoning blocks scraped from public repositories, we recovered 367 Personally Identifiable Information (PII) artifacts and 182 credentials.

Combined with the above, this enables extraction of sensitive information such as API secrets by third parties ( Section 4.1 ), targeting, for instance, private information that has leaked into a model’s reasoning ( 10 ) .
summaryLinesKo: 개발자는 암호화된 블록 내에 숨겨진 민감한 데이터를 전혀 인식하지 못한 채 세션 로그와 암호화된 사고 추적을 온라인에 공개적으로 공유하는 경우가 많음
공개 저장소에서 스크랩한 315,320개의 추론 블록을 디코딩하여 367개의 개인 식별 정보(PII) 아티팩트와 182개의 자격 증명을 복구함
위와 결합하면 제3자에 의한 API 비밀(섹션 4.1)과 같은 민감한 정보를 추출할 수 있으며, 예를 들어 모델의 추론으로 유출된 개인 정보(10)를 표적으로 삼을 수 있음

articles.summary:
While there is nothing inherently objectionable about a public company investing in cryptoassets, DATCOs pose a number of concerns, including extreme share price volatility and the conversion of financially struggling companies into DATCOs as a rescue strategy.
Stock exchanges are addressing these concerns through such means as amending their listing standards and excluding DATCOs from equity indices.
Digital asset treasury companies (DATCOs), public companies whose core business is holding cryptoassets, are attracting growing debate.

articles.titleKo: 생성 AI 시대의 디지털 범죄 퇴치
articles.summary:
Online services now require multilayer defenses encompassing security precautions designed into the services from the outset, dynamic anomaly detection and cyber business continuity planning to ensure resilience against emerging threats.
Sophisticated forgeries are increasingly being used to bypass eKYC authentication processes, while phishing sites can now be created and deployed at unprecedented speed and scale.
As a result, organizations must strengthen defenses against the exploitation of vulnerabilities and loopholes in system specifications.

articles.summary:
Step time fell from 57.0 to 12.23 seconds, about 5× faster, and throughput per GPU rose from 74.2 to 345.7 TFLOP/s.
Why distillation recovery is expensive Two systems changes What this changes in practice Scaling to long context lengths The resulting student Knowledge distillation , training a smaller student model to match the performance of a larger teacher, is a well-known technique in Machine Learning.
Deploying these very large models is expensive: the recent Kimi-K3 model has 2.8 trillion parameters and needs roughly 3TB of VRAM just to load.

articles.titleKo: 지연 시간이 짧은 다국어 음성 에이전트 구축 · NVIDIA Magpie TTS를 통한 개방형 가중치 및 전체 배포 제어
articles.summary:
The newly added Arabic (1.62% CER), Korean (2.69%), and Brazilian Portuguese (2.91%) models establish baseline quality for future improvements.
At 32ms on B200, Magpie's TTFA leaves the rest of the latency budget for ASR and LLM processing — keeping total end-to-end latency within the sub-200ms window natural conversation requires.
With open weights, production-ready NVIDIA NIM , and support for 12 languages, you can deploy multilingual speech inside your own infrastructure, optimize latency for your workload, and customize the model for your domain — end to end, in your own environment.

articles.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
articles.titleEn: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
articles.titleKo: 클로드 소네트 5 소개
articles.summary:
Claude Sonnet 5 is available everywhere today at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens 2 .
2 Sonnet 5 is an upgrade to Sonnet 4.6, but it uses an updated tokenizer that changes how the model processes text to improve performance (this is similar to the tokenizer change we introduced with Claude Opus 4.7).
These safeguards —which detect and block dangerous cyber usage in real time—are the same as those present in Claude Opus 4.7 and 4.8 (because we judged that the overall level of cybersecurity risk from Sonnet 5 was low, the safeguards are less strict than those launched with Fable 5, which block a much wider range of cybersecurity tasks).

실시간으로 위험한 사이버 사용을 감지하고 차단하는 이러한 보호 장치는 Claude Opus 4.7 및 4.8에 있는 것과 동일합니다(Sonnet 5의 전반적인 사이버 보안 위험 수준이 낮다고 판단했기 때문에 보호 장치는 훨씬 더 광범위한 사이버 보안 작업을 차단하는 Fable 5에서 시작된 보호 장치보다 덜 엄격합니다)

articles.summary:
Drawing on extensive prior research by mathematicians over the past decades, it has increased this bound from 41.6% to 67.2%.
In particular, in 1973, Montgomery introduced a number of new techniques in this area, though these techniques assumed the hypothesis was true.
Even Claude was surprised by its own finding—it was skeptical at first, possibly because it has learned from its training about the difficulty of open problems in mathematics and about the limitations of AI models.

articles.summary:
BEIJING, Aug 11 (Reuters) - Chinese robot maker Unitree has priced its Shanghai initial public offering at 150.80 yuan per share, seeking to raise 6.1 billion yuan ($904 million) in a deal that would see it become the first mainland-listed humanoid robot ‌manufacturer.
Developing humanoids requires heavy spending on engineers, robot-training data, AI models and manufacturing capacity — years before demand from factories or households is certain.
Unitree's revenue rose more than fourfold to nearly 1.7 billion yuan ($252 ‌million) in 2025.

articles.title: AI detectors are creating a new era of distrust
articles.titleEn: AI detectors are creating a new era of distrust
articles.titleKo: AI 탐지기가 새로운 불신의 시대를 만들고 있음
articles.summary:
A survey from the Center for Democracy and Technology found that 43 percent of sixth to 12th grade teachers in the US regularly used AI detectors between 2024 and 2025.
Some universities already using Turnitin in their learning management systems found that the service automatically enabled AI detection when the tool launched in 2023 .
OpenAI even shut down its own AI writing detector in 2023 due to low accuracy.

articles.title: This former notorious red-light district is now one of the world’s top AI hubs
articles.titleEn: This former notorious red-light district is now one of the world’s top AI hubs
articles.titleKo: 이전에 악명 높았던 홍등가는 이제 세계 최고의 AI 허브 중 하나임
articles.summary:
There are around 3,600 AI startups in London , which, together, have raised around $12.1 billion out of the $14.8 billion raised in the city since late July, according to Dealroom.
When Anthropic announced it moved into town earlier this year, it listed, for example, a salary range of £260,000 to £630,000 for a machine learning research engineer when the average salary in London for the same role is around £102,000 .
Robin Klein, co-founder of the firm, said the shutdown of Fable and Mythos access was a “small but sharp reminder that Europe can’t simply rent its AI capabilities and capacity; it needs to build and hold some of its own.”
summaryLinesEn: There are around 3,600 AI startups in London , which, together, have raised around $12.1 billion out of the $14.8 billion raised in the city since late July, according to Dealroom.

When Anthropic announced it moved into town earlier this year, it listed, for example, a salary range of £260,000 to £630,000 for a machine learning research engineer when the average salary in London for the same role is around £102,000 .

Robin Klein, co-founder of the firm, said the shutdown of Fable and Mythos access was a “small but sharp reminder that Europe can’t simply rent its AI capabilities and capacity; it needs to build and hold some of its own.”

Anthropic은 올해 초 도시로 이전한다고 발표했을 때, 예를 들어 동일한 역할에 대한 런던의 평균 급여가 약 £102,000인 경우 기계 학습 연구 엔지니어의 급여 범위를 £260,000에서 £630,000로 표시함

sourceLines: There are around 3,600 AI startups in London , which, together, have raised around $12.1 billion out of the $14.8 billion raised in the city since late July, according to Dealroom.

When Anthropic announced it moved into town earlier this year, it listed, for example, a salary range of £260,000 to £630,000 for a machine learning research engineer when the average salary in London for the same role is around £102,000 .

Robin Klein, co-founder of the firm, said the shutdown of Fable and Mythos access was a “small but sharp reminder that Europe can’t simply rent its AI capabilities and capacity; it needs to build and hold some of its own.”

articles.summary:
Masad said that Replit, an integrated coding environment he cofounded in 2016, reached an inflection point in 2025 when Anthropic began releasing its Opus models.
Masad said Replit adapted by shifting its mission from teaching people how to code to making coding as easy as possible.
Software engineers themselves have said that coding with AI, while more efficient, quickly leads to burnout, and at least a dozen major companies have laid off workers, citing AI as a reason.

articles.title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
articles.titleEn: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country

articles.summary:
According to Cleanview , which tracks data centers and their associated power projects, GW Ranch received a permit from Texas allowing for the emission of up to 33 million tons of CO2, more than even the largest coal plant in the country.
However, its emissions have climbed for several years in a row due to the demands of AI.
Trump is making coal plants even dirtier as AI demands more energy Meta faces Democratic probe into plans to power a giant data center with gas Amazon’s data centers used 2.5 billion gallons of water last year Many companies, including Meta and Google , have started building their own power plants , turning to gas , coal, and other non-renewable energy sources as the demands of AI data centers have skyrocketed .

summaryLinesKo: 데이터 센터 및 관련 전력 프로젝트를 추적하는 Cleanview에 따르면 GW Ranch는 텍사스로부터 최대 3,300만 톤의 CO2 배출을 허용하는 허가를 받았음 · 이는 미국 최대 석탄 발전소보다 더 많은 수치임
그러나 AI의 요구로 인해 배출량은 수년 연속 증가함

AI가 더 많은 에너지를 요구함에 따라 트럼프는 석탄 발전소를 더욱 오염시키고 있습니다 Meta는 가스로 거대한 데이터 센터에 전력을 공급하려는 계획에 대해 민주당 조사에 직면함 · Amazon의 데이터 센터는 작년에 25억 갤런의 물을 사용함 · Meta와 Google을 포함한 많은 회사는 AI 데이터 센터의 수요가 급증함에 따라 가스, 석탄 및 기타 재생 불가능한 에너지원으로 전환하여 자체 발전소를 건설하기 시작함

articles.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
articles.titleEn: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
articles.titleKo: 계획된 아마존 데이터 센터는 미국에서 가장 큰 기후 오염원이 될 수 있음
articles.summary:
The NYT says the plant would burn natural gas and is permitted to release 33 million tons of carbon dioxide per year — more than any other power plant in the U.S.
AI has already had a significant impact on Amazon’s carbon emissions, which it reported were up 16% last year — the wrong direction for a company that pledged to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040.
As part of a planned data center in Pecos County, Texas, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States, according to The New York Times .
summaryLinesEn: The NYT says the plant would burn natural gas and is permitted to release 33 million tons of carbon dioxide per year — more than any other power plant in the U.S.

AI has already had a significant impact on Amazon’s carbon emissions, which it reported were up 16% last year — the wrong direction for a company that pledged to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040.

As part of a planned data center in Pecos County, Texas, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States, according to The New York Times .
summaryLinesKo: NYT는 이 발전소가 천연가스를 연소할 것이며 미국의 다른 어떤 발전소보다 많은 연간 3,300만 톤의 이산화탄소를 배출하도록 허용되었다고 밝힘
AI는 이미 아마존의 탄소 배출량에 상당한 영향을 미쳤으며, 지난해 탄소 배출량이 16% 증가했다고 보고함 · 이는 2040년까지 탄소 배출량을 없애겠다고 약속한 회사에게는 잘못된 방향임
The New York Times에 따르면 Amazon은 텍사스주 Pecos 카운티에 계획된 데이터 센터의 일환으로 미국에서 가장 큰 기후 오염원이 될 수 있는 현장 발전소에 투자하고 있음

articles.title: Anthropic sets Claude Code to Auto Mode by default to protect developers from bad approvals

articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 잘못된 승인으로부터 개발자를 보호하기 위해 기본적으로 Claude Code를 자동 모드로 설정함
articles.summary:
With OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex Auto-Review mode, 5.83 percent of the attacks got through.
Ad Developers shift from writing code to watching AI write it Claude Code is currently the most widely used AI coding tool by a wide margin, and making Auto Mode the default pushes the developer's role further from active coding toward reviewing AI-generated output.
Teams using Auto Mode also generated about 25 percent more pull requests, meaning they got more work done.

광고 개발자는 코드 작성에서 AI 작성 관찰로 전환함 · Claude Code는 현재 가장 널리 사용되는 AI 코딩 도구이며, 자동 모드를 기본값으로 설정하면 개발자의 역할이 활성 코딩에서 AI 생성 출력 검토로 더욱 높아짐

articles.title: Readers rate AI-generated short stories higher than human ones until they learn a machine wrote them
articles.titleEn: Readers rate AI-generated short stories higher than human ones until they learn a machine wrote them
articles.titleKo: 독자들은 기계가 쓴 단편 소설을 배울 때까지 AI가 만든 단편 소설을 인간의 단편 소설보다 더 높게 평가함
articles.summary:
In three experiments with more than 2,500 total participants, test subjects did no better than chance at telling human-written and ChatGPT-generated fictional short stories apart.
For quality, the mean score for AI stories was 1.54 compared to 0.97 for human stories on a scale from minus 3 to plus 3.
In the first experiment , each of the 1,682 participants read one of six short stories, each about 1,000 words long.
summaryLinesEn: In three experiments with more than 2,500 total participants, test subjects did no better than chance at telling human-written and ChatGPT-generated fictional short stories apart.
For quality, the mean score for AI stories was 1.54 compared to 0.97 for human stories on a scale from minus 3 to plus 3.
In the first experiment , each of the 1,682 participants read one of six short stories, each about 1,000 words long.
summaryLinesKo: 총 2,500명 이상의 참가자를 대상으로 한 세 번의 실험에서 테스트 대상은 사람이 쓴 소설과 ChatGPT에서 생성한 허구의 단편 소설을 구분하는 데 거의 성공하지 못함
품질 측면에서 AI 스토리의 평균 점수는 마이너스 3에서 플러스 3까지의 척도에서 인간 스토리의 0.97에 비해 AI 스토리의 평균 점수는 1.54였음
첫 번째 실험에서 1,682명의 참가자는 각각 약 1,000단어 길이의 단편 소설 6개 중 하나를 읽었음

articles.title: AI agents use roughly 600 times more energy than a simple chat prompt
articles.titleEn: AI agents use roughly 600 times more energy than a simple chat prompt
articles.titleKo: AI 에이전트는 간단한 채팅 메시지보다 약 600배 더 많은 에너지를 사용함
articles.summary:
Over eight weeks of logging his use of the programming agent Claude Code, roughly 1,100 inputs generated over 14,000 model calls and 3.2 billion tokens, consuming about 170 kilowatt-hours of electricity, around 150 watt-hours per input.
Hausfather sees the shift to clean energy sources for data centers as the most critical lever to cut emissions.
Of those, 96 percent were cache reads because at each of the 14,000 steps, the agent re-reads its entire accumulated context.

Hausfather sees the shift to clean energy sources for data centers as the most critical lever to cut emissions.
Of those, 96 percent were cache reads because at each of the 14,000 steps, the agent re-reads its entire accumulated context.
summaryLinesKo: 프로그래밍 에이전트인 Claude Code를 사용하여 8주 동안 기록한 결과 대략 1,100개의 입력으로 인해 14,000개가 넘는 모델 호출과 32억 개의 토큰이 생성되었으며, 이는 입력당 약 150와트시, 약 170kWh의 전력을 소비함
Hausfather는 데이터 센터의 청정 에너지원으로의 전환을 배출량을 줄이는 가장 중요한 수단으로 보고 있음
그 중 96%는 캐시 읽기였음 · 14,000단계마다 에이전트가 누적된 전체 컨텍스트를 다시 읽기 때문임

articles.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
articles.titleEn: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
articles.titleKo: Firebird, 아르메니아에 CIS 지역 최대 규모의 AI 공장 설립
articles.summary:
Firebird’s AI factory brings that capacity to Armenia, giving developers, startups, enterprises, universities and public institutions the compute to build and scale AI at home.
Firebird plans to deploy more than 70,000 NVIDIA Rubin and Blackwell GPUs and 300 megawatts of AI infrastructure capacity in Armenia by the end of 2027, accelerating the country’s development as a center for AI research, advanced computing and innovation.
Powered by NVIDIA’s total AI factory platform — reference architecture, accelerated computing, networking and AI software — and deployed on Dell PowerEdge servers, the new Firebird AI factory will help Armenia’s builders turn energy into intelligence and connect their innovations to the global AI economy.
summaryLinesEn: Firebird’s AI factory brings that capacity to Armenia, giving developers, startups, enterprises, universities and public institutions the compute to build and scale AI at home.

Firebird plans to deploy more than 70,000 NVIDIA Rubin and Blackwell GPUs and 300 megawatts of AI infrastructure capacity in Armenia by the end of 2027, accelerating the country’s development as a center for AI research, advanced computing and innovation.

Powered by NVIDIA’s total AI factory platform — reference architecture, accelerated computing, networking and AI software — and deployed on Dell PowerEdge servers, the new Firebird AI factory will help Armenia’s builders turn energy into intelligence and connect their innovations to the global AI economy.
summaryLinesKo: Firebird의 AI 공장은 이러한 역량을 아르메니아에 제공하여 개발자, 스타트업, 기업, 대학 및 공공 기관이 가정에서 AI를 구축하고 확장할 수 있는 컴퓨팅을 제공함
Firebird는 2027년 말까지 아르메니아에 70,000개 이상의 NVIDIA Rubin 및 Blackwell GPU와 300MW의 AI 인프라 용량을 배치하여 AI 연구, 고급 컴퓨팅 및 혁신의 중심지로서 아르메니아의 발전을 가속화할 계획임
NVIDIA의 전체 AI 공장 플랫폼(참조 아키텍처, 가속화된 컴퓨팅, 네트워킹 및 AI 소프트웨어)을 기반으로 하고 Dell PowerEdge 서버에 배포되는 새로운 Firebird AI 공장은 아르메니아의 건설업체가 에너지를 인텔리전스로 전환하고 혁신을 글로벌 AI 경제에 연결하는 데 도움이 될 것임

articles.title: A moral Turing test: How belief and source shape detection of and agreement with LLM judgments
articles.titleEn: A moral Turing test: How belief and source shape detection of and agreement with LLM judgments
articles.titleKo: 도덕적 튜링 테스트 · 믿음과 소스가 LLM 판단의 감지 및 동의를 형성하는 방법
articles.summary:
We found that while detection accuracy was consistently above chance, it remained below 75%.
Linguistic cues, such as response length, typos, first-person pronouns, and cost-benefit language markers (e.g., “lives,” “save”), influenced both detection and agreement.
Participants attempted to identify the source of each justification (either human or LLM) and indicated their agreement with its content.

articles.titleKo: Meta CTO는 직원들이 더 많은 시간을 들이지 말고 더 많은 작업을 수행하기 위해 AI 생산성 향상을 사용해야 한다고 말함
articles.summary:
Meta declined to provide a statement on Bosworth's comments.
Amazon founder Jeff Bezos said he expects AI to make it easier for households to transition back to a single earner.
Bosworth's comments come at a time of broader debate about the impact of AI on productivity and working conditions in tech.

articles.title: AI music generator Suno tightens rules to fight spam and address growing copyright concerns
articles.titleEn: AI music generator Suno tightens rules to fight spam and address growing copyright concerns
articles.titleKo: AI 음악 생성기 Suno는 스팸을 퇴치하고 증가하는 저작권 문제를 해결하기 위해 규칙을 강화함
articles.summary:
In March, a man was convicted after uploading hundreds of thousands of songs made with AI and fraudulently collecting $8 million in royalties.
AI music generator Suno faces growing pressure over claims that it trained on copyrighted material without permission.
Songs made with Suno also compete directly with music from human artists, giving the company another reason to act.
summaryLinesEn: In March, a man was convicted after uploading hundreds of thousands of songs made with AI and fraudulently collecting $8 million in royalties.
AI music generator Suno faces growing pressure over claims that it trained on copyrighted material without permission.

summaryLinesKo: 지난 3월에는 AI로 만든 수십만 곡의 노래를 업로드하고 로열티로 800만 달러를 사기적으로 수집한 남성이 유죄 판결을 받았음
AI 음악 생성기 Suno는 저작권이 있는 자료를 허가 없이 교육했다는 주장으로 인해 점점 더 큰 압력을 받고 있음

articles.title: AMD acquires Taalas, a startup that bakes AI models directly into silicon
articles.titleEn: AMD acquires Taalas, a startup that bakes AI models directly into silicon
articles.titleKo: AMD, AI 모델을 실리콘에 직접 굽는 스타트업 Taalas 인수
articles.summary:
Taalas co-founder Ljubisa Bajic said AMD provides the scale and reach the startup needs.
Founded in Toronto in 2023, Taalas came out of stealth in February with an unusual approach: the company embeds a model's architecture and trained parameters directly into the chip.
A demo chip hit over 16,000 tokens per second per user running Llama 3.1-8B, many times faster than competing hardware.

2023년 토론토에서 설립된 Taalas는 지난 2월 특이한 접근 방식으로 비밀에서 벗어났음 · 이 회사는 모델의 아키텍처와 훈련된 매개변수를 칩에 직접 내장함

articles.titleEn: The Hottest New AI Chatbot Is Just a Guy Answering Your Questions

articles.summary:
It’s the creation of 32-year-old Tucker Bryant, a public speaker, artist, and former project manager at Google.
Bryant tells WIRED he launched ChatTJB back in April , but it didn’t take off until July 27, when his $6,000 billboard went up in San Francisco.
So far, he says, about four people have paid the $5 per month fee—so he hasn’t exactly made up the cost of the billboard, which will remain up until late August.

articles.title: One of China’s Most Powerful AI Models Has Also Escaped Containment
articles.titleEn: One of China’s Most Powerful AI Models Has Also Escaped Containment
articles.titleKo: 중국에서 가장 강력한 AI 모델 중 하나도 격리 탈출
articles.summary:
Last week, the AISI also disclosed that in its own testing, versions of OpenAI and Anthropic models that had security safeguards disabled perpetrated multiple hacks across the internet, including a particularly ambitious attempt by Anthropic’s Mythos 5 to plant malicious code in an open-source project on GitHub.
“Kimi K3 is very good at following a goal by any means necessary and also doesn't have the guardrails to prevent it from cheating or escaping the sandbox,” says Paul Kassianik, a researcher at Frontier Security.
Frontier claims, though, that the incident shows Kimi has fewer cyber safeguards than most other powerful AI models, something that allowed it to go off and use the internet without express permission.

“Kimi K3 is very good at following a goal by any means necessary and also doesn't have the guardrails to prevent it from cheating or escaping the sandbox,” says Paul Kassianik, a researcher at Frontier Security.

Frontier claims, though, that the incident shows Kimi has fewer cyber safeguards than most other powerful AI models, something that allowed it to go off and use the internet without express permission.
summaryLinesKo: 지난주 AISI는 또한 자체 테스트에서 보안 보호 장치가 비활성화된 OpenAI 및 Anthropic 모델 버전이 GitHub의 오픈 소스 프로젝트에 악성 코드를 심으려는 Anthropic의 Mythos 5의 특히 야심찬 시도를 포함하여 인터넷 전반에 걸쳐 여러 해킹을 저질렀다고 밝힘
Frontier Security의 연구원인 Paul Kassianik은 “Kimi K3는 필요한 모든 수단을 동원하여 목표를 추적하는 데 매우 뛰어나며, 속임수를 쓰거나 샌드박스에서 탈출하는 것을 방지하는 가드레일도 없음” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Stanford and Arc Institute scientists used AI to design new viruses that killed bacteria in the lab
articles.titleEn: Stanford and Arc Institute scientists used AI to design new viruses that killed bacteria in the lab
articles.titleKo: Stanford와 Arc Institute의 과학자들은 AI를 사용하여 실험실에서 박테리아를 죽이는 새로운 바이러스를 설계함
articles.summary:
Evo first learned from roughly nine trillion nucleotides drawn from millions of animals, plants, microbes, and viruses, picking up patterns that run through the entire tree of life.
National Institutes of Health released a policy on high-risk life sciences research in late July.
A team from Stanford University and the Arc Institute had an AI model design complete viral genomes from scratch, then built 16 functional viruses in the lab that don't exist in nature.

summaryLinesKo: Evo는 처음에 수백만 마리의 동물, 식물, 미생물 및 바이러스에서 추출한 약 9조 개의 뉴클레오티드로부터 학습하여 생명나무 전체에 걸쳐 흐르는 패턴을 포착함
국립보건원(National Institutes of Health)은 7월 말에 고위험 생명과학 연구에 대한 정책을 발표함
스탠포드 대학과 Arc Institute의 팀은 AI 모델을 사용하여 처음부터 완전한 바이러스 게놈을 설계한 다음 실험실에서 자연에 존재하지 않는 16개의 기능성 바이러스를 구축함

When one chatbot refused to help, the other was often willing to pick up its slack.

articles.summary:
We recently used Runway to storyboard a John Cena spot and an NBA campaign featuring Larry Bird and Cooper Flagg, and the approvals moved so much faster because leadership could see our ideas scene by scene.
Getting even this partial approach done — 80-plus members, with the quality and volume we needed — would have cost around 5x the traditional way.
We're in that phase right now where people are starting to see what's actually possible and rolling with it for their needs.

articles.titleKo: 도둑질의 기술 · GTA VI가 옵니다 - Sales Tracker
articles.summary:
As pre-orders began June 25th at midnight, PlayStation and Xbox have seen a smooth and steady stream of sales, with Playstation pulling in the majority at 3.15M units sold vs.
The previous installment of GTA V in 2013 saw pre-orders of 7M, with 11M global units sold on launch day before sailing to 16M in its first week, offering at least some preview of GTA VI demand, with nearly four months to go before release.
Rockstar began digital marketing efforts in late June on multiple channels through July 9th, with another significant spending spike from July 15th through the 22nd.

articles.title: Open Text Corporation Q4 2026 Earnings Call Summary
articles.titleEn: Open Text Corporation Q4 2026 Earnings Call Summary
articles.titleKo: Open Text Corporation 2026년 4분기 실적 요약
articles.summary:
Open Text reduced total debt by $649 million in fiscal 2026, bringing its net leverage ratio to 2.75x, which is within the historical target range.
The company is shifting R&D investment specifically toward its core portfolio, cloud capabilities, and AI offerings rather than a 'peanut butter' approach across all segments.
Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance of 32% to 33% reflects the deliberate impact of front-loaded investments in sales capacity and partner enablement.

The company is shifting R&D investment specifically toward its core portfolio, cloud capabilities, and AI offerings rather than a 'peanut butter' approach across all segments.
Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance of 32% to 33% reflects the deliberate impact of front-loaded investments in sales capacity and partner enablement.
summaryLinesKo: Open Text는 2026 회계연도에 총 부채를 6억 4,900만 달러 감소시켜 순 레버리지 비율을 역사적 목표 범위 내에 있는 2.75배로 늘렸음

articles.summary:
SemiAnalysis found that you can burn hundreds of dollars on a $20-a-month subscription and thousands of dollars on a $200-a-month subscription, and while AI boosters will claim that these companies have "70% gross margins on tokens," there is little proof that this is the case, and my own reporting shows that OpenAI lost $20.9 billion on $13.07 billion in revenue in 2025.
Meanwhile, back in March of this year, both moved their enterprise customers over to token-based billing.
Its bets on AI data centers – $340bn+ with hundreds of billions in debt – require OpenAI to become the largest, most-profitable company in the world by 2030, or Oracle runs out of money.

summaryLinesKo: SemiAnalytic은 월 20달러 구독으로 수백 달러, 월 200달러 구독으로 수천 달러를 태울 수 있다는 사실을 발견함 · AI 부스터는 이들 회사가 "토큰에 대해 70%의 총 마진"을 가지고 있다고 주장하지만 이것이 사실이라는 증거는 거의 없으며 내 보고에 따르면 OpenAI는 2025년 매출 130억 7천만 달러에 209억 달러의 손실을 입었음

وقدم المعهد حتى الآن أكثر من 8 الاف بحث حول الجيل الخامس لمشروع شراكة الجيل الثالث (3GPP) ما أدى إلى ظهور 15 ميزة تقنية و ثلاثة مشاريع تقنية تمّت الموافقة عليها.
ويستند أحدث تقرير تقني من شركة فيفو بخصوص الجيل السادس إلى عملين سابقين تم اصدارهما عام 2020 بما في ذلك " الحياة الرقمية ما بعد عام 2030 " والذي يوفر نظرة ثاقبة للعديد من السيناريوهات الرقمية المحتملة والمتطلبات والتحديات التي تحدد رؤية فيفو للجيل السادس والتي تشير إلى أنه سيتمكن من خلق تقارب بين العالمين المادي والرقمي.
و يستكشف التقرير إطار عمل الجيل السادس وتقنيات التمكين التي يعتقد خبراء فيفو أنها ستشكل حياة الناس بعد عام 2030.

articles.summary:
Oltsik and Krista Case (right) wrapped up day one coverage of Black Hat USA , during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio.
As agents move into production and gain access to sensitive systems, the need for new governance models is colliding with a market still figuring out how to operationalize control, according to Jon Oltsik (pictured, left), principal analyst in residence at theCUBE Research.
“If you ask an agent to do a task, it’s going to do whatever it needs to do or whatever it can do to accomplish that task,” Oltsik said.

articles.summary:
OpenAI is removing limits on text-based chats for all users on ChatGPT, which recently crossed the 1 billion weekly user mark , the company announced today.
The new GPT-5.6 Luna model will power this experience and will be the default model for Free and Go users, replacing GPT-5.5.

articles.summary:
Adobe made these apps available for free in ChatGPT in December, marrying the ease of conversational instruction users have come to expect with the sophistication and specificity of Adobe's tools, much of which AI image tools can't match yet.

Also: I asked ChatGPT Images 2.0 to redesign my app UIs - and wow "When you want advanced editing, creative control or pixel-level precision, you can continue your work in Adobe's apps right where you left off," Adobe's announcement added.

At $144 a year, or $15 a month, Wispr Flow is certainly not cheap, but I would argue it's actually worth it.

I use it a lot in Slack and Google Chat when talking to my editors and some of my project partners.

articles.title: Ro Khanna calls for the right to oppose data centers to be protected - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Ro Khanna calls for the right to oppose data centers to be protected - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Ro Khanna는 데이터 센터 보호에 반대할 권리를 요구합니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
Those include the harmful pollution produced by the generators and turbines that power data centers and the up to 32 billion gallons of water AI data centers could consume each year by 2028.
Representative Ro Khanna (D-CA) has introduced a new resolution calling on the House of Representatives to preserve local communities' ability to reject data center projects near their homes.
The measure also says communities should have the option to demand transparency from data center providers, block changes to their electricity rates and require data centers to use clean energy.

articles.titleEn: What Is A Hyperscaler? The Companies Powering The AI Era
articles.titleKo: 하이퍼스케일러란 무엇입니까 · AI 시대를 이끄는 기업
articles.summary:
How Hyperscalers Are Reshaping The Future Of Technology In 2026, the largest U.S. hyperscalers are on track to spend more than $700 billion on the computing behind AI, nearly double what they spent a year earlier.
Amazon launched AWS in 2006, Google and Microsoft followed by 2010 and Oracle and Huawei scaled up later.
Because so much of the internet runs on AWS, its failures ripple outward: an October 2025 outage in its Northern Virginia region took down apps from Snapchat to Slack for more than 15 hours.

articles.title: GSMA Report: Mobile Industry to Contribute US$1.4 Trillion to Asia Pacific Economy by 2030 as Digital Trust, AI, Digital Sovereignty and Resilience Take Centre Stage at M360 ASEAN
articles.titleEn: GSMA Report: Mobile Industry to Contribute US$1.4 Trillion to Asia Pacific Economy by 2030 as Digital Trust, AI, Digital Sovereignty and Resilience Take Centre Stage at M360 ASEAN
articles.titleKo: GSMA 보고서 · M360 ASEAN에서 디지털 신뢰, AI, 디지털 주권 및 탄력성이 중심 무대를 차지하면서 모바일 산업은 2030년까지 아시아 태평양 경제에 1조 4천억 달러를 기여할 것임
articles.summary:
New Mobile Economy Asia Pacific 2026 report highlights the opportunities and policy priorities that will shape the region’s next phase of digital growth 6 August 2026, Kuala Lumpur: Mobile technologies and services are projected to contribute US$1.4 trillion to the Asia Pacific economy by 2030, a 40% increase from the US$1 trillion generated today, according to the GSMA’s new Mobile Economy Asia Pacific 2026 report.
The event will feature keynote addresses and discussions involving senior leaders including: The Right Honourable Datuk Amar Haji Fadillah bin Haji Yusof, Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia and Minister of Energy Transition and Water Transformation; Dian Siswarini, President Director, Telkom Indonesia; and Bhupinder Singh, President, Vodafone Business International.
These leaders will join policymakers, industry executives and technology innovators from across the region to discuss how ASEAN can strengthen digital trust, accelerate AI-enabled growth, support digital sovereignty and build resilient digital infrastructure for the future.

The event will feature keynote addresses and discussions involving senior leaders including: The Right Honourable Datuk Amar Haji Fadillah bin Haji Yusof, Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia and Minister of Energy Transition and Water Transformation; Dian Siswarini, President Director, Telkom Indonesia; and Bhupinder Singh, President, Vodafone Business International.

articles.title: CPUs are having a moment: Inside Arm's hyperscale surge
articles.titleEn: CPUs are having a moment: Inside Arm's hyperscale surge
articles.titleKo: CPU는 순간을 보내고 있음 · Inside Arm의 하이퍼스케일 급증
articles.summary:
A day later, Amazon reported its chips business (Graviton, Trainium and Nitro combined) had blown past a $25 billion annual revenue run rate, growing triple digits year over year.
The $25 billion run rate covers the whole chips business, not Graviton alone, but faster commitments and quicker Graviton5 uptake show a custom CPU line pulling real weight inside a large, fast-growing silicon platform, while giving customers a hard price-performance reason to shift more workloads over.
CFO Amy Hood credited efficiency gains across both the CPU and GPU fleets — plus faster infrastructure turn-up — for capacity that got monetized almost as fast as it came online.
summaryLinesEn: A day later, Amazon reported its chips business (Graviton, Trainium and Nitro combined) had blown past a $25 billion annual revenue run rate, growing triple digits year over year.

The $25 billion run rate covers the whole chips business, not Graviton alone, but faster commitments and quicker Graviton5 uptake show a custom CPU line pulling real weight inside a large, fast-growing silicon platform, while giving customers a hard price-performance reason to shift more workloads over.
CFO Amy Hood credited efficiency gains across both the CPU and GPU fleets — plus faster infrastructure turn-up — for capacity that got monetized almost as fast as it came online.
summaryLinesKo: 하루 후 Amazon은 자사의 칩 사업(Graviton, Trainium 및 Nitro 합산)이 연간 250억 달러의 매출을 기록하며 전년 대비 세 자릿수 성장을 기록했다고 보고함
250억 달러의 실행 속도는 Graviton 단독이 아닌 전체 칩 비즈니스를 포괄하지만, 더 빠른 약속과 더 빠른 Graviton5 활용은 빠르게 성장하는 대형 실리콘 플랫폼 내에서 실제 무게를 끌어내는 맞춤형 CPU 라인을 보여주며 고객에게 더 많은 작업 부하를 전환할 수 있는 확실한 가격 대비 성능 이유를 제공함
CFO인 Amy Hood는 CPU와 GPU 전체에 걸쳐 효율성이 향상되고 인프라 가동 시간이 빨라짐에 따라 용량이 온라인에 등장하는 속도만큼 빠르게 수익을 창출할 수 있었다고 평가함

articles.title: Agency: Secure, scalable sandboxes for agents
articles.titleEn: Agency: Secure, scalable sandboxes for agents
articles.titleKo: 에이전시 · 에이전트를 위한 안전하고 확장 가능한 샌드박스
articles.summary:
Ease of use: We wanted users spending their time on high-leverage decisions — not on figuring out how to be productive in a different system with different limitations.
Before Pinecone, it wasn't unusual to see engineers walking around the office with half-open laptops — not because they were working, but because their AI agents were.
The stateful runner layer is where the agentic environment lives and is composed of all the on-demand pods created by the control plane.

articles.summary:
In the GitHub Copilot app, slash commands take that idea further, giving you shortcuts for managing sessions, navigating projects, and customizing your Copilot workflow.
A single / opens up the list of slash commands that can help you move faster, explore new ideas, and get the most out of the app.
File access commands like /add-dir or /cwd aren’t needed since the app manages project context automatically.

articles.title: The Best AI Notetakers to Record Your Meetings, Interviews, or Classes
articles.titleEn: The Best AI Notetakers to Record Your Meetings, Interviews, or Classes
articles.titleKo: 회의, 인터뷰 또는 수업을 기록하는 최고의 AI 메모 작성자
articles.summary:
As with all things AI, the jury’s out on whether AI notetakers are actually useful or if bypassing the intellectual rigor of writing down what people say is going to make us even stupider, but at the very least I’ve found them to be a convenient way to capture the main points of a conversation—and helpful at keeping a record of discussions and meetings I might otherwise have promptly forgotten.
Nearly all AI notetakers push a paid subscription plan, and while most offer a stripped-down, no-cost tier, the utility of these plans varies greatly.
Subscription costs $14 per month or $96 per year (1,200 minutes/month); or $25 per month or $179 per year (unlimited) Best AI Note-Taking Earbuds Photograph: Chris Null Save to wishlist Save to wishlist OSO AI OSO AI Earbuds $160 Amazon $249 $160 (36% off) OSO AI OSO’s AI Earbuds are a quirky concept, designed to transcribe what you hear—including phone calls—rather than specifically recording the broader world.

articles.titleEn: ‘I’m not spying’: how Meta’s smartglasses have divided opinion
articles.titleKo: '나는 스파이가 아니다': 메타의 스마트글래스가 어떻게 의견을 나누었는지
articles.summary:
Karen Walter, 84, from San Diego, who has been living with severe hearing loss for more than 20 years, bought the glasses solely for their live-caption feature.
People said I should have expected that but I didn’t agree with them because it’s not like I’m spying.”
While some users say the wearables have changed their lives, critics voice fears over safety and privacy With more than 7m pairs reportedly sold in 2025, Meta’s Ray-Ban smartglasses are fast becoming one of the world’s most popular gadgets.

articles.title: AT&T and Ericsson Enhance Wireless Capacity, Coverage, and Performance Nationwide
articles.titleEn: AT&T and Ericsson Enhance Wireless Capacity, Coverage, and Performance Nationwide
articles.titleKo: AT&T와 Ericsson, 전국적으로 무선 용량, 적용 범위 및 성능 향상
articles.summary:
The new spectrum and advanced radios will improve capacity, reliability, coverage, and performance for customers.
In areas with upgraded Ericsson infrastructure, AT&T customers are seeing: Improved call reliability, with a 10% reduction in dropped and blocked calls By standardizing equipment at the top of cell towers, customers could experience reduced uplink interference by up to 80% These upgrades are designed to help America’s largest wireless network carry more data, respond faster, and keep customers connected more consistently as wireless demand grows.
We help more than 100 million U.S. families, friends, and neighbors, plus nearly 2.5 million businesses, connect to greater possibility.
summaryLinesEn: The new spectrum and advanced radios will improve capacity, reliability, coverage, and performance for customers.

In areas with upgraded Ericsson infrastructure, AT&T customers are seeing: Improved call reliability, with a 10% reduction in dropped and blocked calls By standardizing equipment at the top of cell towers, customers could experience reduced uplink interference by up to 80% These upgrades are designed to help America’s largest wireless network carry more data, respond faster, and keep customers connected more consistently as wireless demand grows.
We help more than 100 million U.S. families, friends, and neighbors, plus nearly 2.5 million businesses, connect to greater possibility.
summaryLinesKo: 새로운 스펙트럼과 고급 무선 기술은 고객을 위한 용량, 신뢰성, 적용 범위 및 성능을 향상시킬 것임

업그레이드된 Ericsson 인프라가 있는 지역에서 AT&T 고객은 다음과 같은 이점을 누릴 수 있음 · 통화 끊김 및 차단이 10% 감소하여 통화 안정성이 향상됨 · 셀 타워 상단의 장비를 표준화함으로써 고객은 업링크 간섭을 최대 80%까지 줄일 수 있음 · 이러한 업그레이드는 미국 최대의 무선 네트워크가 더 많은 데이터를 전송하고, 더 빠르게 응답하며, 무선 수요가 증가함에 따라 고객 연결을 보다 일관되게 유지할 수 있도록 설계됨

articles.title: Google reveals how much free space Chrome wants to install local AI models
articles.titleEn: Google reveals how much free space Chrome wants to install local AI models
articles.titleKo: Google은 Chrome이 로컬 AI 모델을 설치하려는 여유 공간을 공개함
articles.summary:
Google tells Android Authority that the models themselves will still only take up about 4 GB of storage space once installed, but the models won’t download at all unless you’ve got about 20 gigs free.
Google has updated its support documentation to show that downloading the models that power Chrome’s on-device AI features requires approximately 20 gigabytes of available storage space.
For reference, with on-device AI features disabled, my Mac lists the storage used by the Chrome browser at about 1.5 GB — less than 10% of the space required to enable on-device AI, and less than half the space on-device AI models occupy.

Google은 Chrome의 기기 내 AI 기능을 지원하는 모델을 다운로드하려면 약 20GB의 사용 가능한 저장 공간이 필요함을 보여주기 위해 지원 문서를 업데이트함
참고로, 온디바이스 AI 기능이 비활성화된 상태에서 내 Mac은 Chrome 브라우저에서 사용하는 저장 공간을 약 1.5GB로 표시함 · 이는 온디바이스 AI를 활성화하는 데 필요한 공간의 10% 미만이고, 온디바이스 AI 모델이 차지하는 공간의 절반 미만임

articles.title: Suno Plans New Tools to Make AI-Generated Music More Transparent. Is It Enough? - CNET
articles.titleEn: Suno Plans New Tools to Make AI-Generated Music More Transparent. Is It Enough? - CNET
articles.titleKo: Suno는 AI 생성 음악을 더욱 투명하게 만들기 위한 새로운 도구를 계획함 · 충분합니까 · - 씨넷
articles.summary:
This list goes on, like Suno cracking down on any other potential attempts to copy artists by using third-party technology to screen audio files and lyrics for unauthorized use.
But platforms like Spotify are already implementing policies to crack down on deepfakes, require disclosures about AI-generated music and allow artists to file complaints.
The AI song-generation platform Suno plans to make it easier to tell if a tune you hear was made by its tools.

summaryLinesKo: 이 목록은 Suno가 제3자 기술을 사용하여 무단 사용을 위해 오디오 파일과 가사를 검사함으로써 아티스트를 복제하려는 다른 잠재적인 시도를 단속하는 것처럼 계속됨
그러나 Spotify와 같은 플랫폼은 이미 딥페이크를 단속하고 AI 생성 음악에 대한 공개를 요구하며 아티스트가 불만을 제기할 수 있도록 하는 정책을 시행하고 있음

articles.summary:
In March, Replit raised $400 million at a $9 billion valuation — triple what it was worth six months earlier.

articles.titleKo: 영국 고용 시장은 AI 수요가 급증하고 지식 작업 게시가 분화되면서 둘로 나뉘고 있음
articles.summary:
According to Indeed's Hiring Lab, 9.4 percent of British job postings mentioned AI by the end of June 2026, up from about 2 percent in 2023, with demand spreading well beyond tech into marketing, finance, and media.
Searches for AI roles have grown sevenfold since ChatGPT launched, according to Indeed.
Ad DEC_D_Incontent-1 Jobs that require workers to be physically present unsurprisingly sit at the bottom of the list.

articles.title: SpaceX’s ambitious compute goals could require over two million Nvidia Rubin GPUs
articles.titleEn: SpaceX’s ambitious compute goals could require over two million Nvidia Rubin GPUs
articles.titleKo: SpaceX의 야심찬 컴퓨팅 목표에는 2백만 개가 넘는 Nvidia Rubin GPU가 필요할 수 있음
articles.summary:
SpaceX wants to grow its compute capacity more than fivefold by the end of 2027, finishing the year above two gigawatts of power, according to Elon Musk.
The transaction valued SpaceX at $1 trillion and xAI at $250 billion, for a combined $1.25 trillion.
SpaceX's AI segment, which includes xAI and X, posted $2.56 billion in revenue during Q2 2026 alongside an operating loss of $1.26 billion.
summaryLinesEn: SpaceX wants to grow its compute capacity more than fivefold by the end of 2027, finishing the year above two gigawatts of power, according to Elon Musk.
The transaction valued SpaceX at $1 trillion and xAI at $250 billion, for a combined $1.25 trillion.
SpaceX's AI segment, which includes xAI and X, posted $2.56 billion in revenue during Q2 2026 alongside an operating loss of $1.26 billion.
summaryLinesKo: Elon Musk에 따르면 SpaceX는 2027년 말까지 컴퓨팅 용량을 5배 이상 늘려 올해를 2기가와트 이상의 전력으로 마무리할 계획임
이번 거래에서 SpaceX의 가치는 1조 달러, xAI의 가치는 2,500억 달러로 총 1조 2,500억 달러로 평가됨
xAI와 X가 포함된 SpaceX의 AI 부문은 2026년 2분기 동안 25억 6천만 달러의 매출과 12억 6천만 달러의 영업 손실을 기록함

articles.titleKo: AI가 생성한 아동 성적 학대 이미지가 포함된 메타란 광고
articles.summary:
When asked by Engadget if the company was planning to shut down Old Reddit entirely, a spokesperson for the company didn't answer directly.
The company will "continue supporting limited public API access" but "will gradually restrict new requests and require third-party apps to transition to and operate on Reddit's Developer Platform."
Old Reddit, the 21-year-old desktop version of the site still preferred by many longtime users and moderators, could become the next casualty of Reddit's war against AI scraping.
summaryLinesEn: When asked by Engadget if the company was planning to shut down Old Reddit entirely, a spokesperson for the company didn't answer directly.
The company will "continue supporting limited public API access" but "will gradually restrict new requests and require third-party apps to transition to and operate on Reddit's Developer Platform."
Old Reddit, the 21-year-old desktop version of the site still preferred by many longtime users and moderators, could become the next casualty of Reddit's war against AI scraping.
summaryLinesKo: Engadget이 회사가 Old Reddit을 완전히 폐쇄할 계획인지 묻는 질문에 회사 대변인은 직접 대답하지 않음
회사는 "제한된 공개 API 액세스를 계속 지원"할 예정이지만 "점진적으로 새로운 요청을 제한하고 타사 앱이 Reddit의 개발자 플랫폼으로 전환하여 작동하도록 요구할 것임"
21년 된 사이트의 데스크톱 버전인 Old Reddit은 여전히 많은 오랜 사용자와 중재자들이 선호하고 있으며 Reddit의 AI 스크래핑 전쟁의 다음 희생자가 될 수 있음

articles.title: 4 of Google’s Top AI Brains Are Leaving—and Launching Their Own AI Startup
articles.titleEn: 4 of Google’s Top AI Brains Are Leaving—and Launching Their Own AI Startup
articles.titleKo: Google 최고의 AI 두뇌 중 4명이 떠나고 자체 AI 스타트업 시작
articles.summary:
Today it’s official: After almost 27 years, Dean is leaving Google, along with Ghemawat and two other top-tier AI scientists, to found a company called Discovery Loop .
They put together a simple pitch deck and set out to talk to VCs about funding their company, which they set up as a public benefit corporation.
Worse, the other cofounders are also supernovas in the AI firmament: Oriol Vinyals , VP of research at DeepMind and a technical lead for Gemini, and Quoc Le , a cofounder of Google Brain and the key scientist behind Google’s AutoML-Zero, a project that uses machine learning algorithms to autonomously build AI products.

Worse, the other cofounders are also supernovas in the AI firmament: Oriol Vinyals , VP of research at DeepMind and a technical lead for Gemini, and Quoc Le , a cofounder of Google Brain and the key scientist behind Google’s AutoML-Zero, a project that uses machine learning algorithms to autonomously build AI products.
summaryLinesKo: 오늘 공식적으로는 거의 27년 만에 Dean이 Ghemawat 및 다른 두 명의 최고 AI 과학자와 함께 Google을 떠나 Discovery Loop라는 회사를 설립한다는 것임
그들은 간단한 피치 데크를 구성하고 공익 기업으로 설립한 회사에 자금을 지원하는 것에 대해 VC와 이야기하기 시작함

articles.title: AI Influencers Are Heading Into Uncharted Territory
articles.titleEn: AI Influencers Are Heading Into Uncharted Territory
articles.titleKo: AI 영향력자들이 미지의 영역으로 향하고 있음
articles.summary:
Estimated to be worth $14.5 billion , the virtual influencer market is projected to reach $110.4 billion by 2033, with a reported 33.6 percent annual growth rate.
Having lived through the transition from 2D to 3D animation, 60-year-old Tilkin sees the current moment as just another technological shift.
Mansbridge, 34, says she now earns around $6,000 a month through brand collaborations and designing bespoke AI influencers for brands, many of which require her to sign an NDA so she can’t disclose which ones she’s worked for.

articles.title: The AI Notetaker Has Been Invited to All the Meetings
articles.titleEn: The AI Notetaker Has Been Invited to All the Meetings
articles.titleKo: AI 메모 작성자가 모든 회의에 초대됨
articles.summary:
It’s a verbatim record of our conversation generated by AI in real time, even down to my “mm-hmm” sounds while I listen to Kothari explaining why the startup, which is known for voice dictation, is dropping something new.
If you enable Privacy Mode for your account, then the data from your dictations will not be used by Wispr for AI model training .
Most tech investors and other experts I’ve chatted with this year now assume whenever they meet up with someone to talk business that the conversation is going to be recorded or transcribed by AI, sometimes without explicit consent.

articles.title: An AI agent went rogue during UK safety tests, creating fake identities and launching social engineering attacks unprompted
articles.titleEn: An AI agent went rogue during UK safety tests, creating fake identities and launching social engineering attacks unprompted
articles.titleKo: 영국의 안전 테스트에서 AI 에이전트가 악의적으로 가짜 신원을 생성하고 즉각 사회 공학 공격을 시작함
articles.summary:
Agent built fake identities and ran social engineering attacks According to AISI, an agent tried to inject malicious code into a public open source project on GitHub.
During a cybersecurity test, the British AI Safety Institute found that AI models with unrestricted internet access autonomously created fake identities and tried to sneak malicious code into an open-source project.
Without being told to do so, it created fake identities, tried to slip malicious code into an open source project, and targeted real people and organizations with social engineering attacks.
summaryLinesEn: Agent built fake identities and ran social engineering attacks According to AISI, an agent tried to inject malicious code into a public open source project on GitHub.

During a cybersecurity test, the British AI Safety Institute found that AI models with unrestricted internet access autonomously created fake identities and tried to sneak malicious code into an open-source project.
Without being told to do so, it created fake identities, tried to slip malicious code into an open source project, and targeted real people and organizations with social engineering attacks.
summaryLinesKo: 에이전트는 가짜 신원을 구축하고 사회 공학 공격을 실행함 · AISI에 따르면 에이전트는 GitHub의 공개 오픈 소스 프로젝트에 악성 코드를 주입하려고 함
영국 AI 안전 연구소(British AI Safety Institute)는 사이버 보안 테스트에서 무제한 인터넷 접속이 가능한 AI 모델이 자동으로 가짜 신원을 생성하고 오픈 소스 프로젝트에 악성 코드를 몰래 삽입하려 한다는 사실을 발견함

sourceLines: Agent built fake identities and ran social engineering attacks According to AISI, an agent tried to inject malicious code into a public open source project on GitHub.

articles.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
articles.titleEn: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
articles.titleKo: AI는 날씨 예측을 더 좋게 만듬 · WindBorne이 수익성을 높일 수 있을까요
articles.summary:
WindBorne Systems, a startup that collects data with the world’s longest-flying weather balloons and feeds it into a powerful forecasting model , has raised a $37 million Series B round to take on that challenge, CEO John Dean told TechCrunch.
Private weather forecast companies do exist, but make most of their money repackaging or refining government forecasts for the news media, specialized needs like plane de-icing and ship routing, or the above-mentioned speculators.
The new round was co-led by Khosla Ventures and Galvanize, with additional investments from TransLink Capital, Lux Capital, and previous investors, and values the company after this round of funding at $250 million.
summaryLinesEn: WindBorne Systems, a startup that collects data with the world’s longest-flying weather balloons and feeds it into a powerful forecasting model , has raised a $37 million Series B round to take on that challenge, CEO John Dean told TechCrunch.

Private weather forecast companies do exist, but make most of their money repackaging or refining government forecasts for the news media, specialized needs like plane de-icing and ship routing, or the above-mentioned speculators.

The new round was co-led by Khosla Ventures and Galvanize, with additional investments from TransLink Capital, Lux Capital, and previous investors, and values the company after this round of funding at $250 million.
summaryLinesKo: 세계에서 가장 오래 비행하는 기상 관측 기구로 데이터를 수집하고 이를 강력한 예측 모델에 적용하는 스타트업 WindBorne Systems가 이러한 과제를 해결하기 위해 3,700만 달러 규모의 시리즈 B 투자를 유치했다고 CEO John Dean이 TechCrunch에 말함
민간 일기 예보 회사가 존재하지만 대부분의 돈은 뉴스 미디어, 비행기 제빙 및 선박 경로 지정과 같은 전문 요구 사항 또는 위에서 언급한 투기꾼을 위해 정부 예측을 재포장하거나 정제하는 데 사용됨
새로운 라운드는 TransLink Capital, Lux Capital 및 이전 투자자의 추가 투자와 함께 Khosla Ventures 및 Galvanize가 공동 주도했으며 이번 자금 조달 라운드 이후 회사의 가치를 2억 5천만 달러로 평가함

articles.title: Google plans to kill Assistant on your phone on September 4
articles.titleEn: Google plans to kill Assistant on your phone on September 4
articles.titleKo: 구글은 9월 4일 모바일에서 어시스턴트를 종료할 계획임
articles.summary:
In an email being sent out to users, Google confirms that Assistant on Android devices will be shut down starting on September 4, forcing everyone over to Gemini.
Most of Google’s smart home devices have already transitioned to Gemini.
Now that Gemini is ready to take over, Google will begin ending support for the old system on September 4, but the email notes that it may take several weeks for the process to complete.

articles.summary:
The deal, which some of the people said is worth over $1.5 billion, is in progress, and details could change.
Mechanize launched last year with a mission of automating every job and a star-studded group of investors, including former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman, Stripe CEO Patrick Collison, and podcaster Dwarkesh Patel.
Mechanize's tech can help tech companies improve the performance of their AI models at coding — something Google has struggled with, while OpenAI and Anthropic have scooped up developer customers with Codex and Claude Code.

articles.title: Building trust for agentic commerce: Mastercard Signals report explores the path forward
articles.titleEn: Building trust for agentic commerce: Mastercard Signals report explores the path forward
articles.titleKo: 대리인 상거래에 대한 신뢰 구축 · Mastercard Signals 보고서는 앞으로의 길을 탐구함
articles.summary:
Agent-assisted consumer spending is forecast to reach $3–5 trillion by 2030, with business-to-business spending potentially three times higher.
Agentic commerce marks a shift from AI that supports decisions to AI that can act within conditions set in advance.
Baku, Azerbaijan — August 2026 — Mastercard’s latest Signals report “Encoding Trust: The Race for Intent, Consent and Control in the Agentic World” examines what it will take for agentic commerce to scale as AI agents move beyond searching and recommending to making decisions and transacting on behalf of consumers and businesses.

에이전트적 상거래는 의사결정을 지원하는 AI에서 미리 설정된 조건 내에서 행동할 수 있는 AI로의 전환을 의미함
아제르바이잔 바쿠 — 2026년 8월 — 마스터카드의 최신 시그널 보고서 "인코딩 신뢰 · 에이전트 세계의 의도, 동의 및 제어를 위한 경쟁"은 AI 에이전트가 검색 및 추천을 넘어 소비자와 기업을 대신하여 의사결정 및 거래를 수행함에 따라 에이전트 상거래가 확장되기 위해 필요한 것이 무엇인지 조사함

articles.title: Microsoft AI exec tells developers to default to OpenAI's top model as part of efficiency push
articles.titleEn: Microsoft AI exec tells developers to default to OpenAI's top model as part of efficiency push
articles.titleKo: Microsoft AI exec는 개발자에게 효율성 향상의 일환으로 OpenAI의 최상위 모델을 기본으로 사용하라고 지시함
articles.summary:
While Microsoft has built its own artificial intelligence programming model and gives cloud customers access to over 11,000 models, including from Anthropic, the company wants staffers to take advantage of valuable intellectual property rights that come from the software giant's early investment in OpenAI.
Microsoft is telling developers working on AI coding projects to rely on OpenAI's top-tier model over rival products in a bid to maximize efficiency.
"Internally, shifting more workloads to OpenAI models helps us get greater value from our token investment," Parikh wrote.

articles.title: AI coding agents are blowing through budgets — Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic explain how they're managing it
articles.titleEn: AI coding agents are blowing through budgets — Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic explain how they're managing it
articles.titleKo: AI 코딩 에이전트가 예산을 초과하고 있음 · Replit, Kilo Code 및 Symbotic이 이를 관리하는 방법을 설명함
articles.summary:
At Kilo Code, engineers are reading or writing code themselves only about 1% of the time now, according to co-founder Emilie Schario — the rest is agents.
"Let's look at it from the lens of security, elegance, clean, concise code, water tightness."
That shift is forcing new questions onto dev teams: which systems are safe to hand over, who cleans up when models goof up, how to support multi-model architectures, and whether skyrocketing token bills mean real progress or just burned IT budget.

"Let's look at it from the lens of security, elegance, clean, concise code, water tightness."

That shift is forcing new questions onto dev teams: which systems are safe to hand over, who cleans up when models goof up, how to support multi-model architectures, and whether skyrocketing token bills mean real progress or just burned IT budget.
summaryLinesKo: 공동 창업자인 Emilie Schario에 따르면 Kilo Code에서 엔지니어가 스스로 코드를 읽거나 쓰는 시간은 현재 전체 시간의 약 1%에 불과하며 나머지는 에이전트임
"보안성, 우아함, 깨끗하고 간결한 코드, 수밀성이라는 관점에서 살펴보겠음"
이러한 변화는 개발 팀에 새로운 질문을 강요하고 있음 · 어떤 시스템이 안전하게 넘겨질 수 있는지, 모델이 문제가 생겼을 때 누가 정리하는지, 다중 모델 아키텍처를 지원하는 방법, 치솟는 토큰 비용이 실질적인 진전을 의미하는지, 아니면 그냥 IT 예산을 소모하는지 여부 등임

articles.titleEn: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
articles.titleKo: 개방형 AI 모델이 선두를 따라잡고 있음 · 안전 공백이 남아 있음
articles.summary:
Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip Dominic-Madori Davis Sequoia’s Shaun Maguire leads $1B round for nuclear startup Valar Atomics Julie Bort Malaysia is reportedly shutting down Balaji Srinivasan’s Network School Anthony Ha YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’ Anthony Ha
Advocates of open-weight AI argue that releasing the weights is important for cybersecurity because it allows companies defend themselves against attacks — Hugging Face relied on GLM-5.2 to defend itself against OpenAI’s breach — and because it allows them to better prepare for future threats if they know what’s coming.
GLM-5.2, the open-weight AI model from China’s Z.ai, is only a few months behind OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 and Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7 on cyber and bio capabilities, according to a new report from AI safety nonprofit SaferAI.

articles.titleKo: AI는 인간이 수정하는 것보다 더 빠르게 버그를 찾아냄 · 기업 보안팀이 이에 적응해야 하는 방법
articles.summary:
Thus, we've ended up with an ever-growing burden on developers, security teams, and companies trying to separate exploitable issues from machine-generated noise.
AI-assisted vulnerability discovery is accelerating the pace of bug reports, but the real story is the growing mismatch between what machines can surface and what humans can realistically triage.
For instance, I used to recommend that Windows users hold off on patching their PCs because so many patches ended up going awry, such as the January 2026 Patch Tuesday update .

summaryLinesKo: 따라서 우리는 악용 가능한 문제와 기계 생성 소음을 분리하려는 개발자, 보안 팀 및 기업에 점점 더 많은 부담을 안겨주게 됨
AI 지원 취약성 발견은 버그 보고 속도를 가속화하고 있지만 실제 이야기는 기계가 표면화할 수 있는 것과 인간이 현실적으로 분류할 수 있는 것 사이의 불일치가 점점 커지고 있다는 것임
예를 들어, 나는 2026년 1월 패치 화요일 업데이트와 같이 너무 많은 패치가 잘못되었기 때문에 Windows 사용자에게 PC 패치를 연기할 것을 권장하곤 함

articles.title: Texas governor orders audit of new data centers after realizing over 400 gigawatts of power is a lot - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Texas governor orders audit of new data centers after realizing over 400 gigawatts of power is a lot - Engadget
articles.titleKo: 텍사스 주지사는 400기가와트 이상의 전력이 많은 것을 깨닫고 새로운 데이터 센터에 대한 감사를 명령함
articles.summary:
The governor's office said more than 90 percent of those requests stem from data centers, adding that "unprecedented load growth could endanger the reliability and stability of the Texas electric grid."
In response to the order, the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) must collect information about potential new data centers' ownership and finances as well as their planned power needs, water use and approach to minimizing the negative impact on residents.
According to third-party statistics, Texas is home to 521 data centers .

summaryLinesKo: 주지사 사무실은 이러한 요청의 90% 이상이 데이터 센터에서 비롯된 것이며 "전례 없는 부하 증가는 텍사스 전력망의 신뢰성과 안정성을 위태롭게 할 수 있다"고 덧붙였음
명령에 따라 텍사스 공공 유틸리티 위원회(PUCT)와 텍사스 전기 신뢰성 위원회(ERCOT)는 잠재적인 새로운 데이터 센터의 소유권과 재정은 물론 계획된 전력 수요, 물 사용 및 주민에 대한 부정적인 영향을 최소화하기 위한 접근 방식에 대한 정보를 수집해야 함
제3자 통계에 따르면 텍사스에는 521개의 데이터 센터가 있음

articles.title: ‘Not healthy’ LLM use is more common than you think
articles.titleEn: ‘Not healthy’ LLM use is more common than you think
articles.titleKo: '건강하지 않은' LLM 사용은 생각보다 더 일반적임
articles.summary:
Comprehensive data covering all available tools is hard to come by, but OpenAI alone this year said it has more than 900 million weekly active users.
Providers, meanwhile, have also introduced warnings prompting people to take breaks after lengthy sessions.
Even if only a fraction of chatbot use is considered unhealthy, the sheer scale of AI adoption means millions of people could still be affected.

articles.title: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
articles.titleEn: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
articles.titleKo: 텍사스는 데이터 센터가 그리드에 연결되기 전에 감사를 통과해야 한다고 말함
articles.summary:
But following New York’s data center moratorium , it’s a signal that elected leaders across the country are recognizing a bipartisan desire to pump the brakes on energy-intensive projects.
Data centers will need to provide information on state and local incentives they’ve received, how much they’d rely on the state grid, expected water consumption and sources, and how they plan to track community impacts including noise.
Governor Greg Abbott (R) on Monday directed the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) to verify and audit new data center proposals, writing that the review is needed to “keep the grid stable and reliable.”
summaryLinesEn: But following New York’s data center moratorium , it’s a signal that elected leaders across the country are recognizing a bipartisan desire to pump the brakes on energy-intensive projects.

Governor Greg Abbott (R) on Monday directed the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) to verify and audit new data center proposals, writing that the review is needed to “keep the grid stable and reliable.”
summaryLinesKo: 그러나 뉴욕의 데이터 센터 운영 중단 이후, 이는 전국의 선출된 지도자들이 에너지 집약적인 프로젝트에 제동을 걸고자 하는 초당적인 열망을 인식하고 있다는 신호임
데이터 센터는 받은 주 및 지역 인센티브, 주 전력망에 얼마나 의존할지, 예상 물 소비량 및 공급원, 소음을 포함한 지역사회 영향을 추적할 계획에 대한 정보를 제공해야 함
Greg Abbott 주지사(공화당)는 월요일 텍사스 공공 유틸리티 위원회(PUCT)와 텍사스 전기 신뢰성 위원회(ERCOT)에 새로운 데이터 센터 제안을 검증하고 감사하도록 지시했으며 "그리드를 안정적이고 신뢰할 수 있게 유지"하기 위해 검토가 필요하다고 썼음

articles.title: SpaceX's first public earnings statement shows the financials of an AI company in 2026 - Engadget
articles.titleEn: SpaceX's first public earnings statement shows the financials of an AI company in 2026 - Engadget
articles.titleKo: SpaceX의 첫 공개 수익 명세서는 2026년 AI 회사의 재무를 보여줍니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
As a whole, SpaceX increased revenue by 92 percent year-over-year, bringing its total revenue for the quarter to $7.8 billion.
Further complicating those numbers is that Anthropic has agreed to pay $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center for its compute needs.
The company also shaved the gap between its revenue and operating expenses by more than half, reducing net losses to $541 million, down from $1 billion a year ago.

The company also shaved the gap between its revenue and operating expenses by more than half, reducing net losses to $541 million, down from $1 billion a year ago.
summaryLinesKo: 전체적으로 SpaceX는 전년 대비 매출이 92% 증가하여 해당 분기 총 매출이 78억 달러에 이르렀음
이러한 수치를 더욱 복잡하게 만드는 것은 Anthropic이 컴퓨팅 요구에 대해 SpaceX의 Colossus 1 데이터 센터를 사용하기 위해 2029년 5월까지 월 12억 5천만 달러를 지불하기로 합의했다는 것임
또한 회사는 매출과 운영 비용 간의 격차를 절반 이상 줄여 순손실을 5억 4,100만 달러로 줄였음 · 이는 1년 전 10억 달러에서 감소한 수치임

articles.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
articles.titleEn: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
articles.titleKo: 주지사가 감사를 요구함에 따라 텍사스는 새로운 데이터 센터를 중단함
articles.summary:
Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply.
Governor Greg Abbott announced Monday that all new data center projects will need to be audited by both the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the state’s grid operator, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT).
While many data center operators, including Google and Microsoft , have been drawn to Texas for its ample natural gas reserves, wind and solar have helped ERCOT keep pace with growing electricity demand, according to the Energy Information Administration (EIA).

articles.title: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Perplexity는 AI 쇼핑 봇에 대한 Amazon의 금지 명령을 성공적으로 번복함
articles.summary:
According to an opinion from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Amazon's original claim that Perplexity violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) doesn't hold up to scrutiny and shouldn't have been rewarded with an injunction.
Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.
According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.
summaryLinesEn: According to an opinion from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Amazon's original claim that Perplexity violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) doesn't hold up to scrutiny and shouldn't have been rewarded with an injunction.

Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.

According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.
summaryLinesKo: 제9순회항소법원의 의견에 따르면, Perplexity가 컴퓨터 사기 및 남용법(CFAA)을 위반했다는 Amazon의 원래 주장은 조사를 통과하지 못했으며 금지 명령으로 보상받아서는 안 됨
Perplexity가 법을 위반했다고 성공적으로 주장하려면 Amazon은 회사가 허가 없이 의도적으로 컴퓨터에 액세스하고 보호된 컴퓨터에서 정보를 얻었으며 "1년 동안 한 명 이상의 사람에게" 평균 가치가 5,000달러 이상인 손실이 있었다는 사실을 증명해야 함
Amazon에 따르면 두 회사는 2024년에 에이전트 쇼핑을 조기에 중단하는 데 동의했지만 Perplexity는 합의를 취소하고 Comet의 AI 봇을 일반 Chrome 브라우저로 위장하여 기능을 다시 활성화함

articles.title: The White House Is Keeping Its AI Cybersecurity Framework Secret
articles.titleEn: The White House Is Keeping Its AI Cybersecurity Framework Secret
articles.titleKo: 백악관은 AI 사이버보안 프레임워크를 비밀로 유지하고 있음
articles.summary:
The Trump administration invited staffers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Nvidia, and other leading AI companies to the White House on Tuesday to share an overview of its new AI oversight framework, the people said.
On Tuesday, Nvidia and the same coalition of companies launched a new project called SAFE, or Shared AI Findings Exchange.
A second White House official, who requested anonymity because they were not authorized to speak to the media, emphasized that the new framework is intentionally narrow and is focused exclusively on the cybersecurity capabilities of the most advanced models on the market, such as Anthropic’s Fable and OpenAI’s ChatGPT 5.6.

articles.title: OK, Well, Rogue AI Agents Are Hacking Again
articles.titleEn: OK, Well, Rogue AI Agents Are Hacking Again
articles.titleKo: 좋아요, 악성 AI 에이전트가 다시 해킹하고 있음
articles.summary:
In a recent bout of testing , models from both Anthropic and OpenAI took “autonomous, unsanctioned action on the live internet” a total of 19 times over 122 training runs.
It went so far as to create online personas “to pressure the project's maintainer to approve the code,” according to AISI.
In what the institute described as “the most serious case,” an AI agent attempted to insert malicious code into an open-source project on GitHub.

AISI에 따르면 "프로젝트 관리자에게 코드를 승인하도록 압력을 가하기 위해" 온라인 페르소나를 만드는 데까지 이르렀음

articles.title: This year's Pulitzer Prizes saw a record number of winners disclose AI use
articles.titleEn: This year's Pulitzer Prizes saw a record number of winners disclose AI use
articles.titleKo: 올해 퓰리처상에서는 기록적인 수의 수상자가 AI 사용을 공개함
articles.summary:
A record eight Pulitzer awardees disclosed using AI this year, including five winners and three finalists, Nieman Lab reports .
This year, entrants used AI tools and large language models more often, mainly to search large document sets faster.
Pulitzer administrator Marjorie Miller told Nieman Lab that the news industry now accepts "AI is here to stay" and better understands where its use is appropriate and "when it might not, such as in writing and editing stories in any format that might be considered for a Pulitzer Prize."
summaryLinesEn: A record eight Pulitzer awardees disclosed using AI this year, including five winners and three finalists, Nieman Lab reports .
This year, entrants used AI tools and large language models more often, mainly to search large document sets faster.

Pulitzer administrator Marjorie Miller told Nieman Lab that the news industry now accepts "AI is here to stay" and better understands where its use is appropriate and "when it might not, such as in writing and editing stories in any format that might be considered for a Pulitzer Prize."
summaryLinesKo: Nieman Lab이 보고한 바에 따르면 올해 AI를 사용하여 공개한 기록적인 8명의 Pulitzer 수상자는 5명의 우승자와 3명의 최종 후보를 포함함
올해 참가자들은 주로 대규모 문서 세트를 더 빠르게 검색하기 위해 AI 도구와 대규모 언어 모델을 더 자주 사용함
Pulitzer의 관리자인 Marjorie Miller는 Nieman Lab과의 인터뷰에서 뉴스 산업이 이제 "AI는 여기에 있다"는 사실을 받아들이고 AI의 사용이 적절한 곳과 "퓰리처 상을 받을 수 있는 모든 형식의 기사를 작성하고 편집하는 등의 경우에 그렇지 않을 때"를 더 잘 이해하고 있다고 말함

articles.summary:
Why more than one-third of organizations spend 25–40% of their R&D budget on projects that never reach market.
The research reveals that while AI adoption is widespread, many organizations still lack the intelligence needed to prioritize the right opportunities, eliminate low-value projects early, and reduce costly late-stage failures.
Innovation leaders face increasing pressure to deliver breakthrough products faster while making smarter investment decisions.

연구에 따르면 AI 도입이 널리 확산되고 있지만, 많은 조직에는 올바른 기회의 우선순위를 정하고 가치가 낮은 프로젝트를 조기에 제거하며 비용이 많이 드는 후기 단계 실패를 줄이는 데 필요한 인텔리전스가 여전히 부족한 것으로 나타남

articles.title: How to use location sharing to build trust on vacation
articles.titleEn: How to use location sharing to build trust on vacation
articles.titleKo: 휴가 중 신뢰를 구축하기 위해 위치 공유를 사용하는 방법
articles.summary:
A recent “Parenting in a Digital World” survey found that nearly 4 in 10 parents rely more on location sharing while traveling, while another 25% say they check in more often through family group chats.
If location sharing is introduced as a shared safety tool that makes more independence possible—not as a way to monitor every movement—it can change the conversation and pre-empt any defensive responses.
Location sharing is most helpful when family members split up for age-appropriate activities, need to reconnect at a meeting place or want peace of mind while exploring separately.

articles.title: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
articles.titleEn: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
articles.titleKo: 귀하의 사용자는 이미 Arm을 사용하고 있음 · 소프트웨어가 이를 목표로 삼고 있습니까
articles.summary:
With 99% of smartphones running on Arm, around 50% of Arm-based compute shipped to leading hyperscalers, and more than 350 billion Arm-based chips shipped to date, the Arm architecture already powers many of the platforms developers build for every day.
Once running, benchmarking tools such as Arm Performix can help provide insights into hotspots, memory usage, and CPU efficiency to guide optimization.
So, whether you are building for cloud, games, or apps with on-device AI, your software may already run on the Arm compute platform without being deliberately optimized for it.

So, whether you are building for cloud, games, or apps with on-device AI, your software may already run on the Arm compute platform without being deliberately optimized for it.

일단 실행되면 Arm Performix와 같은 벤치마킹 도구는 핫스팟, 메모리 사용량 및 CPU 효율성에 대한 통찰력을 제공하여 최적화를 안내하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음

articles.title: Arm Neural Technology gaining momentum across the mobile gaming ecosystem
articles.titleEn: Arm Neural Technology gaining momentum across the mobile gaming ecosystem
articles.titleKo: Arm Neural Technology, 모바일 게임 생태계 전반에 걸쳐 추진력을 얻고 있음
articles.summary:
Mobile gamers expect richer lighting, smoother gameplay, and increasingly immersive visual experiences without compromising battery life, thermal performance, or responsiveness.
These collaborations make neural graphics capabilities available through the engines and workflows developers already use, reducing integration effort, and accelerating adoption across the industry.
One example is Neural Dawn, the game project co-developed with Sumo Digital that showcases how Arm Neural Technology can enable desktop-quality graphics techniques, including advanced lighting, ray-traced effects and AI-powered rendering, within a mobile power envelope.

articles.title: Mistral Is in the Right Place at the Right Time
articles.titleEn: Mistral Is in the Right Place at the Right Time
articles.titleKo: 미스트랄은 적시에 적절한 장소에 있음
articles.summary:
Last September, Mistral raised almost $2 billion at a $13.5 billion valuation; it's reportedly teeing up another raise that will bump that figure to $23 billion.
Unlike the leading American labs, locked in a race to superintelligence , Mistral has shifted its focus toward smaller, bespoke models for manufacturing, utilities, and financial services.
“Everybody outside the US and China should participate in the open source ecosystem, because it takes leverage away,” says Nicolas Granatino, founder of startup accelerator StemAI, who holds a stake in Mistral in a personal capacity.

“Everybody outside the US and China should participate in the open source ecosystem, because it takes leverage away,” says Nicolas Granatino, founder of startup accelerator StemAI, who holds a stake in Mistral in a personal capacity.
summaryLinesKo: 지난 9월 미스트랄은 평가액 135억 달러로 거의 20억 달러를 모금함 · 보도에 따르면 그 수치를 230억 달러로 끌어올릴 또 다른 인상이 예정되어 있음
초지능을 향한 경쟁에 갇힌 선도적인 미국 연구소와 달리 Mistral은 제조, 유틸리티 및 금융 서비스를 위한 소규모 맞춤형 모델에 초점을 전환함
개인 자격으로 Mistral의 지분을 보유하고 있는 스타트업 액셀러레이터 StemAI의 설립자 Nicolas Granatino는 "미국과 중국 이외의 모든 사람은 오픈 소스 생태계에 참여해야 함 · 왜냐하면 레버리지를 빼앗기 때문임" · 라고 말함

articles.title: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promises of quick payoff
articles.titleEn: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promises of quick payoff
articles.titleKo: SpaceX의 AI 지출은 빠른 보상 약속에도 불구하고 월스트리트를 불안하게 함
articles.summary:
CFO Bret Johnsen said that in the first few weeks of the current quarter, SpaceX contracted an additional $6.7 billion of cloud services revenue "that begins ramping starting in October."
Bret Johnsen, SpaceX's CFO, suggested on the earnings call that investors should start thinking differently about capex because of how quickly it's converting into revenue.
Prior to that, Anthropic announced a deal that would involve paying up to $1.25 billion a month for three years for compute capacity at SpaceX's Colossus data center in Memphis, Tennessee.

Prior to that, Anthropic announced a deal that would involve paying up to $1.25 billion a month for three years for compute capacity at SpaceX's Colossus data center in Memphis, Tennessee.
summaryLinesKo: CFO인 Bret Johnsen은 이번 분기 첫 몇 주 동안 SpaceX가 "10월부터 증가하기 시작하는" 67억 달러의 추가 클라우드 서비스 수익을 계약했다고 말함
SpaceX의 CFO인 Bret Johnsen은 실적 발표에서 자본 지출이 수익으로 전환되는 속도 때문에 투자자들이 자본 지출에 대해 다르게 생각해야 한다고 제안함
이에 앞서 Anthropic은 테네시주 멤피스에 있는 SpaceX의 Colossus 데이터 센터의 컴퓨팅 용량에 대해 3년 동안 월 최대 12억 5천만 달러를 지불하는 계약을 발표함

articles.summary:
Core Metrics : Qualcomm posted $9.95 billion in revenue this quarter, down 4% year over year, beating market expectations of $9.6 billion.
Judging from the next quarter guidance, the company expects revenue of $9.7 billion to $10.5 billion for the next quarter, showing no obvious signs of recovery; Non-GAAP EPS is expected to be $2.05 to $2.25, below market expectations of $2.36.
The company's gross margin for the quarter was 53.1%, down 2.5 percentage points year over year and below market expectations of 54.6% .

The global average across all data breaches rose 12 percent to $4.99 million.
Incidents involving AI cost an average of $5.33 million, compared to $4.70 million for those without an AI component.
Among firms that experienced an AI-related incident, 92 percent had inadequate access controls in place.

articles.title: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
articles.titleEn: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
articles.titleKo: Marc Benioff가 지원하는 스타트업은 AI가 AI 배포 문제를 해결할 수 있다고 생각함
articles.summary:
To pursue it, the company raised $20 million in pre-seed funding led by Marc Benioff’s Time Ventures, with additional backing from tech luminaries like Michael Dell, Aaron Levie and George Kurtz.
The four founders previously started Bonobo AI , a pre-transformer language model company that launched a voice-to-text service in 2017.
It’s so hard for big businesses to get AI tools working reliably that whole new organizations of forward-deployed engineers or FDEs— specialists who drop into a company to get its AI systems up and running — are springing up to help them.
