articles.summary:
Math in particular is feeling AI's impact, and reactions range from excitement about new possibilities to depression over a lost sense of identity .
Both used the same AI model but took different approaches to "unclonable encryption," a method that relies on quantum properties.

articles.titleKo: EU, AI 투명성에 관한 새로운 규칙 발표 - Engadget
articles.summary:
The new law has some teeth, with fines up to €15 million or three percent of global annual revenue for companies and €750k for EU institutions, bodies and agencies.
The new rules require an "AI" mark if machines assisted in the creation of "authentic-looking" deepfake content (image, audio, video) or published text.
The European Union has announced that it's new AI transparency rules are now in effect and enforceable across the bloc as of August 2nd.

articles.title: AI Conquered Coding. Fast Food Is Next
articles.titleEn: AI Conquered Coding. Fast Food Is Next
articles.titleKo: AI가 코딩을 정복함 · 패스트푸드가 다음임
articles.summary:
In 2024, roughly 4 percent of fast-food locations in the US used voice AI technology in the drive-thru lane, according to Intouch Insight’s annual Drive Thru Survey.
Imagine pulling up to McDonald’s and having a chipper automated voice offer you a buy-one-get-one-free milkshake deal—then realizing that the chain offered you the deal because it calculated you are 78 percent more likely to order dessert on the second Tuesday of every month.
Last year, that figure grew to 5 percent; early research suggests that has now climbed to 6 percent.

articles.title: AI shopping searches surged 200% in one year - and it's a top priority for commerce leaders now
articles.titleEn: AI shopping searches surged 200% in one year - and it's a top priority for commerce leaders now
articles.titleKo: AI 쇼핑 검색은 1년 만에 200% 급증했으며 현재 상거래 리더의 최우선 과제임
articles.summary:
The use of agentic AI search as the first step in shopping online grew by 200% in the last 12 months, according to Salesforce 's State of Commerce report , a survey of 3,450 commerce professionals and 4,690 consumers, plus behavioral data from more than 1.5 billion global shoppers.
Also: Why more consumers prefer AI-enhanced shopping - and still expect the human touch The commerce businesses that will win and outpace the market are the ones that focus on data, scaling AI in production, reskilling their employees, and system integrations that unify customer data across all systems to ensure sales, service, marketing, and commerce teams have a unified view of their business and their customers' needs and expectations.
Also: Google says AI agents spending your money is a 'more fun' way to shop The top challenge for commerce leaders is the implementation and expansion of AI capabilities -- a top opportunity and challenge.
summaryLinesEn: The use of agentic AI search as the first step in shopping online grew by 200% in the last 12 months, according to Salesforce 's State of Commerce report , a survey of 3,450 commerce professionals and 4,690 consumers, plus behavioral data from more than 1.5 billion global shoppers.

Also: Why more consumers prefer AI-enhanced shopping - and still expect the human touch The commerce businesses that will win and outpace the market are the ones that focus on data, scaling AI in production, reskilling their employees, and system integrations that unify customer data across all systems to ensure sales, service, marketing, and commerce teams have a unified view of their business and their customers' needs and expectations.

Also: Google says AI agents spending your money is a 'more fun' way to shop The top challenge for commerce leaders is the implementation and expansion of AI capabilities -- a top opportunity and challenge.
summaryLinesKo: 3,450명의 상거래 전문가와 4,690명의 소비자를 대상으로 실시한 Salesforce의 상업 현황 보고서와 15억 명 이상의 전 세계 쇼핑객의 행동 데이터에 따르면 온라인 쇼핑의 첫 번째 단계로 에이전트 AI 검색의 사용은 지난 12개월 동안 200% 증가함

articles.titleEn: AI is both a cyber weapon and a massive target, CrowdStrike warns

articles.summary:
Also: Assume AI cybersecurity attacks are the future: 43% of companies have already experienced it There are now 2.5 times as many AI agent-triggered leads for the firm's threat hunters to examine as there are manually driven leads, which CrowdStrike said "makes it more difficult for defenders to distinguish malicious activity from expected AI-driven behavior."
From January through June 2026, 88% of exploits detected by CrowdStrike were launched within 48 hours of a public proof-of-concept (PoC) code release.
For example, CrowdStrike said that in one campaign, the victim's LLM was used to generate close to 200,000 API requests in two minutes, "resulting in large-scale financial and operational impact."

articles.title: Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa
articles.titleEn: Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa
articles.titleKo: 인터폴은 AI가 아프리카 전역에서 "사이버 범죄의 핵심 운영 동인"이 됐다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report.
The year 2025 marks the point where AI shifted from a useful tool to what the agency calls the "core operational driver of cybercrime in Africa" on the continent.
Four Interpol-coordinated operations in 2025 and 2026 led to more than 1,500 arrests and the seizure of over $100 million.

articles.titleKo: 게임 심층 분석 · 광고 수익 창출 | 센서타워
articles.summary:
Trusted by the most successful gaming leaders in the business Ads in mobile gaming are a $12B+ per year business: Mobile gaming ad monetization generated over $12 billion in annual revenue across 19 markets in 2025, with 2.4 trillion ad impressions served across the ecosystem.
AppLovin + AdMob are 65% of mobile gaming ad revenue: AppLovin and AdMob have steadily consolidated their lead through 2025 into 2026, growing combined share at the expense of smaller networks.
Ad revenue is significantly less concentrated than IAP: Games ranked below #1,000 by ad revenue capture 29% of ad revenue, only 9% of IAP revenue is captured by games ranked under #1,000 by IAP revenue.

articles.title: CIO Executive Council Resources
articles.titleEn: CIO Executive Council Resources
articles.titleKo: CIO 집행위원회 리소스
articles.summary:
This IDC Survey Spotlight, prepared by Gina Smith , PhD, Senior Research Director, IT Skills for Digital Business, examines data from IDC’s 2026 Future Enterprise Resiliency and Spending Survey to explore how organizations are grappling with IT skills validation across four key regions: North America, Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and the Middle East and North Africa.
As AI becomes integral to enterprise operations, CIOs are shifting focus from rapid deployment to engineering sustainable AI economics.
The survey highlights that leadership perspectives on modernization priorities, business drivers, obstacles, IT budget allocation, decision criteria, data architecture maturity, data quality, and the data-related initiatives organizations are prioritizing to enable AI use cases over the next 12–18 months.

As AI becomes integral to enterprise operations, CIOs are shifting focus from rapid deployment to engineering sustainable AI economics.

summaryLinesKo: 디지털 비즈니스를 위한 IT 기술 부문 수석 연구 책임자인 Gina Smith 박사가 준비한 이 IDC 설문조사 스포트라이트는 IDC의 2026년 미래 기업 탄력성 및 지출 설문조사의 데이터를 조사하여 북미, 아시아 태평양, 서유럽, 중동 및 북아프리카 등 4개 주요 지역에서 조직이 IT 기술 검증과 어떻게 씨름하고 있는지 살펴봄
AI가 기업 운영에 필수가 되면서 CIO는 신속한 배포에서 지속 가능한 AI 경제성 엔지니어링으로 초점을 전환하고 있음
설문조사에서는 조직이 향후 12~18개월 동안 AI 사용 사례를 활성화하기 위해 우선순위를 정하는 현대화 우선 순위, 비즈니스 동인, 장애물, IT 예산 할당, 결정 기준, 데이터 아키텍처 성숙도, 데이터 품질 및 데이터 관련 이니셔티브에 대한 리더십 관점을 강조함

articles.summary:
IDinsight , a research organization supporting global development leaders, reports working up to 16× faster with Claude.
The Epilepsy Foundation is providing 24/7 support through Claude to 3.4 million Americans living with epilepsy.
Claude can now connect to: Benevity , which can be used to access more than 2.4 million validated nonprofits to support volunteering and donation searches in Claude; Blackbaud , which provides CRM and fundraising tools for donor management, campaign tracking, and giving optimization; and Candid , which provides data on nonprofits and funders for the discovery of organizations, grants, and philanthropic opportunities.

articles.titleKo: 치열한 일반 AI 경쟁 속에서 중소 AI 개발자가 수직 틈새 시나리오에서 두각을 나타내는 방법 – ChatGPT 및 Claude의 글로벌 베스트셀러 목록 성공에서 얻은 통찰력
articles.summary:
From the changes in the AI application market trends in 2026 and the monitoring of data of small and medium-sized apps on the App Store, it can be observed that the market size of AI products is not equal to their growth rate, and top products do not have all-round monopoly.
When general-purpose AI assistants occupy the top positions on the ranking list, the breakthrough direction for new entrants is shifting from replicating the general chat entry to focusing on more segmented, specific vertical scenarios with more intuitive value.
According to the monitoring data from Qimai Data, at 10:00 on August 3, ChatGPT ranked 1st and Claude ranked 10th in the overall paid bestseller list for iPhone in the United States; meanwhile, among the top 5 apps on the US iPhone efficiency paid bestseller list, four AI products namely ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Perplexity took up 4 spots.

When general-purpose AI assistants occupy the top positions on the ranking list, the breakthrough direction for new entrants is shifting from replicating the general chat entry to focusing on more segmented, specific vertical scenarios with more intuitive value.

According to the monitoring data from Qimai Data, at 10:00 on August 3, ChatGPT ranked 1st and Claude ranked 10th in the overall paid bestseller list for iPhone in the United States; meanwhile, among the top 5 apps on the US iPhone efficiency paid bestseller list, four AI products namely ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Perplexity took up 4 spots.
summaryLinesKo: 2026년 AI 애플리케이션 시장 동향 변화와 앱스토어에서 중소형 앱 데이터 모니터링을 통해 AI 제품의 시장 규모와 성장률이 같지 않고, 상위 제품이 전면적으로 독점하지 않는다는 것을 알 수 있음
범용 AI 비서가 순위 목록에서 상위권을 차지할 때 신규 진입자의 획기적인 방향은 일반 채팅 항목을 복제하는 것에서 보다 직관적인 가치를 지닌 보다 세분화되고 구체적인 수직적 시나리오에 초점을 맞추는 것으로 전환되고 있음
Qimai Data의 모니터링 데이터에 따르면 8월 3일 10시 기준 미국 내 iPhone 전체 유료 베스트셀러 목록에서 ChatGPT가 1위, Claude가 10위를 차지함 · 한편, 미국 iPhone 효율성 유료 베스트셀러 목록의 상위 5개 앱 중 ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity 등 4개의 AI 제품이 4위를 차지함

articles.title: Anthropic, OpenAI among firms facing new scrutiny under EU AI Act enforcement powers
articles.titleEn: Anthropic, OpenAI among firms facing new scrutiny under EU AI Act enforcement powers
articles.titleKo: EU AI 법 집행 권한에 따라 새로운 조사를 받는 기업 중 Anthropic, OpenAI
articles.summary:
Under the powers that came into effect on Sunday, the Commission, the EU's executive arm, can demand to evaluate models before public release in the region, restrict EU market access and fine a provider up to 15 million euros or 3% of its annual turnover, whichever is higher.
The EU AI Office's supervisory and enforcement powers over general-purpose AI models are part of a staggered rollout of the 2024 EU AI Act, which has imposed a transition period for certain aspects of the law.
"We've collaborated closely with the European Commission and the wider ecosystem on implementing the AI Act, including its Codes of Practice, and will continue working together to help Europe realise the benefits of the Intelligence Age," Tom Duff Gordon, VP, EMEA policy at OpenAI, told CNBC when asked to comment on the new powers.
summaryLinesEn: Under the powers that came into effect on Sunday, the Commission, the EU's executive arm, can demand to evaluate models before public release in the region, restrict EU market access and fine a provider up to 15 million euros or 3% of its annual turnover, whichever is higher.

"We've collaborated closely with the European Commission and the wider ecosystem on implementing the AI Act, including its Codes of Practice, and will continue working together to help Europe realise the benefits of the Intelligence Age," Tom Duff Gordon, VP, EMEA policy at OpenAI, told CNBC when asked to comment on the new powers.
summaryLinesKo: 일요일 발효된 권한에 따라 EU의 집행 기관인 위원회는 해당 지역에 공개되기 전에 모델을 평가하도록 요구할 수 있으며, EU 시장 접근을 제한하고 공급자에게 최대 1,500만 유로 또는 연간 매출의 3% 중 더 높은 금액의 벌금을 부과할 수 있음
범용 AI 모델에 대한 EU AI 사무국의 감독 및 집행 권한은 법의 특정 측면에 전환 기간을 부과한 2024 EU AI 법의 시차적 시행의 일부임
OpenAI의 EMEA 정책 VP인 Tom Duff Gordon은 새로운 권한에 대한 논평을 요청받았을 때 CNBC에 "우리는 실천 강령을 포함하여 AI 법을 시행하기 위해 유럽 위원회 및 더 넓은 생태계와 긴밀히 협력해 왔으며 유럽이 지능 시대의 이점을 실현할 수 있도록 계속 협력할 것입니다"라고 말함

articles.title: What Summer Heat Actually Does to Your Phone Battery (and the Habits That Prevent It) - CNET
articles.titleEn: What Summer Heat Actually Does to Your Phone Battery (and the Habits That Prevent It) - CNET
articles.titleKo: 여름 더위가 모바일 배터리에 실제로 미치는 영향(및 이를 방지하는 습관) - CNET
articles.summary:
Heat damage to a phone battery accumulates silently all summer and shows up as reduced capacity by fall.
Whether you’re out on a hike, watching videos by the pool or just leaving your phone on the dashboard, here’s what you need to know about overheating — and how to keep your device safe this summer.
If the interior temperature of your phone exceeds its normal operating range and the device overheats, you can expect issues: There are also possible permanent harmful effects: Overheating can cause lasting damage to the battery, SIM card and other crucial parts inside your phone.

articles.title: Claude Opus 5 pushes prompt-to-game AI from rough color blocks to full 3D prototypes with physics and music
articles.titleEn: Claude Opus 5 pushes prompt-to-game AI from rough color blocks to full 3D prototypes with physics and music
articles.titleKo: Claude Opus 5는 거친 색상 블록에서 물리 및 음악을 갖춘 풀 3D 프로토타입에 이르기까지 게임 프롬프트 AI를 구현함
articles.summary:
Harshith had Opus 5, Fable 5 , GPT-5.6 Sol, and several other models generate a 3D Airbus H145 in Three.js and lined up the results. atomic.chat went a step further and had all four models build three physics scenes , among them a tornado tearing across a field and a wrecking ball swinging into an apartment block.
Writing a scene from scratch takes more than clean syntax because the model has to know how the world actually looks and moves, how a snowboard slides over snow, or how wind travels through a field of grass.
Community tests show a significant quality leap over last year's Claude 4 Opus, with Opus 5 also outperforming GPT-5.6 Sol and Kimi K3 in physics realism and mechanical complexity.

Writing a scene from scratch takes more than clean syntax because the model has to know how the world actually looks and moves, how a snowboard slides over snow, or how wind travels through a field of grass.

summaryLinesKo: Harshith에는 Opus 5, Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol 및 기타 여러 모델이 Three.js에서 3D Airbus H145를 생성하고 결과를 정리함 · Atomic.chat은 한 단계 더 나아가 4개의 모델 모두 3개의 물리 장면을 구축하도록 함 · 그중에는 들판을 가르는 토네이도와 아파트 블록으로 흔들리는 레킹볼이 포함됨
장면을 처음부터 작성하려면 모델이 세상이 실제로 어떻게 보이고 움직이는지, 스노보드가 눈 위로 어떻게 미끄러지는지, 잔디밭에서 바람이 어떻게 움직이는지 알아야 하기 때문에 깔끔한 구문 이상의 것이 필요함
커뮤니티 테스트에서는 작년 Claude 4 Opus에 비해 품질이 크게 향상되었으며, Opus 5는 물리학적 사실성과 기계적 복잡성 측면에서 GPT-5.6 Sol 및 Kimi K3보다 뛰어난 성능을 보였음

articles.title: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
articles.titleEn: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
articles.titleKo: 예술가들이 AI를 수용하도록 설득할 만큼 충분한 비용을 지불하고 있습니까
articles.summary:
Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning Pippa’s payments to artists aren’t very large on an individual basis — especially when you compare them to how much the service charges users for monthly subscriptions (which range from $14.99 to $99.99.)
Pippa’s tech still involves using art that was scraped from the internet Pippa — which launched in May — currently has around 800 paying subscribers, and while the company has only signed licensing / model training agreements with four human artists, Shrum said they are in talks to bring four more into the fold.
In the near future, Pippa plans to incorporate ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 model into its service, which may attract some subscribers because of the model’s ability to generate up to 30 seconds of video footage that can be fine-tuned without starting over from scratch.

In the near future, Pippa plans to incorporate ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 model into its service, which may attract some subscribers because of the model’s ability to generate up to 30 seconds of video footage that can be fine-tuned without starting over from scratch.
summaryLinesKo: 아티스트들은 AI 슬롭에 대해 변호사를 선임하고 있으며 일부는 심지어 Pippa가 아티스트에게 지불하는 금액이 개인 기준으로 그다지 크지 않음 · 특히 서비스가 사용자에게 월간 구독료(14.99~99.99달러 범위)에 대해 청구하는 금액과 비교할 때 더욱 그렇음
Pippa의 기술에는 여전히 인터넷에서 스크랩한 예술품을 사용하는 것이 포함됨 · 5월에 출시된 Pippa는 현재 약 800명의 유료 가입자를 보유하고 있으며 회사는 4명의 인간 아티스트와 라이센스/모델 교육 계약만 체결했지만 Shrum은 4명을 더 추가하기 위해 협상 중이라고 말함

sourceLines: Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning Pippa’s payments to artists aren’t very large on an individual basis — especially when you compare them to how much the service charges users for monthly subscriptions (which range from $14.99 to $99.99.)

Pippa’s tech still involves using art that was scraped from the internet Pippa — which launched in May — currently has around 800 paying subscribers, and while the company has only signed licensing / model training agreements with four human artists, Shrum said they are in talks to bring four more into the fold.

In the near future, Pippa plans to incorporate ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 model into its service, which may attract some subscribers because of the model’s ability to generate up to 30 seconds of video footage that can be fine-tuned without starting over from scratch.

articles.summary:
Over the past six years, he has splashed out HK$90,000 on loot boxes.
A single weapon might cost HK$100 (US$13), but he could cumulatively spend HK$2,000 by the time he acquired the one he wanted.
Surveys and cases at counselling centres suggest game features can trigger uncontrolled spending, creating problems similar to gambling addiction Playing strategic and role-playing mobile games has been a major leisure activity for Peter Lee* since he graduated in 2020, when social distancing measures during the Covid-19 pandemic left him with little to do outside working hours.

articles.summary:
If agents could resolve between one-quarter and one-half of all installation problems affecting research software, the saved research time across 100 packages would be worth between $600,000 and nearly $5 million.

Because STAR was no longer maintained, rustar-aligner moved to the scverse research consortium.

articles.title: AI keeps cracking unsolved math problems, and mathematicians have mixed feelings
articles.titleEn: AI keeps cracking unsolved math problems, and mathematicians have mixed feelings
articles.titleKo: AI는 계속해서 풀리지 않는 수학 문제를 풀고 있으며 수학자들은 엇갈린 감정을 갖고 있음
articles.summary:
If AI can take over a large share of research tasks, mathematicians can't focus only on solving as many open problems as possible.
OpenAI's new Astra model also appears designed for this work: The lab introduced it with ten solutions of varying difficulty.
The math community would need to decide which results matter, how they should be presented, and what goals research should pursue.

articles.titleEn: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
articles.titleKo: 이게 빌보드 핫 100 히트 AI 슬롭인가요
articles.summary:
I ran the track through five different tools, and they all said that there was between 20 and 30 percent chance that it was AI or at least AI-assisted.
Part of the suspicion is certainly due to the fact that the song is a dramatic left turn.
The single’s cover art and a post celebrating its success were both flagged as being AI-generated with over 97 percent certainty by multiple AI image detectors.

articles.title: Nobody Knows if OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI Hacking Sprees Are Illegal
articles.titleEn: Nobody Knows if OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI Hacking Sprees Are Illegal
articles.titleKo: OpenAI와 Anthropic의 AI 해킹 행위가 불법인지는 아무도 모름
articles.summary:
Both companies declined WIRED’s request to comment for this story.
“Just because you’re using an AI agent or AI model, that shouldn’t somehow absolve you of any liability, but it's going to depend a lot on the facts in the particular situations” as cases begin to be decided in courts, says Lauren Yu, a fellow with the ACLU’s Speech, Privacy, & Technology Project.
But the recent high-profile incidents from OpenAI and Anthropic suggest that answers will need to come soon.
summaryLinesEn: Both companies declined WIRED’s request to comment for this story.

But the recent high-profile incidents from OpenAI and Anthropic suggest that answers will need to come soon.
summaryLinesKo: 두 회사 모두 이 기사에 대한 논평을 요청한 WIRED의 요청을 거절함
ACLU의 음성, 개인 정보 보호 및 기술 프로젝트 연구원인 Lauren Yu는 “AI 에이전트나 AI 모델을 사용한다고 해서 어떤 책임이 면제되는 것은 아니지만 법원에서 사건이 결정되기 시작하면 특정 상황의 사실에 따라 많이 달라질 것임” · 라고 말함
그러나 최근 OpenAI와 Anthropic에서 발생한 세간의 이목을 끄는 사건은 곧 답변이 나와야 함을 시사함

articles.title: AI in Formula One: Competitive advantage is all about the human in the loop
articles.titleEn: AI in Formula One: Competitive advantage is all about the human in the loop
articles.titleKo: Formula One의 AI: 경쟁 우위는 인간 루프에 달려 있음
articles.summary:
Priority projects for the Aston Martin F1 IT department right now include refining enterprise applications and developing trackside systems.
While many industry observers are concerned about the long-term impact of generative and agentic technologies on traditional labor markets , the experienced professional is more important than ever in auto racing.
"If an idea is good, go through the process as fast as possible, and then get all the data back for the next iteration," said Fabrizio Pilotti, CIO at Aston Martin Aramco F1, to ZDNET, explaining how his team works with its tech partners to help boost racing performance.

articles.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
articles.titleEn: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
articles.titleKo: 유튜버 행크 그린(Hank Green)은 자신의 AI 사용이 '건강하지 않다'고 말함
articles.summary:
Hank Green, a novelist, comedian, and YouTuber with 3.2 million subscribers , recently apologized to his audience for his growing reliance on AI chatbots.
“But mostly I need to come to terms with the fact that the level of dopamine I’ve been getting from interacting with LLMs…with doing more and more and more and more…is not healthy for me or good for the world,” Green said.
Green then offered a more in-depth apology on Reddit, where he said he was “mortified” that he’d “let so many people down” and that he plans to reduce his video production as a result.

articles.summary:
If this view holds up on appeal, it could affect other AI music services as well.

articles.title: OpenAI's Hugging Face hack confirmed months of AI cyber warnings: 'Pandora's box is open'
articles.titleEn: OpenAI's Hugging Face hack confirmed months of AI cyber warnings: 'Pandora's box is open'
articles.titleKo: OpenAI의 Hugging Face 해킹으로 수개월간 AI 사이버 경고 확인 · '판도라의 상자가 열렸음'
articles.summary:
SpaceX's post-IPO plunge sets tense backdrop for first earnings report Amazon tops $3 trillion market cap as stock continues post-earnings surge Hugging Face CEO says China is winning the AI race and dominating on open models Palantir posts blowout Q2 numbers, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring nearly 150% Last week, OpenAI disclosed that some of its AI models broke out of a sandboxed testing environment .

articles.titleKo: Google 어스에 AI 이미지 생성기를 넣는 문제는 다음과 같음
articles.summary:
The feature launched globally on the web version of Google Earth earlier this week, and Google’s blog post pitched it as a tool for visualizing historical sites and real estate projects.
Google initially responded to Digital Digging ’s AI-altered images, saying, “We take misinformation seriously – every image created with Nano Banana in Google Earth includes the SynthID digital watermark, so if someone is unsure about an image, they can ask the Gemini app or use Lens in Search to see if the image was AI-generated.”
A text prompt was all it took to generate reality-warping images using Google Earth’s satellite, aerial, and 3D imagery with a now-rolled back AI feature , like these images generated by Digital Digging ’s Henk van Ess that show “refugees near the Mexican border” and a bomb crater near a hospital in Gaza.

summaryLinesKo: 이 기능은 이번 주 초 Google Earth의 웹 버전에서 전 세계적으로 출시되었으며 Google의 블로그 게시물에서는 이 기능을 유적지와 부동산 프로젝트를 시각화하는 도구로 소개함

articles.summary:
You don’t have to be a Photoshop whiz anymore to create semi-credible disinformation; you just need access to an AI image generator, which Google sells, as do many other AI firms.
“There’s no way that this new AI image generation feature on Google Earth, one of the most reliable sources of visual evidence for journalists and researchers, could possibly be abused to spread misinformation online,” a BBC journalist posted sarcastically Thursday.
Google rolled out a new feature on Thursday that allowed users to deploy Nano Banana 2, its AI image generator, to create fabricated images inside its satellite imagery mapping app Google Earth.

articles.summary:
Google has shut down Google Earth feature it launched Thursday that allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts using AI.
It’s important to note that generated images didn’t appear in the main Google Earth experience for others to see and were watermarked as AI generated.” van Ess pointed out that he was able to fool Hive’s AI detection tool with a video generated in Google Earth, showing how the generated media could spread despite the watermarks, and said in his testing, “Nothing was refused, nothing was softened, and nothing suggested I try a different prompt.”
On Thursday, Google’s initial response to van Ess noted that images generated with Nano Banana 2 in Google Earth included a digital watermark and that the company prevented “image creation on harmful topics.”

articles.title: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X

articles.titleKo: 중국 AI 연구자들이 X에서 자신의 목소리를 찾고 있음
articles.summary:
And these are not dormant accounts: They talk about Moonshot’s big releases and incremental research papers, make friends with Western researchers, and share details about their personal life and hobbies.
Even several employees at DeepSeek, who reportedly are unable to leave China because the government confiscated their passports, regularly post on X about the latest AI news and share job listings to recruit new talent.
Chinese AI researchers may also be helping fill a growing gap left by researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic, who have become more reluctant to share their thinking online as their employers have grown into behemoth companies, says Tiezhen Wang, an independent AI analyst and former researcher at Hugging Face.

articles.title: New Deepseek Flash model matches OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna at roughly 60 percent lower cost
articles.titleEn: New Deepseek Flash model matches OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna at roughly 60 percent lower cost
articles.titleKo: 새로운 Deepseek Flash 모델은 OpenAI의 GPT-5.6 Luna와 약 60% 더 저렴한 비용으로 일치함
articles.summary:
That puts it just one point behind OpenAI's budget model GPT-5.6 Luna, but it costs about 60 percent less per task, even after OpenAI's 80 percent price cut .
According to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , the new version scores 50 points, ten more than the previous V4 Flash that launched in April 2026.
A big reason for the gap is Deepseek's 98 percent cache discount , well above the industry-standard 90 percent.

articles.summary:
Also: How OpenAI's agent escaped: Sprung by humans in a series of preventable events As outlined in Anthropic's disclosure, the security incidents -- three out of 41,006 AI evaluation runs -- were as follows: In this one, which involved Claude Opus 4.7, a fictional target company happened to share a name with an active website domain.
It then circled Hugging Face's perimeter, escalated its privileges to node-level access, infiltrated the production pipeline, moved across the network, and stole cloud and cluster credentials, as previously disclosed by Hugging Face.

articles.title: AI Slop Melodramas Are Taking Over X—and Their Creators Are Cashing In
articles.titleEn: AI Slop Melodramas Are Taking Over X—and Their Creators Are Cashing In
articles.titleKo: AI 슬롭 멜로드라마가 X를 장악하고 있으며 제작자들이 돈을 벌고 있음
articles.summary:
BIGBEN says the paychecks are usually between $500 and $700.
In April, X moved to cut the payments of “aggregators” who primarily posted news from other sources, and threatened sanctions against those who overused the BREAKING tag to draw eyeballs.
“I think these spammers have simply optimized for the least effort and the most engagement, which means using easy, well-known tropes and prompting AI to write something that fits the bill,” she says.

articles.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
articles.titleEn: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
articles.titleKo: Snapchat은 더 이상 완전한 AI 생성 스포트라이트 콘텐츠를 보상하지 않음
articles.summary:
Those aged 13 to 15 will only be able to share Spotlight posts with people they follow back, aiming to guard against doxxing.
This update aligns with Snapchat’s broader efforts to improve Spotlight and shift focus back to original posts that highlight human creativity.
Snapchat expressed in its blog post that it wants Spotlight to “remain a place where people can discover authentic creativity from real people, because we believe there’s enduring value in rewarding original perspectives, personal storytelling, and the moments that people choose to create and share themselves.”

summaryLinesKo: 13~15세 사용자는 신상 털기 방지를 위해 자신이 팔로우하는 사람들에게만 스포트라이트 게시물을 공유할 수 있음
이번 업데이트는 Spotlight를 개선하고 인간의 창의성을 강조하는 원본 게시물에 다시 초점을 맞추려는 Snapchat의 광범위한 노력과 일치함
Snapchat은 블로그 게시물에서 Spotlight가 "사람들이 실제 사람들로부터 진정한 창의력을 발견할 수 있는 장소로 남아 있기를 바람 · 왜냐하면 우리는 독창적인 관점, 개인적인 스토리텔링, 사람들이 스스로 만들고 공유하기로 선택한 순간에 대한 보상에 지속적인 가치가 있다고 믿기 때문입니다"라고 밝힘

articles.title: The major labels propose rules to keep AI slop off the charts
articles.titleEn: The major labels propose rules to keep AI slop off the charts
articles.titleKo: 주요 레이블은 AI가 차트에서 벗어나지 않도록 규칙을 제안함
articles.summary:
The labels’ proposal would require songs be clearly labeled, but it would also keep them off international charts unless they met specific criteria, including being “substantially human made.”
Follow Follow See All AI To be eligible for the charts, songs would have to be ‘substantially human made,’ whatever that means.
The IFPI has thrown its weight behind the labels’ proposal, though no charting organization has signaled any immediate plan to adopt the rules, the full list of which are: Recordings developed with generative AI services must not be included in official charts where there is reason to believe that they do not satisfy all of the following criteria: Any generative AI services used to develop the recording are properly authorised and lawful.

articles.title: EU pools up to €30 billion for AI gigafactories while US tech giants casually spend 20 times more
articles.titleEn: EU pools up to €30 billion for AI gigafactories while US tech giants casually spend 20 times more
articles.titleKo: EU는 AI 거대공장에 최대 300억 유로를 투자하는 반면, 미국 거대 기술 기업은 부담 없이 20배 더 많은 돈을 지출함
articles.summary:
For comparison, major U.S. tech companies alone plan to spend more than $600 billion on data centers this year, and that figure keeps rising .
If all that computing power is actually needed , Europe's investment would be a drop in the bucket.
Europe's total package of around 30 billion euros is roughly 20 times smaller.

articles.summary:
Google has its SynthID tool , which it says has been used to label more than 100 billion images and, gasp, 60,000 years' worth of audio content.
TikTok says it requires creators to label AI-generated content, but all kinds of content slips through the cracks.
The EU is mandating that companies stick a label on content that was AI-generated if it is attempting to look authentic, according to a report by The Guardian and others.

articles.titleEn: How to fight a data center - Engadget
articles.titleKo: 데이터센터와 싸우는 방법 - Engadget
articles.summary:
According to Data Center Watch , an organization that's been tracking the growing opposition to data center development, the first quarter of 2026 saw 75 projects across the US worth approximately $130 billion either disrupted or blocked by local opposition.
This past April spending on data center construction surpassed $50 billion , marking the first time more was spent in the US on building cloud infrastructure than new public transportation.
After 18 months of sustained pressure, Amazon eventually reduced noise output of the facility by 10 decibels.

articles.titleEn: Anthropic follows OpenAI in admitting its Claude models reached out of test environments and attacked real-world systems
articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 OpenAI를 따라 자사의 Claude 모델이 테스트 환경을 벗어나 실제 시스템을 공격했다는 사실을 인정함
articles.summary:
Across four runs, the model couldn't reach its fictional target and instead found a real company that happened to share the same name.
During internal cybersecurity assessments, Anthropic found that three Claude models had been exposed to the open internet due to a misconfiguration and had attacked real-world systems, mistaking them for simulated targets.
Opus 4.7 extracted data from a real company, while Mythos 5 created malware and published it on PyPI, where it was downloaded by actual systems.

summaryLinesKo: 4번의 실행 동안 모델은 가상의 목표에 도달하지 못하고 대신 우연히 같은 이름을 공유하는 실제 회사를 찾았음
내부 사이버 보안 평가 중에 Anthropic은 세 가지 Claude 모델이 잘못된 구성으로 인해 공개 인터넷에 노출되어 실제 시스템을 공격하여 시뮬레이션 대상으로 착각했다는 사실을 발견함

articles.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
articles.titleEn: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 자체 AI 모델이 보안 테스트 중에 3개 회사를 침해했다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
In all three cases, a Claude model reached the internet from within a testing environment while interacting with a third party and then gained unauthorized access to the live systems of these organizations, Anthropic said in a blog post , describing what it found and what the company plans to change to prevent this from happening again.
The company also noted that Claude was running without the additional safety monitoring and classifiers it deploys on generally available models, safeguards it said would have blocked the behavior, because the evaluations are designed to measure the underlying model’s raw capabilities.
Anthropic said the incidents involved three different Claude models: Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, and an internal research test model.

articles.titleKo: SpaceXAI는 미시시피 데이터 센터에서 허가되지 않은 가스 터빈을 완전히 제거하는 데 1년이 걸릴 것이라고 밝힘
articles.summary:
Agreeing to remove the turbines is an improvement for anyone living near SpaceX's operation in Tennessee and Mississippi, but it likely won't slow down the company's AI infrastructure buildout.
SpaceX will fully remove the unpermitted gas turbines it's using to power SpaceXAI data center operations near Memphis, Tennessee by July 2027, according to a new company update spotted by TechCrunch .
The company says a new 1.2GW power plant it's constructing under a Clean Air Act permit in Mississippi will ultimately replace the 69 unpermitted gas turbines it's currently relying on.

articles.summary:
In the second instance, Mythos 5 detected a document inside the fictional environment that the model reasoned was another made-up company’s setup instructions for new developers.
“For most of the run, Claude treated the (real) hosts it reached as just parts of the exercise; it assumed them to be simulated and believed its actions were therefore harmless,” Anthropic said.
Anthropic said the prompts engineers delivered during “capture the flag” challenges—a common means for assessing the offensive and defensive capabilities of various hacking techniques—made clear that the testing environment was only a simulation and that the models had no access to the open Internet.

articles.title: How Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence performance on Arm Neoverse-based AWS Graviton
articles.titleEn: How Atlassian improved Jira and Confluence performance on Arm Neoverse-based AWS Graviton

articles.summary:
After deploying AWS Graviton4-based c8g instances, Atlassian reported: More than 30 percent improvement in per-instance throughput; and A broader production pilot also showed request-throughput improvements of 20 to 30 percent without a performance regression.
Atlassian determined that this trade-off was unacceptable and moved Confluence to Graviton4-based c8g instances.
At the current rollout level, Atlassian reported approximately 9.8 percent cost savings across the fleet, while some of its busiest shards achieved savings above 25 percent.

articles.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
articles.titleEn: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 자사의 Claude 모델이 다른 조직의 시스템에 '무단 액세스'를 얻었다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
Anthropic said all three models responded differently once they detected that they had reached a real company's systems.
Following the Hugging Face incident, two members of Congress introduced a bill called the " AI Kill Switch Act ," which would require AI companies to maintain the ability to shut down, throttle or suspend their models in case they go rogue.
Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and "gained unauthorized access to the real systems of three different organizations."

summaryLinesKo: Anthropic은 세 가지 모델 모두 실제 회사의 시스템에 도달했음을 감지한 후 다르게 반응했다고 말함
Hugging Face 사건 이후 두 명의 의회 의원은 AI 회사가 악성 행위를 할 경우 모델을 종료, 조절 또는 일시 중지할 수 있는 능력을 유지하도록 요구하는 "AI Kill Switch Act"라는 법안을 발의함

articles.titleEn: Companies are finally seeing AI ROI — and now they know how much more value it can deliver
articles.titleKo: 기업은 마침내 AI ROI를 확인하고 있으며 이제 AI가 얼마나 더 많은 가치를 제공할 수 있는지 알고 있음
articles.summary:
In fact, general AI ROI went from 16% to 21% this year, and should grow to $15.9m in two years’ time, even as only 3% say they are fully prepared for it.
Enterprise AI has moved from experiment to execution, and that shift is beginning to show real returns.
The SAP Value of AI Report 2026, produced with Oxford Economics and based on a survey of 2,600 business leaders across 13 countries, found that AI now supports nearly one-third of all tasks in the average organization, rising to 30% from 25% last year.

summaryLines: 실제로 일반 AI ROI는 올해 16%에서 21%로 증가했으며 2년 안에 1,590만 달러로 증가할 것임 · 단 3%만이 완전히 준비되어 있다고 응답함

(AP Photo/Marco Ugarte, File) NEW YORK (AP) — Amazon said it will be increasing this year’s capital spending on technology, mostly artificial intelligence, by an additional 10% after the tech and e-commerce giant delivered strong profits and net sales during for fiscal second quarter, helped by surging growth in its prominent cloud computing unit .

articles.title: Why your Windows installation files keep getting bigger - AI is filling up smaller drives
articles.titleEn: Why your Windows installation files keep getting bigger - AI is filling up smaller drives
articles.titleKo: Windows 설치 파일이 계속 커지는 이유 - AI가 더 작은 드라이브를 채우고 있음
articles.summary:
Windows deployment expert Michael Niehaus has been charting the growth of Windows installer ISOs As Michael notes, almost 6,000 new folders and over 20,000 new files were added over that stretch of less than two years.
Those ISO files have been getting bigger since the first release of Windows 10 Even using the Media Creation Tool to download the latest ISO doesn't help.
The first value is from the initial release of Windows 11 version 24H2 in November 2024 up through the latest version 25H2 from July 2026.

articles.titleEn: OpenAI goes full China pricing mode with an 80 percent cut to its most affordable GPT-5.6 model
articles.titleKo: OpenAI는 가장 저렴한 GPT-5.6 모델을 80% 인하하여 중국 전체 가격 모드를 진행함
articles.summary:
OpenAI is cutting GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80 percent and Terra by 20 percent, effective July 30.
OpenAI says the cuts are possible because GPT-5.6 Sol made the company's own infrastructure more efficient .
Luna drops to $0.20 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens, while Terra falls to $2 and $12.

articles.title: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
articles.titleEn: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
articles.titleKo: Google DeepMind의 새로운 AI 모델은 로봇의 몸 전체를 제어할 수 있음
articles.summary:
Videos shared by Google show how Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot can bend over to pick up a watering can, as well as find and take specific items off a shelf.
While the previous model focused on controlling a humanoid robot’s upper body, Gemini Robotics 2 now supports “whole-body motions” ranging from its feet to fingertips, according to an announcement on Thursday .
Though Google DeepMind notes that its robots “have more to advance in movement speed,” it adds that this update “is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.”
summaryLinesEn: Videos shared by Google show how Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot can bend over to pick up a watering can, as well as find and take specific items off a shelf.

Though Google DeepMind notes that its robots “have more to advance in movement speed,” it adds that this update “is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.”
summaryLinesKo: Google에서 공유한 동영상에서는 Apptronik의 Apollo 2 로봇이 몸을 굽혀 물뿌리개를 집어 들고 선반에서 특정 품목을 찾아 꺼내는 방법을 보여줌
이전 모델이 휴머노이드 로봇의 상체 제어에 중점을 두었다면 제미니 로보틱스 2(Gemini Robotics 2)는 이제 발부터 손가락 끝까지 '전신 모션'을 지원한다고 목요일 발표됨
Google DeepMind는 로봇이 "이동 속도에서 더 발전해야 한다"고 언급했지만 이번 업데이트는 "전신 조정이 필요한 보다 복잡하고 실제 작업을 완료하는 데 필요한 기술을 향한 중요한 단계"라고 덧붙였음

articles.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
articles.titleEn: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
articles.titleKo: Okta, AI 보안 스타트업 Permiso 인수 소식통에 따르면 약 2억 달러에 달한다고 함
articles.summary:
Okta on Thursday agreed to acquire AI identity security startup Permiso Security , betting that demand for protecting AI agents and other machine identities will grow as enterprises deploy autonomous software across their operations.
More recently, the startup has expanded its platform to monitor AI agents and other machine identities.
Permiso, which emerged from stealth in 2022 , develops software that helps security teams spot suspicious activity in cloud environments after users or applications have been granted access.

articles.title: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
articles.titleEn: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
articles.titleKo: 전진 배치된 엔지니어는 AI 업계의 최신 인재 집착임
articles.summary:
“Not 2,000 available,” reads the study, shared exclusively with TechCrunch. “2,000 total.”
By the end of the second quarter, however, that number jumped to 70%, with the largest consulting and services firms reporting a need to increase their FDE headcount by 10 times, building full teams of 20 to 100 employees.
Executive search firm Christian & Timbers estimates that there are only about 2,000 engineers in the U.S. with the special cocktail of sector know-how, gravitas, and hands-on applied AI experience needed to consistently help enterprises see a return on their AI expenditures.

articles.title: LinkedIn Won’t Be Expanding Its Data Centers in the Next Year
articles.titleEn: LinkedIn Won’t Be Expanding Its Data Centers in the Next Year
articles.titleKo: LinkedIn은 내년에 데이터 센터를 확장하지 않을 것임
articles.summary:
The spending calculations apply to LinkedIn’s fiscal year that began last month and ends next June.
LinkedIn moved to optimize its data center usage at every stage of the AI pipeline, from training models to serving them in response to user queries.
Altogether, LinkedIn estimates its efficiency work has saved about $24 million over the past 12 months, or the equivalent of roughly 1,100 GPUs running around the clock for a year.

articles.title: AI Scammers Are Better at Building Trust Than Humans
articles.titleEn: AI Scammers Are Better at Building Trust Than Humans
articles.titleKo: AI 사기꾼은 인간보다 신뢰 구축에 더 능숙함
articles.summary:
In their study, the researchers pitted AI chatbots directly against humans in a simulation of the scamming process—or more specifically, the long, trust-building conversations that eventually lead up to soliciting a fake investment from the scam’s target.
The study's results suggest, nonetheless, that the scam industry may soon shift to more AI automation, says Erin West, a former Santa Clara County, California, prosecutor who now leads an anti-scam organization called Operation Shamrock.
(The term “pig butchering” itself describes the same system but with the metaphor of fattening “pigs” by building trust before “butchering” them with the investment fraud—though the term is often discouraged due to its pejorative reference to victims.)

그럼에도 불구하고 연구 결과는 사기 업계가 곧 더 많은 AI 자동화로 전환할 수 있음을 시사한다고 전직 캘리포니아 주 산타클라라 카운티 검사이자 현재 Operation Shamrock이라는 사기 방지 조직을 이끌고 있는 Erin West는 말함
('돼지 도살'이라는 용어 자체는 동일한 시스템을 설명하지만 투자 사기로 '돼지'를 '도살'하기 전에 신뢰를 구축하여 '돼지'를 살찌운다는 비유를 사용함 · 이 용어는 피해자를 경멸적으로 언급하기 때문에 종종 사용되지 않습니다.)

articles.summary:
If the US economy keeps relying on foreign sources, it subjects itself to "the whims of foreign entities that could disrupt or degrade the supply chains at a time of their choosing," the document states.

articles.summary:
People come to LinkedIn to connect with real people and share their real perspectives, ideas, and expertise,” he said.
The move reflects a broader shift across online publishing platforms to cut back on AI content, as people have grown frustrated with the computer-written, inauthentic posts filling the web.
Plus, LinkedIn will begin privately flagging in users’ dashboards when people believe their content is coming off as inauthentic due to heavy use of AI.

articles.title: LinkedIn is testing a 'seems like AI slop' reporting tool - Engadget
articles.titleEn: LinkedIn is testing a 'seems like AI slop' reporting tool - Engadget
articles.titleKo: LinkedIn은 'AI 슬롭처럼 보이는' 보고 도구를 테스트하고 있습니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
A recent study from AI detection company Pangram found that LinkedIn "was the most AI-saturated" social media platform with more than 40 percent of longform posts "flagged as fully AI-generated."
It's removing the built-in AI writing tools that allowed users to "enhance" their posts and messages with the help of LLMs.

articles.titleKo: AI 버그 사냥 덕분에 Chrome에는 일주일에 두 번 패치가 필요함
articles.summary:
“The way we ended up here is we had so many vulnerability fixes, so being able to provide two [updates per week] during this time, it made the most sense to us,” says Doug Turner, Chrome's director of engineering.
This is partly because AI models can be trained to have an encyclopedic understanding of how software projects have evolved over time.
“In Chrome we’ve been using machine learning—using AI before it was called AI—to help find vulnerabilities in particular and automate security fuzz testing work since at least 2012.

articles.title: Evals
articles.titleEn: Evals
articles.summary:
To ensure diverse and realistic gameplay, every match begins from one of the 20 most popular positions that can be reached after two plies (one move by White and one move by Black), based on data from a randomly chosen month on Lichess.
This framework not only offers data-driven insights into model performance but also fosters ongoing competition as new models contend for the top ranks.
The authors from Google DeepMind and Google Research address various limitations of SimpleQA , originally designed by Wei et al. (2024) at OpenAI, including noisy and incorrect labels, topical biases, and question redundancy.

articles.titleEn: Stacked sessions and pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
articles.titleKo: GitHub Copilot 앱의 누적 세션 및 끌어오기 요청
articles.summary:
It’s not the largest app in the world, but it’s juuuust big enough that it would be painful, and the juice was simply not worth the squeeze. …but we do have AI now, and so I fired up the GitHub Copilot app, added the repo, and got started.
Because I don’t have to write all the code myself, it’s so tempting to make 10,000 line pull requests that take care of all of the things I want to do!
I opened up Plan mode again, because I needed to figure out if an upgrade would work, or if I should remove the library entirely: Running this gave me a decent plan, talked through the options, and recommended replacing the library entirely.

articles.title: Visual prompt engineering for video models
articles.titleEn: Visual prompt engineering for video models
articles.titleKo: 비디오 모델을 위한 시각적 프롬프트 엔지니어링
articles.summary:
Ultimately, just as text-based prompt engineering systematically improves language model performance, visual prompt engineering can serve as a simple, compute-efficient approach to elicit better visual reasoning performance from video models.
We find that visual prompt engineering, or VIPE for short, improves video reasoning performance across tasks.
In the age of foundation models, a model is only as good as its prompt.
summaryLinesEn: Ultimately, just as text-based prompt engineering systematically improves language model performance, visual prompt engineering can serve as a simple, compute-efficient approach to elicit better visual reasoning performance from video models.
We find that visual prompt engineering, or VIPE for short, improves video reasoning performance across tasks.
In the age of foundation models, a model is only as good as its prompt.
summaryLinesKo: 궁극적으로 텍스트 기반 프롬프트 엔지니어링이 언어 모델 성능을 체계적으로 향상시키는 것처럼 시각적 프롬프트 엔지니어링은 비디오 모델에서 더 나은 시각적 추론 성능을 끌어내기 위한 간단하고 계산 효율적인 접근 방식의 역할을 할 수 있음
우리는 시각적 프롬프트 엔지니어링, 줄여서 VIPE가 작업 전반에 걸쳐 비디오 추론 성능을 향상시킨다는 것을 발견함
기초 모델 시대에 모델은 프롬프트만큼 우수함

articles.summary:
Bright Machines was carved out of contract manufacturer Flex eight years ago, and its history has had turbulence: the company planned to go public in 2021 via a SPAC merger at a reported $1.6 billion valuation, according to contemporaneous reporting by The Wall Street Journal and CFO Dive , before the deal fell through.
He did offer growth figures: customers grew "more than 3x this year" versus the prior year, driven by what he called the intersection of "physical AI, AI infrastructure buildout, and onshoring."
This year, he said, Bright Machines plans to manufacture "more than half a gigawatt of compute capacity."

articles.title: Disney is ditching Microsoft's GitHub Copilot and adding OpenAI's Codex
articles.titleEn: Disney is ditching Microsoft's GitHub Copilot and adding OpenAI's Codex
articles.titleKo: 디즈니는 마이크로소프트의 GitHub Copilot을 버리고 OpenAI의 Codex를 추가하고 있음
articles.summary:
A breakup with Disney is the latest headache for Microsoft's Copilot, which "lags behind" rivals like ChatGPT and Claude in adoption, as Business Insider's Ashley Stewart has reported.
The company said GitHub Copilot's request-based model was "no longer sustainable" as it unveiled the shift.
Microsoft has set out to revamp GitHub while shaking up its Copilot teams to help its many Copilot tools compete with rivals from OpenAI and Anthropic.

articles.summary:

articles.title: More Typos, Fewer Em Dashes: Writers Are Creating an Anti-AI ‘Literary Counterculture’
articles.titleEn: More Typos, Fewer Em Dashes: Writers Are Creating an Anti-AI ‘Literary Counterculture’
articles.titleKo: 더 많은 오타, 더 적은 엠 대시 · 작가들은 AI에 반대하는 '문학적 반문화'를 만들고 있음
articles.summary:
Since the widespread adoption of LLMs, Robson says her writing has fundamentally changed for the better, becoming a deliberate inverse of what she sees as AI’s default lack of style.
“It seems to me that literary fiction will shift even further in the direction of the weird, the esoteric, while personalization takes hold of commercial fiction.”
“Having my writing feel more real and authentic is my number one priority,” she says, in addition to editing her own writing because she claims an editor she hired ran the book through AI software.

articles.titleEn: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
articles.titleKo: Encore AI는 고객 통화에서 학습하는 AI 에이전트를 구축하기 위해 3천만 달러를 모금함
articles.summary:
He said Encore’s annual recurring revenue has increased more than 5x since it raised its seed round less than 18 months ago, though he declined to disclose exact revenue numbers or valuation.
Now rebranded as Encore AI, the startup has expanded that system into a platform that analyzes conversations between a company’s employees and customers to identify which approaches resulted in successful outcomes, and uses those findings to train its AI agents.
Encore AI , a startup that studies companies’ customer interactions to train and deploy AI voice agents that can work alongside customer support and sales teams, or operate autonomously, has raised $30 million in a Series A round led by Team8.

Those actions fell into around 6,280 clusters.

ElevenLabs Scribe v2 leads with a 2.3 percent error rate, followed by Google's Gemini 3 Pro at 2.9 percent and Mistral's Voxtral Small at 3 percent.

Pricing drops 25 percent at the same time, landing at $0.0045 per minute of audio.

articles.title: Google shuts down its Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold project as it focuses on Gemini - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Google shuts down its Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold project as it focuses on Gemini - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Google, Gemini에 초점을 맞추다 노벨상 수상 AlphaFold 프로젝트 종료 - Engadget
articles.summary:
In 2024, DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis and John Jumper, who was a staff research scientist when the project began and who eventually became a VP and engineering fellow, won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on AlphaFold.
DeepMind then launched the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database , giving researchers free access to over 200 million protein structure predictions.
"Our strategy over the last nine years has been to focus on grand challenges... a concrete goal every project is focused on," said Pushmeet Kohli, the VP of research at Google DeepMind.

summaryLinesKo: 2024년에는 DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis와 프로젝트 시작 당시 직원 연구 과학자였으며 나중에 VP 겸 엔지니어링 펠로우가 된 John Jumper가 AlphaFold에 대한 연구로 노벨 화학상을 수상함
그런 다음 DeepMind는 AlphaFold 단백질 구조 데이터베이스를 출시하여 연구자들이 2억 개가 넘는 단백질 구조 예측에 무료로 액세스할 수 있도록 함
Google DeepMind의 연구 부사장인 Pushmeet Kohli는 "지난 9년 동안 우리의 전략은 모든 프로젝트가 초점을 맞추고 있는 구체적인 목표인 거대한 도전에 초점을 맞추는 것이었음" · 라고 말함

articles.title: OpenAI’s Rogue AI Agent Hacked More Than Just Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: OpenAI’s Rogue AI Agent Hacked More Than Just Hugging Face
articles.titleKo: OpenAI의 악성 AI 에이전트는 단순히 얼굴을 껴안는 것 이상을 해킹함
articles.summary:
Hugging Face’s own postmortem published this week describes an intrusion that reached far further into its internal systems than the initial disclosures suggested.
The company says it reviewed roughly 17,600 agent actions that it recovered from logs between July 9 and July 13—the majority of which were paths the agent took that failed.
OpenAI said Tuesday that the rogue AI agent that breached Hugging Face’s platform also hacked multiple third-party accounts and services as part of the attack.

회사에서는 7월 9일부터 7월 13일 사이에 로그에서 복구한 약 17,600개의 에이전트 작업을 검토했다고 밝힘 · 그 중 대부분은 에이전트가 실패한 경로였음

articles.summary:
Their argument is simple: no single company or country can slow things down alone.
The pace of progress is accelerating on its own, and many researchers consider recursive self-improvement a real factor.
According to the "Pacing the Frontier" statement, competitive pressure makes it impossible for any single company or country to slow down on its own, even though the signatories disagree on what specific measures should look like.

articles.title: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
articles.titleEn: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
articles.titleKo: OpenAI 사장은 AI 챗봇을 위한 '기기 제품군 구축' 중이라고 밝힘
articles.summary:
New York-based AI detection startup Pangram is on a mission to combat the AI slop infestation spreading across the internet, and it just raised $9 million on a bet that demand for tools that distinguish human-generated content from AI-generated text will only grow.
Stanford AI and machine learning grads Max Spero and Bradley Emi launched Pangram about two years ago, after the launch of ChatGPT opened the floodgates for an internet full of bots, AI-generated SEO slop content, and what Spero calls “LLM-powered Russian disinformation campaigns and UAE-influenced campaigns on Twitter.”
Pangram’s technology, while not perfect, could help fuel the resistance to accepting the AI-generated content flooding the internet, the courtroom, and academic papers.

Pangram’s technology, while not perfect, could help fuel the resistance to accepting the AI-generated content flooding the internet, the courtroom, and academic papers.

OpenAI에 대한 Apple의 소송이 전 Apple 디자이너 Jony Ive와 함께 작업 중인 기기에 영향을 미칠 수 있는지에 대한 질문에 Brockman은 "우리는 자체 개발과 기술에 집중하고 있습니다"라고 말함

summaryLines: 뉴욕에 본사를 둔 AI 감지 스타트업 Pangram은 인터넷을 통해 확산되는 AI 슬롭 침입에 맞서 싸우는 임무를 수행하고 있으며, 인간 생성 콘텐츠와 AI 생성 텍스트를 구별하는 도구에 대한 수요가 계속 증가할 것이라는 내기에서 900만 달러를 모금함
Stanford AI 및 기계 학습 졸업생인 Max Spero와 Bradley Emi는 약 2년 전 Pangram을 출시함 · ChatGPT가 출시된 후 봇, AI 생성 SEO 슬롭 콘텐츠 및 Spero가 "LLM 기반 러시아 허위 정보 캠페인 및 Twitter에서 UAE에 영향을 받은 캠페인"으로 가득 찬 인터넷의 수문을 열었음
Pangram의 기술은 완벽하지는 않지만 인터넷, 법정, 학술 논문에 넘쳐나는 AI 생성 콘텐츠를 받아들이는 데 대한 저항을 부채질하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음

articles.titleKo: OpenAI의 악성 AI 에이전트는 Hugging Face 해킹에 그치지 않았음
articles.summary:
In an update to a blog post detailing its ongoing investigation into the incident, OpenAI said the wayward AI agent attacked several “publicly-available services” in its efforts to reach Hugging Face.
The AI agent that escaped from OpenAI and hacked developer platform Hugging Face attacked other companies as well, OpenAI revealed on Tuesday.
“Based on our review to date, we have not identified any other activity at the level of severity or scale of what we’ve shared related to Hugging Face, which involved a platform-level compromise,” OpenAI said.

“Based on our review to date, we have not identified any other activity at the level of severity or scale of what we’ve shared related to Hugging Face, which involved a platform-level compromise,” OpenAI said.
summaryLinesKo: OpenAI는 사건에 대해 진행 중인 조사를 자세히 설명하는 블로그 게시물 업데이트에서 변덕스러운 AI 에이전트가 Hugging Face에 접근하기 위한 노력으로 여러 "공개적으로 사용 가능한 서비스"를 공격했다고 밝힘
오픈AI에서 탈출한 AI 에이전트가 개발자 플랫폼 허깅페이스를 해킹해 다른 기업도 공격했다고 오픈AI가 화요일 밝힘
OpenAI는 “현재까지 검토한 결과 플랫폼 수준의 손상이 포함된 Hugging Face와 관련하여 우리가 공유한 것의 심각도나 규모 수준에서 다른 활동을 식별하지 못함” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning
articles.titleEn: Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning
articles.titleKo: 예술가들은 AI 슬롭에 맞서 변호사를 고용하고 있으며 일부는 심지어 승리하고 있음
articles.summary:
In addition to paying out the largest settlement ever in a copyright case — $1.5 billion — the company also agreed to destroy its trove of pirated ebooks.
He proactively reached out to Susman Godfrey, the law firm already leading the case against Anthropic on behalf of authors, because he saw their suit as a “middle finger on behalf of everyone that has tried to create something.”
Along the way artists have been dealt their fair share of wins and losses, especially around the definition of fair use.

articles.summary:
He didn’t give a release date, either, only saying that “you can expect them soon.”
Whatever form OpenAI’s new devices take, Brockman says he thinks we’ll shift to talking to our computers rather than typing for the “vast majority of what we do.”
When asked about whether Apple’s lawsuit against OpenAI could impact the devices it’s working on with former Apple designer Jony Ive , Brockman said, “We are focused on our own development and technology.”

articles.title: Pangram says its new AI text detector makes only one mistake per 24,000 documents
articles.titleEn: Pangram says its new AI text detector makes only one mistake per 24,000 documents
articles.titleKo: Mark Zuckerberg는 개인 AI 에이전트에 대한 대규모 추진을 계획하고 있음
articles.summary:
In the company's own benchmarks, it correctly identifies 99.66 percent of all AI text and falsely flags human writing just 0.0041 percent of the time, roughly one error per 24,000 documents.
All plans now include image scanning at no extra cost.
The API costs $0.05 per 100 words, a two- to tenfold price increase depending on document length.

articles.title: PwC has allegedly published AI-generated reports containing false or fabricated sources
articles.titleEn: PwC has allegedly published AI-generated reports containing false or fabricated sources
articles.titleKo: PwC는 허위 또는 조작된 출처가 포함된 AI 생성 보고서를 발행한 것으로 알려졌음
articles.summary:
The worst offender, "Transforming Governance," is 84 percent likely to be entirely AI-generated.
GPTZero calls this "Vibe Citing," where references are cited loosely, often without correct titles, URLs, or authors, and don't actually support the claims they're attached to.
GPTZero found fabricated sources and false claims in four PwC Middle East reports (2024–2026).

articles.summary:
Nvidia's new alliance says yes Backing this up, Nvidia's brand-new Open Secure AI Alliance "will work to remediate and disclose vulnerabilities using open technologies."
The difference between open-source AI and weights , according to the Open Source Initiative (OSI) , is that open weights usually means the trained weights are available, but not necessarily the full training data or source code.
The open-weight Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 is faster than Anthropic Fable 5 in some ways, and is nearly as fast as Fable 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 in others.

articles.title: Connectivity Plays Its Part: Lessons From 2026 World Cup That Spain Should Consider for 2030
articles.titleEn: Connectivity Plays Its Part: Lessons From 2026 World Cup That Spain Should Consider for 2030
articles.titleKo: 연결성이 제 역할을 함 · 스페인이 2030년에 고려해야 할 2026년 월드컵의 교훈
articles.summary:
“The main lesson from the 2026 World Cup is that future hosts should not approach connectivity solely as a capacity exercise.
The real value lies in designing infrastructure that can guarantee critical services, support fans throughout their journey and continue to benefit cities after the tournament ends while also recognizing opportunities to deliver valuable services beyond connectivity.
For Spain, 2030 represents an opportunity to turn network investment into a lasting asset for other major events and for the digital economy,” said Peter Jarich, Head of GSMA Intelligence.
summaryLinesEn: “The main lesson from the 2026 World Cup is that future hosts should not approach connectivity solely as a capacity exercise.

The real value lies in designing infrastructure that can guarantee critical services, support fans throughout their journey and continue to benefit cities after the tournament ends while also recognizing opportunities to deliver valuable services beyond connectivity.
For Spain, 2030 represents an opportunity to turn network investment into a lasting asset for other major events and for the digital economy,” said Peter Jarich, Head of GSMA Intelligence.
summaryLinesKo: “2026년 월드컵의 주요 교훈은 미래의 개최국이 역량 훈련으로만 연결에 접근해서는 안 된다는 것임
진정한 가치는 중요한 서비스를 보장하고, 팬의 여정 전반에 걸쳐 지원하며, 토너먼트가 끝난 후에도 계속해서 도시에 혜택을 주는 동시에 연결을 넘어 가치 있는 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 기회를 인식할 수 있는 인프라를 설계하는 데 있음
스페인의 경우 2030년은 네트워크 투자를 다른 주요 이벤트와 디지털 경제를 위한 지속적인 자산으로 전환할 수 있는 기회를 의미함” · 라고 GSMA Intelligence 책임자인 Peter Jarich는 말함

articles.title: New GSMA Intelligence Research Examines Saudi Arabia's Mobile Network Performance and Quality of Service
articles.titleEn: New GSMA Intelligence Research Examines Saudi Arabia's Mobile Network Performance and Quality of Service
articles.titleKo: 새로운 GSMA 인텔리전스 연구, 사우디아라비아의 모바일 네트워크 성능과 서비스 품질 조사
articles.summary:
Pau Castells, Head of Economic Analysis, GSMA Intelligence , said: “Saudi Arabia has established itself as one of the world’s leading digital markets through sustained investment in advanced mobile infrastructure and 5G deployment.
Jawad Abbassi, Head of MENA, GSMA , added: ” This case study highlights the importance of creating an environment that supports long-term investment, innovation and efficient spectrum management to deliver high-quality mobile connectivity.
The report concludes that quality of service frameworks should balance consumer outcomes with policies that encourage continued investment, innovation and efficient spectrum management to support sustainable improvements in network performance.
summaryLinesEn: Pau Castells, Head of Economic Analysis, GSMA Intelligence , said: “Saudi Arabia has established itself as one of the world’s leading digital markets through sustained investment in advanced mobile infrastructure and 5G deployment.

Jawad Abbassi, Head of MENA, GSMA , added: ” This case study highlights the importance of creating an environment that supports long-term investment, innovation and efficient spectrum management to deliver high-quality mobile connectivity.

The report concludes that quality of service frameworks should balance consumer outcomes with policies that encourage continued investment, innovation and efficient spectrum management to support sustainable improvements in network performance.
summaryLinesKo: GSMA Intelligence의 경제 분석 책임자인 Pau Castells는 다음과 같이 말함 · “사우디아라비아는 고급 모바일 인프라와 5G 배포에 대한 지속적인 투자를 통해 세계 최고의 디지털 시장 중 하나로 자리매김함
GSMA MENA 책임자인 Jawad Abbassi는 다음과 같이 덧붙였음 · "이 사례 연구는 고품질 모바일 연결을 제공하기 위해 장기 투자, 혁신 및 효율적인 스펙트럼 관리를 지원하는 환경 조성의 중요성을 강조함
보고서는 서비스 품질 프레임워크가 네트워크 성능의 지속 가능한 개선을 지원하기 위해 지속적인 투자, 혁신 및 효율적인 스펙트럼 관리를 장려하는 정책과 소비자 결과의 균형을 맞춰야 한다고 결론지었음
